Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks.

You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified frameworks that integrate multiple modalities.

  • Develop and refine reward modeling strategies that improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create and curate multimodal simulation environments and datasets to support robust training, evaluation, and benchmarking of reinforcement learning systems.

  • Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

  • Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance.

  • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

  • Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance.

  • Proven track record of research publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

  • Prototype and Demonstrate Value: Rapidly build prototypes and proof-of-value solutions that demonstrate tangible outcomes to business and technical stakeholders.

  • Lead AI Innovation with Customers: Facilitate workshops, hackathons, and innovation sessions with customers to explore new ways AI can transform their operations.

  • Drive Adoption and Business Impact: Partner with customer teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and realisation of measurable value from AI deployments.

What's Different About This Role

  • Writing a sharp brief for what you want AI to build is now core to the role, not a side skill.

  • Judgment on business impact matters more than raw build speed: which use case actually moves the metric the customer cares about, and which is just an impressive demo.

  • You'll keep pushing on what's possible as Omnea's AI tooling evolves, and bring what you learn back to the rest of the team.

About You

You might be a great fit if you…

  • 3+ years in transformation, strategy or operations work, ideally where AI or automation was part of the answer

  • You take a messy business problem, form a hypothesis fast, and turn it into something that can actually be built

  • You’re comfortable in front of a CFO or COO, whether that’s working through a problem on a whiteboard or presenting a formal readout

  • You know how to measure the business impact of what you've delivered (pre- and post-delivery), and can turn that into a clear story for stakeholders - time saved, error rates down, adoption up, whatever the metric that actually matters to that customer

  • You’d rather be accountable for the outcome than hand over the recommendation and move on

  • Experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy is a big plus, though not required

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build

  • Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

  • Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

  • Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

  • Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For

  • Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

  • Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

  • Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

  • Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

  • Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

  • Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

  • Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind eine Performance Marketing Agentur mit einem großen Fokus auf Creative Design. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok, und produzieren dabei über 1.000 Creatives im Monat.

Kurz zur Einordnung, weil der Begriff Performance Creatives oft ein bisschen unklar ist: Damit meinen wir ganz einfach Werbeanzeigen für Social Media, also Bilder, Videos und UGC Ads für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok. Für YouTube erstellen wir die auch, unser größter Fokus liegt aber ganz klar auf Meta Ads (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok Ads.

Dabei arbeiten wir mit richtig großen Playern zusammen und begleiten sie strategisch, zum Beispiel Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli, Steiff, Gothaer, Finanzguru, Pixum und Olavson.

Jetzt suchen wir einen Art Director in Vollzeit, der bei uns die kreative und strategische Leitung übernimmt. Das ist für uns eine extrem wichtige Rolle. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Research und Daten basieren, bist ganz nah an unseren Kunden dran, bereitest Reportings auf und leitest unser Design Team.

Beim Thema AI sind wir extrem weit vorne. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst.

Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben.

Aufgaben

  • Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging

  • Research: Du tauchst richtig tief in Researches ein, also Zielgruppe, Wettbewerb und Plattformen. Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut und was funktioniert gerade auf Meta und TikTok

  • Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt

  • Reportings: Performance im Ads Manager analysieren, Learnings ableiten und daraus Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für unsere Kunden aufbereiten

  • Kundenkontakt: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, führst Calls, präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse und bist kreative Ansprechperson

  • Teamleitung: Du leitest unser Design Team (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter), briefst, gibst Feedback und entwickelst das Team weiter

  • Kapazitäten: Du stimmst Kapazitäten, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Design Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte sauber laufen

  • Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und mit Blick auf Performance, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung

  • Du entwickelst unsere AI Workflows mit Claude, Figma und Higgsfield ständig weiter und trägst Learnings ins Team

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder als Creative Lead, idealerweise im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld

  • Wirklich hohe Kreativität: Du entwickelst eigene, unverwechselbare Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads

  • Sicheres Auftreten: Du präsentierst Ideen klar und überzeugend vor Kunden und triffst im Team auch mal Entscheidungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit allen gängigen Designprogrammen, vor allem Figma

  • Sehr gute AI Skills: Du nutzt Claude und Figma im Arbeitsalltag und arbeitest darin komplett selbstständig. Erfahrung mit Higgsfield, ElevenLabs und Co ist ein großes Plus

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Ad Creative Konzepten für Meta, TikTok o.ä. (PFLICHT, bitte im Portfolio zeigen)

  • Du kannst mit Zahlen arbeiten: Ads Manager Daten lesen, CTR, Hook Rate, ROAS interpretieren und daraus Strategien ableiten

  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team geleitet und Kapazitäten geplant

  • Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig laufen

  • Du beschäftigst dich auch privat mit Social Ads, Trends und Plattform Updates

  • Sprache: Deutsch mind. C1, Englisch mind. B2

Benefits

  • Arbeite mit wirklich großen Marken wie Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli und Steiff, und zwar strategisch, nicht nur ausführend

  • AI Vorsprung: Wir sind beim Thema AI extrem weit vorne, du lernst bei uns super viel und bekommst die passenden AI Prozesse an die Hand (Claude, Figma, Higgsfield)

  • Zielbasiert statt nach Zeit: flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote first

  • Datengetriebenes Umfeld, jede kreative Entscheidung wird messbar

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du formst die kreative Ausrichtung der Agentur mit

  • Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

  • JobRad

  • Mehrere Workations pro Jahr

  • Regelmäßige Team Events

Unser Prozess

Weil die Rolle für uns so wichtig ist, gehören eine Testaufgabe und ein Interview fest zum Prozess dazu.

  1. Bewerbung einreichen (CV + Portfolio/Case Studies)

  2. Kennenlerngespräch mit Gerrit (GF)

We are looking for a Search & Ecommerce Account Director to lead the strategic development, execution, and performance of integrated biddable activity across Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and Amazon Search.

As a senior leader within the team, you will be responsible for defining and delivering best-in-class search and ecommerce strategies, ensuring alignment with broader client business goals and full-funnel media objectives.

You will act as the senior client contact, working with stakeholders at Director level and above, while leading cross-functional teams and offshore delivery hubs to execute against strategy.

This role combines deep platform expertise, strategic leadership, and operational oversight, ensuring campaigns are executed to the highest standard while continuously driving innovation and growth.

Strategic Leadership

Client and Stakeholder Management

Onshore–Offshore Delivery Model

  • Define and manage ways of working between onshore strategy teams and offshore execution teams

    • Defined processes

 Skills & Experience:

  • Strong understanding of full-funnel media strategy and cross-channel integration
  • Advanced analytical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Experience managing large-scale, complex accounts and budgets
  • Strong client leadership experience, including senior stakeholder management
  • Experience managing and developing multi-layered teams (including offshore models)

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Who you are

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

What you’ll do

  • Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

  • Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

  • Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

  • Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

  • Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Associate Member of Trading Staff
descriptionHtml:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.

Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.

The Trading Operations group at Voleon sits at the crossroads of finance and applied science, collaborating with research and other production staff to supervise and improve systematic trading strategies.  The team ensures that the outputs of our research efforts are successfully implemented in the real world.  Domains of contribution include algorithmic execution, securities lending, and market expertise across a variety of asset classes and markets. 

As an Associate Member of Trading Staff, you will rotate across our credit, equity, forex, and derivatives desks to learn each asset class and region we trade, and eventually assume ownership of our systematic trading programs.  You will directly interact with both internal stakeholders and the broker dealer community.  The collaboration and rotation amongst the team will enable you to become an expert in market microstructure and trading operations.  Under mentorship from senior traders, you will build analytics and automation that enhance the level of sophistication and scale at which the firmwide trading program operates. 

Responsibilities

  • Monitor high-volume execution algorithms and portfolio risk

  • Track real-time market developments

  • Interface with external brokers and trading counterparties

  • Contribute to the codebase underlying automated trading operations

  • Build processes and technology to prevent errors or outages while increasing team capacity

  • Provide insight and expertise to the research and development staff

  • Work global market hours for a portion of every year on a rotational basis

Requirements

  • Demonstrated passion for markets

  • Proficiency in a programming language like Python or R

  • Experience using a Unix-like OS

  • Academic or practical familiarity with statistics

  • A skillset in data analysis and visualization

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or quantitative discipline

  • Attention to detail and clarity of thought

title: Automation, IT Systems & Security Specialist (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Automation, IT Systems & Security Specialist(m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

In this key role, you act as the architect and guardian of our internal IT infrastructure. Your focus is not on maintaining the status quo, but on building a highly secure, automated, and scalable system landscape. You eliminate manual effort through intelligent IT automation and ensure that our network and security architecture keeps pace with our global growth.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and implementation of a secure, cloud-aligned IT and network landscape (e.g. AWS, Zero Trust principles)

  • Ensuring highest standards in Identity & Access Management (IAM), SSO, and secrets management

  • Protection of endpoints and continuous monitoring of system integrity across all teams

  • Identification and automation of repetitive IT processes (e.g. automated onboarding/offboarding, asset management)

  • Selection and integration of tools that connect and streamline internal workflows across Finance, HR, and Engineering

  • Active use of modern automation tools, including AI-supported solutions, to sustainably reduce manual support effort

  • Ownership of global device and lifecycle management, including rollout processes

  • Acting as a technical lead for complex first- and second-level support topics

  • Close collaboration with Engineering and Cloud teams on infrastructure, security, and automation topics

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Computer Science, IT Systems, Security or a comparable field

  • Several years of experience in system administration, network architecture, or IT security in cloud environments

  • Strong ownership mindset: you take responsibility, proactively identify gaps, and close them independently

  • A strong automation mindset: you are driven by the principle of not doing things twice manually and actively use scripting or tools to improve processes

  • Deep understanding of cloud architectures, modern identity models, and network security concepts

  • A structured and pragmatic working style, combined with a strong ownership mindset and focus on scalable systems

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus)

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Builder
descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

 

What a week can look like

  • A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy

  • A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning

  • Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets

Who we're looking for

Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else.

  • You've built something people used and owned the outcome: as a founder, in a fast-growing product team, or with a side project that you launched.

  • You have commercial sense and product taste. Agency and taste are the main differentiators in today's AGI age.

  • You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default and you've made something real with them that wouldn't exist otherwise.

  • You have strong technical intuition: you reason about data and systems rather than getting caught up in the details of code.

  • You're comfortable in front of industrial customers. You are fluent in German; English is strong plus.

  • You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

  • Early in your career? Great. We love to bet on people with a steep learning curve.

 

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

  3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

title: CASS Oversight Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted.

  • Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way.

  • Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed.

  • Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion.

  • Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change.

  • Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design.

  • Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest.

  • Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights.

What you bring:

  • Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates.

  • Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits.

  • Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks.

  • Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines.

It’s great if you have:

  • Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages.

Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et le L&D pour analyser les besoins, segmenter les publics et cartographier un workflow.Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation.Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité.Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert.Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Suivre l'adoption et la valeur du use case, les compétences acquises, la capacité à répliquer et les premiers usages; proposer des ajustements concrets pour améliorer l'activation.Contribuer à l’analyse des freins et au plan de change du programme, sous la responsabilité du chef de mission.Identifier les dépendances SI, les risques sécurité et le besoin d'escalade vers la DSI ou AI Engineering.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

  • 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une première expérience de pilotage d’un stream ou d’une mission et de coaching de consultants juniors.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une bonne maîtrise de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding).
  • Une aisance dans la conception et l’animation d’expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, d’ateliers collaboratifs et de dispositifs de montée en compétences par la pratique.
  • Une capacité à comprendre les enjeux et processus métier, à embarquer les parties prenantes et à accompagner la transformation des tâches, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.
  • Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA).

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering).Un rôle avec de l’autonomie et des perspectives
Piloter des streams, développer une expertise, faire grandir une équipe et contribuer au développement de l’activité.Un parcours clair de progression

Un accompagnement concret : counsellor, parcours de formation et programme de leadership.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager
  3. Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un Manager
  4. Un role play AI Adoption Senior (45 / 60’) avec Directeur
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program.

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems.

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.


Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated.

Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics.

Starting dates: Fall 2026

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
department: LIRIS - Laboratoire d'Informatique en Image et Systèmes d'Information
descriptionHtml:
Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire

Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions.

Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos.

Présentation de la thématique :

Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments.

Description de la mission

La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable.

Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée.

Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments.

Le planning envisagé est le suivant :

Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12)

• Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts).

• Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes.

• Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM).

Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5)

• Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades.

• Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes.

Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9)

• Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets).

• Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage.

Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16)

• Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux).

• Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées.

Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18)

• Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM.

• Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs).

• Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation.


Profil recherché / Compétences attendues

Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique

Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond

Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale

Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en deux étapes, supervisé par une commission de recrutement, en conformité avec la politique OTMR de Centrale Lyon.

· Étude du dossier écrit : CV + lettre de motivation + diplôme de doctorat

· Entretien de sélection : en présentiel ou en visioconférence

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.
