About ALAIKA

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory.

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply.

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else.
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity.
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that.

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies. 

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck.

Join the movement — apply now.

The role and what you will work on

  • Own. Own the finance function end-to-end. Accounting, controlling, reporting, tax, and the annual financial statements — and the judgment behind them. The numbers are yours: accurate, on time, founder-ready, and built to help the business decide.
  • Lead. Build the finance team from the ground up. Hire, steer, develop. Multiply the output of everyone in it, not just your own.
  • Build. We're scaling fast, and the finance backbone has to scale with us: systems, processes, controls, forecasting. Build a genuinely automated operation, not a manual one held together by effort. You don't inherit a finished machine — you build it.
  • Steer. Own the forward view: planning, budgeting, forecasting. Track cash, runway, and burn. You see what's coming and steer for it.
  • People. Own the systems that pay and grow the team: compensation, bonus structures, performance reviews, the people operation behind them. In a firm that hires the best, how you reward them is a competitive weapon. You build it, you make it work.
  • Govern. Own risk, compliance, and controls as the firm scales across borders. Own the external relationships that come with them: auditors, tax advisors, banks, authorities.
  • Expand. The role scales with the firm. New deals, new business units, new ground — you grow with it, and the finance backbone becomes the platform the whole firm builds on

What you bring

  • Background: Strong degree in finance, business, or a comparably analytical field. A professional qualification (Steuerberater, ACCA, CPA) or an audit background is a plus. A track record that speaks for itself matters more.

title: Chief Investment Officer (CIO)
descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading companies in Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), SkyNRG is developing and advancing projects, partnerships and commercial opportunities that will play a critical role in the decarbonization of aviation.

As our portfolio grows in scale and complexity, we are looking to further strengthen our investment capabilities, combining strategic thinking, commercial insight and disciplined decision-making to accelerate value creation across the business. To support this next stage of growth, we are seeking a Chief Investment Officer.

Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Executive Committee, Board and shareholders, the CIO will play a central role in shaping the future direction of SkyNRG. This executive will bring an institutional investor mindset to the organization, strengthening how opportunities are evaluated, prioritized and executed while ensuring that capital is deployed toward initiatives that create sustainable strategic and financial value.

The Opportunity

The Chief Investment Officer will be responsible for leading SkyNRG's Investment Management capability and driving value creation across the business.

Working closely with the Executive Committee, Board and shareholders, the CIO will help shape the strategic direction of SkyNRG by ensuring investment decisions, capital allocation and growth initiatives are aligned with long-term value creation.

This role combines the analytical rigor of an investment professional with the strategic perspective of a business leader. It offers the opportunity to influence some of the most significant decisions facing the company while contributing directly to the development of projects and partnerships that support the future of sustainable aviation.

Your Role

As Chief Investment Officer, you will be responsible for strengthening investment decision-making and value creation across SkyNRG.

You will:

  • Lead SkyNRG's Investment Management capability and establish the frameworks, governance and standards that support disciplined decision-making.

  • Further improve SkyNRG’s investment strategy, building on 17 years of SAF experience, network and track record, and the company’s overall strategic plans

  • Drive the evaluation and prioritization of major investments, strategic partnerships and growth opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Bring an institutional investor mindset into the organization, fostering collaboration across teams and ensuring opportunities are assessed through the lens of strategic fit, risk-adjusted returns and long-term value creation.

  • Provide leadership to Corporate Development and Project Commercial activities, building high-performing teams and fostering a collaborative, results-driven culture that aligns strategic ambitions, commercial execution and investment outcomes.

  • Support the development of bankable, financeable and commercially attractive SAF projects.

  • Lead selected M&A, partnership and corporate development opportunities that contribute to SkyNRG's long-term growth strategy.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Executive Committee, Board and shareholders on investment strategy, capital allocation and portfolio prioritization.

Key Areas of Impact

Investment Strategy

You will provide leadership on how capital is allocated across SkyNRG's portfolio, ensuring resources are directed toward opportunities with the greatest strategic and commercial potential.

You will oversee investment evaluations, valuation methodologies, business case development and portfolio prioritization to support informed decision-making at Executive Committee and Board level.

Portfolio Development

You will help maximize value across SkyNRG's portfolio by strengthening investment discipline throughout the project lifecycle.

From opportunity identification through commercial structuring and execution, you will ensure investment decisions are supported by robust analysis, clear governance and a strong understanding of risk and value drivers.

Partnerships

Growth opportunities are expected to come from a combination of project development, strategic partnerships and selective corporate development initiatives.

You will play a leading role in identifying, assessing and executing opportunities that enhance SkyNRG's position within the sustainable aviation ecosystem and support the company's long-term ambitions.

Organizational Leadership

You will collaborate closely with teams across Projects, Commercial, Finance, Legal and Strategy to strengthen how investment opportunities are evaluated and executed.

By embedding a common investment framework across the business, you will increase transparency, improve decision quality and support a culture focused on value creation and accountability.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative leader with a strong track record in investment, infrastructure, energy or related capital-intensive industries. You are able to build trust across diverse stakeholder groups and bring people together around complex decisions.

You combine strategic thinking with strong commercial judgment and have experience evaluating complex investment opportunities in capital-intensive environments.

You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, engaging with boards and shareholders and navigating situations where commercial, financial and strategic considerations intersect.

You bring:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in infrastructure, energy transition, project finance, private equity, corporate development or investment management.

  • A proven track record of evaluating and executing complex investment opportunities.

  • Deep expertise in valuation, financial analysis, capital allocation and investment decision-making.

  • Experience working with executive teams, Boards and institutional investors.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • The ability to balance strategic vision with pragmatic execution.

  • A genuine interest in accelerating the transition toward more sustainable aviation.

We recognize that exceptional candidates may not meet every listed requirement. If you are excited about the opportunity to shape the future of sustainable aviation and believe your experience can contribute to our ambitions, we encourage you to apply.

Location & International Exposure

Based at SkyNRG's Amsterdam headquarters, this role offers the opportunity to work across an international network of partners, investors and project stakeholders that are helping shape the future of sustainable aviation.

We offer a flexible hybrid working model, recognizing that impactful leadership can be delivered through a combination of in-person collaboration, stakeholder engagement and remote working.

Why join SkyNRG

This is an opportunity to play a defining role in one of the most dynamic and ambitious companies operating within the sustainable aviation sector.

As Chief Investment Officer, you will influence investment decisions that shape the future of the company, contribute to the development of large-scale SAF projects and help create long-term value for shareholders, partners and the aviation industry as a whole.

You will join an entrepreneurial and mission-driven organization where commercial success and sustainable impact go hand in hand, and where your decisions will directly influence the growth trajectory of both the business and the broader SAF ecosystem.

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Chief Strategic Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We are seeking a visionary Regional Chief Strategic Architect to serve as Workato's technical authority and strategic advisor to our most critical prospects, customers, and the broader market within their assigned region. The Chief Strategic Architect operates at the nexus of technical credibility, executive influence, and market thought leadership, acting as the external-facing voice of Workato's innovation and technical vision.

This is not a sales role. It is a strategic, hybrid operator-advisor-influencer position. Chief Strategic Architects act as extensions of the executive team in the field, elevating conversations with senior leaders and positioning Workato as the essential platform for enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation.

This role is accountable for building technical trust across the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through strategic expansion - while simultaneously shaping how the market understands enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation. The Chief Strategic Architect influences deal outcomes, product direction, and industry perception, ensuring Workato is recognized as the definitive leader in Enterprise Orchestration.

First 90 Days

Learn & Align (Days 0-30)

  • Deep immersion into Workato's AI vision, product roadmap, and GTM strategy

  • Shadow at least 10 executive customer conversations

  • Develop initial point of view for engagement with CIO/CTO/CDO personas

Engage & Formulate (Days 30-60)

  • Lead first strategic engagements with enterprise accounts

  • Establish feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams

Influence & Scale (Days 60-90)

  • Cultivate trusted relationships with C-level executives in 5+ strategic accounts

  • Co-create first AI-driven integration use cases with customers

  • Establish thought leadership presence through content and speaking opportunities

Technical Trust & Executive Relationships

  • Engage directly with C-level executives (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers) at enterprise accounts to shape integration strategies that solve complex business challenges

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through expansion - providing strategic guidance rooted in real-world operator experience

  • Build lasting peer-to-peer relationships that position you as the go-to expert on enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and automation at scale

  • Act as technical closer in competitive deals, articulating why Workato's architecture differentiates us from competitors like MuleSoft and Boomi

  • Influence enterprise architecture decisions and multi-year technology strategies at the executive level

AI, Agentic Automation & Enterprise MCP Strategy

  • Shape and guide customers' AI and agentic automation journeys, leveraging Workato's AI capabilities and ecosystem

  • Advise on the design and adoption of agent-based workflows, human-in-the-loop models, and decision automation frameworks

  • Partner with customer executives to define enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) strategies including context management, secure AI orchestration, and governance

  • Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable enterprise use cases that drive measurable business outcomes

  • Position Workato as the integration and orchestration backbone for enterprise AI transformation

Domain Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Establish yourself as the recognized authority across iPaaS, API Management (APIM), data orchestration, EDI, and AI/Agentic automation

  • Lead "Art of the Possible" workshops that fundamentally shift how customers think about enterprise integration and intelligent automation

  • Represent Workato at industry conferences, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings, and partner events

  • Create high-impact thought leadership content: blogs, white papers, webinars, reference architectures, and technical videos

  • Shape industry narratives and best practices that establish Workato as the category leader

Deal Acceleration & Commercial Impact

  • Accelerate deal velocity through technical validation, competitive differentiation, and executive trust-building

  • Identify and shape strategic expansion opportunities by uncovering automation, integration, and AI-driven transformation initiatives

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership on account strategy, competitive positioning, and C-level engagement tactics

  • Articulate compelling ROI narratives and business case frameworks that accelerate buying decisions

  • Demonstrate measurable impact on win rates, deal size, and sales cycle length in strategic opportunities

Strategic Advisory & Technical Leadership

  • Lead high-impact customer engagements requiring executive-level judgment, architectural vision, and industry expertise

  • Guide prospects and customers through Enterprise Orchestration vision and roadmap development

  • Develop prioritization frameworks for integration, automation, and AI use cases

  • Lead technology evaluation and vendor selection processes with enterprise customers

  • Design governance, scalability, and enterprise operating models for automation initiatives

Product Influence & Market Intelligence

  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering teams, channeling field insights into actionable roadmap input

  • Identify capability gaps, competitive threats, and market opportunities based on executive-level customer conversations

  • Develop and refine competitive positioning, objection handling, and differentiation strategies

  • Define reusable patterns, reference architectures, and technical frameworks that accelerate customer success

  • Influence industry analysts and thought leaders to strengthen Workato's market position

Internal Enablement & Team Development

  • Educate and enable Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and Customer Success teams on complex technical capabilities and emerging trends

  • Develop strategic frameworks, competitive positioning, and executive engagement playbooks for enterprise accounts

  • Mentor technical team members, helping them develop deeper domain expertise and executive engagement skills

  • Create scalable technical enablement content and programs that amplify your expertise across the field organization

  • Drive customer reference creation and participation in case studies, speaking opportunities, and advisory boards

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 20+ years of technology transformation experience, including integration, middleware, or API management platforms

  • 15+ years in an Enterprise Architect, CTO, VP Engineering, or similar senior architecture/leadership role

  • Demonstrated experience advising C-level executives on technology strategy and enterprise transformation

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, governance, and operating models

  • Proven track record of driving platform expansion and value realization in enterprise accounts

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including board-level presentations and strategic documentation

  • Ability to operate independently in complex, ambiguous environments and take ownership of outcomes

  • Travel to client sites up to 50%, with flexibility based on regional needs

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or related field

  • Deep knowledge of key enterprise applications: Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle

  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and GCP

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms and agentic automation frameworks

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

  • Established personal brand and thought leadership presence in the integration/automation space

Measures of Success

Long-term success for this leader will be measured by their ability to:

  • Embed Workato at the heart of technology strategy conversations across the region's most influential enterprises

  • Cultivate sustained engagement with senior technology and engineering leaders ensuring Workato becomes synonymous with Enterprise Orchestration and AI orchestration

  • Create a robust pipeline of seven-figure opportunities tied to transformation initiatives

title: Commercial Associate
descriptionHtml:
🏷️ Title: Commercial Associate

👫 Department: Found, Commercial. Reporting to the Head of Commercial, Found

💰 Salary: OTE £75,000 - £105,000 (£50,000 - £70,000 base) + equity

🎁 Benefits & Culture: See here

📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering

🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays

💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future

💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week

🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK

 

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

We're launching Found for Specialist Care, a brand new vertical alongside Care Home and Home Care, and we're hiring our first Commercial Associate to build it from the ground up. There's no playbook, no team and no set way of doing things yet. You'll write them.

Sales is at the heart of the role. You'll be the one opening doors, running demos and closing providers. But you'll also sit at the intersection of Commercial, Product and Customer Success: working out what this market needs, shaping how we talk about Found, and making sure what you hear from providers shapes what we build next.

We have a head start: 7-8 specialist care providers already use Found, plus a pipeline we previously turned away. You'll work closely with Tom Frost, our Head of Commercial, with direct access to product and our founder. If you want to build something from nothing and stretch well beyond a typical sales role, this is it!

 

💻 What does this role involve?

  • Sell: own conversations with specialist care and supported living providers from first call to demo to close, against MRR targets with uncapped commission on ARR closed

  • Build pipeline: prospect through calls, emails, LinkedIn and events, re-engage providers we've spoken to before, and grow our existing customers

  • Build the go-to-market: test messaging, learn what lands and turn it into a repeatable playbook others can follow

  • Be the voice of the market: bring provider insight back to Product and Engineering and help shape the roadmap for Found for Specialist Care

  • Connect the dots: work across Commercial, Product, Marketing and Customer Success so providers get a joined-up experience from first call to onboarding

💪 What problems will you be solving?

  • Taking a vertical from a handful of customers to a real, repeatable revenue line

  • Understanding a largely local-authority-funded world, where buying decisions and ROI look different to private-pay care

  • Selling honestly while the product is still evolving, and turning feedback into what we build next

  • Working out what to build, sell and say first, with no blueprint to copy

👀 We think you’ll be a great fit if…

  • You have a strong sales spike. You're confident on the phone, love outbound and have a track record of hitting targets in a B2B commercial role

  • You're a natural generalist. You're as happy digging into a market, writing messaging or giving product feedback as you are closing a deal

  • You've built something from scratch before, such as a new territory, product line, process, society or side project, and you enjoy the ambiguity

  • You work well across teams and can translate between providers, product and engineering

  • You build genuine relationships: empathetic and consultative rather than "salesy"

  • You explain value in plain language to people who aren't always tech-savvy

  • You're motivated by targets and commission, and want to own this vertical for at least 12 months

  • Bonus: startup experience, B2B SaaS, or exposure to regulated or publicly funded sectors. Care sector experience is not required

Sound like you but not quite 100%? Apply anyway. We're looking for potential and passion, not a perfect CV match.

  

💔 This role isn’t for you if…

  • You want an established playbook, a structured process and constant guidance

  • You want to focus purely on closing and aren't interested in the wider commercial and product picture

  • You're not comfortable with outbound prospecting

  • You're looking for a stepping stone and want to move into something different in 6 months

 

💻Application

We'd love to see a short video (2-3 minutes) answering this question:

Introduce yourself, tell us why you’re interested in Lottie and what makes you a good fit for this role.

We appreciate this takes time. We receive a high volume of applications and this helps us assess you on more than your CV.

🔢 Lottie’s Interview Process

  1. First Interview with Lottie's Talent Acquisition Lead - 20 mins (remote)

  2. Case Study with Tom Frost (Head of Commercial, Found) and a member of the Commercial team - 1h presentation with additional pre-work (remote)

  3. Final interviews with Will Donnelly (Lottie's Co-Founder & CEO) and Tom Frost (Head of Commercial, Found), 1h30 total (in-person)

🤩 Candidate Experience:

  • Pre-Screen & First Interview: You'll receive an email notification, but no specific feedback will be provided at this stage.

  • Case Study: If you are not successful after the assessment, you'll receive constructive feedback via email and be offered a debrief call with our Talent Lead.

  • Final Interview: For final-stage candidates who are not offered the role, we will provide your feedback live via a phone call.

🚀 Meet Lottie

Founded with a mission to build the care sector of the future, Lottie is creating the AI operating system for social care - designed to unlock profitability for care providers and to make finding care as easy as booking a holiday on Airbnb.

Launched in London in July 2021, Lottie has raised over £25m from tier 1 venture capital funds (Accel and General Catalyst) and is widely recognised as one of Europe's fastest growing tech companies. Most recently, Lottie was the acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50, LinkedIn Top Startups, The Sunday Times Tech 2026 and Startups 100.

As of today, Lottie offers three core products:

  • Lottie (B2B2C Marketplace) - Free service that helps families find the UK’s best care homes and home care services.

  • Found by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - AI-native OS software supporting care providers to effectively manage their enquiries, occupancy and finances. Eliza by Found is our newest Found module. AI agents that handle care home enquiries - so no family goes unanswered. Launch video here.

  • Seniorcare by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - Employee benefit helping companies deliver outstanding eldercare support to their employees.

🤩 Why Lottie?

  • Career Opportunity - Build a new revenue vertical from nothing, as a commercial all-rounder working across Sales, Product and leadership from day one.

  • Early Hire Benefits - Be an early hire at one of the UK’s fastest growing startups and benefit from fast career progression, as well as a generous stock options package.

  • Mission - Tech for good that aims to build the care industry of the future and to positively impact millions of people's lives. Care is one of the final remaining large consumer industries that is yet to be disrupted and positively revolutionised by technology.

  • Investors - Series A backed startup having raised £25m+ from tier 1 venture capital investors including Accel and General Catalyst.

  • Global Opportunity & Scalability - Be part of a company that is solving a real tangible problem that every family around the world faces at some point in their life.

  • People - Join a kind, talented and mission driven team that loves coming to work every day.

  • Culture - Excellent employee compensation/benefits, hybrid office policy and outstanding company culture with a 5/5 employee review score on Glassdoor.

  • Award Winning - Acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50, LinkedIn’s “Top Startups”,theStartup.co.uk 100 Indexand most recently 20th in The Sunday Times 100 Tech 2026.

We want to create an inclusive environment that celebrates the diversity of our people whilst enabling them to do the best work of their careers. We are committed to ensuring that all our people processes are equitable. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status. title: Consulting director
descriptionHtml:
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that. We help brands turn fulfillment into a competitive advantage: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience. Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 8 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, greener — and more cost-efficient. Backed by $20M+ in funding, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward bold enterprise expansion. To deliver on this ambition, we are looking for a leader who will drive operational excellence and innovation at scale. The role: Consulting director Merchants often need more guidance than our product alone can provide. They struggle with optimizing delivery options, managing customer support or demand planning and streamlining other operational processes. While our product addresses part of this need, merchants require structured, expert advice to grow and optimize their business. That’s why we’re launching a new Professional Services program — to help brands unlock the full potential of Bigblue Operations. As Fulfillment Strategy & Operations Lead, you will build and lead this new function from the ground up: designing offers, structuring delivery, and ensuring execution at scale. Your mission is to sell (and sometimes offer) operational consulting, providing tailored support across logistics, transport, and commerce operations — while capturing and distributing the knowledge that will shape internal training, product development, and merchant strategy. This is a cross-functional leadership role, reporting directly to the co-CEOs, with strong exposure to sales, merchants, product and ops teams, and the executive leadership. What you’ll do 📦 Design and launch Bigblue’s Professional Services program: define the service offering, pricing models, and delivery frameworks for operational consulting. 🧠 Deliver structured, high-impact advice to merchants: help brands streamline their operations, unlock growth, and make the most of Bigblue’s operational capabilities. 📊 Create and track performance metrics: define success KPIs — including merchant satisfaction, project ROI, and delivery timelines — and build the tools and processes to monitor and improve them. 📚 Generate and structure company knowledge: turn field experience into scalable insights that fuel internal training, merchant enablement, and product roadmap decisions. 🤝 Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Ops, and Customer teams: scope merchant needs, influence product direction, and ensure Professional Services are tightly integrated into the overall customer journey. 🧩 Handle both repeatable and bespoke projects: from standardized onboarding packages to tailored merchant migrations, flex between industrialized delivery and custom-built solutions. 💸 Make Professional Services a profitable growth engine: design revenue models, forecast team utilization, and ensure strong project economics while delivering value to merchants.
Who you are
  • You have 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, or implementation at a high-growth scale-up, logistics player, eCom or SaaS company.
  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to turn complex needs into actionable plans.
  • You know how to balance execution, people management, and financial performance.
  • You are a builder — ready to design and scale processes from scratch, not just operate what exists.
  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, collaborating across product, ops, tech, and commercial teams.
  • You are both strategic and hands-on — comfortable driving the roadmap while jumping into project firefighting when needed.
  • Fluent in English and ideally French or Spanish.
    • Why join Bigblue? 💼 High-impact leadership role at the heart of Bigblue’s growth and customer success. 🚀 Fast-growing scale-up with a well-funded roadmap and bold ambitions. ⚙️ Room to build and innovate: create a PS function from the ground up. 🌍 Pan-European scope: support leading omnichannel brands across multiple markets. 🍱 10€ meal voucher per worked day (55% paid by Bigblue) 🧘‍♀️ ClassPass membership for fitness & wellness. 🖥️ MacBook or your preferred setup to do your best work. 🩺 100% health insurance coverage with Benefiz. 💙 Founders-led company where operations are truly core to the mission. Regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, origin, disability, age… At Bigblue, we create equal opportunities for all and make our culture as inclusive as possible. Because we believe that challenging assumptions and embracing diversity in experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. Because what we value first and foremost are curiosity and growth-driven minds. So, regardless of who you are and how many “boxes” you tick on the job description, if you have the energy and passion to help shape Bigblue’s entrepreneurial adventure, APPLY.

title: Consulting Manager - Financial Services / Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner in 4-5 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Specialisation. You are a generalist with shallow expertise and a thin network → AI will eat your lunch. We bet on depth. 
  • Ownership. You spot the problem and walk it to your boss → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now.
 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Take full ownership of significant client groups and stakeholder relationships. The work, the team, the relationships, the numbers. You do not own pieces; you own outcomes. 
  • Lead. Run workstreams and project teams. Set the bar for consultants and senior consultants — challenge them, develop them, raise their game. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Run and source proposals independently. Open new buying centers. Grow existing ones. Turn one engagement into three. At ALAIKA, business development is not a partner privilege — it is an expectation. 
  • Connect. Bring a network. Extend it. Lead peer and senior client discussions in your area of responsibility. Build trust deep enough that clients call youfirst. 
  • Grow. Become the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track within reach. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You do not just deliver client work; you co-build the firm. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. You move. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. Minimum 4 years in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data & AI experience required. An established network in Financial Services is expected at this level.  
  • Industry Focus. You have worked inside or deeply alongside financial services institutions. Sub-sector expertise in insurance preferred, but we would consider experience in banking, asset management, or payments as well.    
  • Leadership. You have led teams that delivered. We hire managers who build careers, not just project plans. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Four years from manager to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures. 
  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders + investors building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 

Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space

title: Content Creator – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Culinary Agency

Passionné(e) par la gastronomie, la création vidéo et les univers premium ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre créativité au service de belles maisons, de restaurants, d’hôtels et d’acteurs de la gastronomie ?

Chez Culinary Agency, nous accompagnons des établissements et des marques d’exception dans leur stratégie de communication et leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité et de notre portefeuille clients, nous recherchons un(e) Content Creator capable d’imaginer, de produire et de monter des contenus visuels de qualité, avec un véritable sens du détail et de l’esthétique.

Vos missions

En lien étroit avec les équipes de l’agence et en binôme avec un Content Creator Junior, vous serez au cœur de la production de contenus pour nos clients.

1. Organisation et préparation des tournages

  • Organiser et planifier les sessions de tournage chez nos clients.

  • Préparer les besoins en amont : idées de contenus, séquences, matériel et organisation logistique.

  • Veiller au bon déroulement des tournages et au respect des plannings.

2. Création de contenus vidéo

  • Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium.

  • Imaginer et produire des contenus adaptés aux codes des réseaux sociaux, notamment Instagram et les formats courts (Reels).

  • Mettre en valeur les lieux, les équipes, les produits, les gestes et les expériences à travers un regard créatif et soigné.

  • Être capable de produire un volume important de contenus tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.

  • Être présent(e) sur le terrain environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine pour réaliser les tournages chez nos clients.

3. Montage et post-production

  • Assurer le montage des vidéos et leur adaptation aux différents formats.

  • Sélectionner les meilleures séquences, travailler le rythme et soigner les détails visuels.

  • Organiser et suivre les étapes de montage, en garantissant le respect des délais et des attentes clients.

4. Suivi, coordination et relation client

  • Participer au suivi des stratégies de contenu définies pour les clients.

  • Travailler en binôme avec le Content Creator Junior et coordonner les différentes étapes de production.

  • Être force de proposition et contribuer à faire évoluer la qualité créative des contenus de l'agence.

  • Développer une relation de confiance avec les clients, en étant leur interlocuteur privilégié lors des tournages et en assurant un suivi de qualité.

  • Créer un lien humain fort avec les clients, comprendre leurs attentes et leurs univers, et savoir s'adapter à leurs personnalités.

  • Représenter l'agence auprès de clients et de personnalités de premier plan, parfois connues, et contribuer à construire des relations professionnelles durables.

La relation client est une dimension essentielle du poste : votre capacité à créer du lien, à instaurer la confiance et à faire vivre une expérience agréable à nos clients contribuera directement à la réussite des projets.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne créative, organisée, rigoureuse et à l'aise sur le terrain, capable de passer rapidement d'un univers client à un autre.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants :

  • Vous avez une expérience en création de contenu vidéo, tournage et montage.

  • Vous maîtrisez la captation vidéo, notamment avec un iPhone, et connaissez les codes des réseaux sociaux.

  • Vous possédez un véritable œil esthétique et savez identifier les images qui valorisent un lieu, un produit ou une expérience.

  • Vous êtes extrêmement organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs productions en parallèle.

  • Vous savez produire du contenu en volume sans sacrifier la qualité.

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel et êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'agence auprès de clients exigeants.

  • Vous aimez créer du lien, instaurer une relation de confiance et entretenir des relations professionnelles de qualité.

  • Vous soignez votre présentation et adoptez une attitude professionnelle en toutes circonstances.

  • Vous êtes polyvalent(e), autonome et capable de vous adapter à des environnements et des interlocuteurs variés.

Une expérience à l'international est un vrai plus, tout comme une sensibilité particulière aux univers de la gastronomie, de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, du luxe et de l'art de vivre.

Ce que nous proposons

  • Localisation : Paris, secteur Saint-Lazare et Paris-centre

  • Présence terrain : environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine chez nos clients pour les tournages.

  • Déplacements professionnels : environ 3 jours par mois, avec des nuitées à prévoir selon les tournages.

Vous rejoindrez une agence en plein développement, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez participer à des projets variés, rencontrer de belles maisons et contribuer directement à la qualité des productions.

Notre processus de recrutement

Nous souhaitons prendre le temps de découvrir votre parcours, votre personnalité et votre potentiel créatif.

  1. Premier échange en visioconférence : un entretien de préqualification pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos expériences et vos motivations.

  2. Mise en situation : si ce premier échange est concluant, nous vous proposerons un exercice pratique afin d'évaluer votre créativité, votre sens de l'image, votre maîtrise de la vidéo et votre capacité à produire du contenu.

  3. Vérification des références : nous pourrons échanger avec certaines de vos précédentes expériences professionnelles.

  4. Entretien final avec le CEO : une dernière rencontre pour échanger sur votre vision du poste et votre envie de rejoindre Culinary Agency.

Vous avez envie de mettre votre créativité au service de la gastronomie et de belles maisons ?

Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer et de vous accueillir dans notre brigade !

title: Content Creator Video & Social mit CEO-Fokus (all genders) B2B SaaS für KMU
descriptionHtml:
Buchhaltung ist für die meisten Gründerinnen und Gründer ein Blackbox-Posten: teuer, langsam, und am Ende weiß niemand genau, wofür er zahlt.
mika ändert das. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Buchhaltung, die Unternehmen selbst in die Hand nehmen können, ohne Steuerberater dazwischen. Belegerfassung, Klassifizierung, E-Rechnung, Validierung und Meldungen laufen automatisiert, statt im Monatsrhythmus über einen externen Schreibtisch zu wandern.
Wir sind 30 Personen, betreuen rund 900 Kunden und haben unsere Seed-Runde frisch abgeschlossen.

Worum es geht
Unsere CEO und Mitgründerin hat auf LinkedIn eine starke Personal Brand aufgebaut. Sie spricht auf Bühnen, co-hostet einen Podcast und ist eine der lauteren Stimmen zu Unternehmertum und KI. Jetzt soll das auch auf Instagram, TikTok und ggf. YouTube funktionieren, und zwar so, wie es auf diesen Kanälen funktioniert, nicht als Kopie von LinkedIn. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du produzierst Video- und Visual-Content für die Kanäle unserer CEO: Short-Form-Videos, Podcast-Schnipsel, Visuals

  • Du begleitest sie auf Veranstaltungen und machst dort Content: Talks, Backstage, Gespräche, Stimmung

  • Du baust ihre Kanäle auf Instagram, TikTok und ggf. YouTube aus, mit einer eigenen Logik für jeden Kanal

  • Du entscheidest mit, welche Inhalte über die CEO laufen und welche über mika

  • Du filmst, schneidest und schreibst selbst, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post

  • Du beobachtest Trends und reagierst schnell darauf, nicht erst drei Wochen später

  • Du produzierst auf Deutsch und auf Englisch

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast schon Kanäle aufgebaut, idealerweise für dich selbst oder für eine Gründerin oder einen Gründer, und kannst das mit Zahlen und Beispielen zeigen

  • Du weißt, warum ein Video auf TikTok anders funktioniert als auf Instagram oder YouTube, und baust Content entsprechend

  • Du filmst und schneidest sicher, mit dem Handy genauso wie mit der Kamera

  • Du schreibst gut, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch (min C1)

  • Du bist schnell, arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst keine Briefings für jeden Post

  • Du wohnst in Berlin oder ziehst her, denn ohne Präsenz vor Ort geht der Job nicht

  • Du reist gern und bist 1–4 Mal im Monat auf Events in Deutschland dabei

Was dich erwartet

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit der CEO und hast echten Einfluss darauf, wie sie und mika nach außen wirken

  • Du baust etwas auf: Du übernimmst keinen fertigen Redaktionsplan, du entwickelst die Kanäle selbst

  • Du bist auf Bühnen, Events und hinter den Kulissen eines schnell wachsenden KI-Startups dabei

  • Du hast viel Freiraum bei Formaten und Ideen, solange sie funktionieren

Bewerbung
Schick uns statt eines langen Anschreibens 3–5 Links zu Kanälen oder Videos, die du aufgebaut oder produziert hast, und schreib in zwei Sätzen dazu, was deine Rolle dabei war.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Creative Concept (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media mit, weißt wie Marken auf den Plattformen wirklich funktionieren und hast dabei immer die visuelle Weiterentwicklung im Blick. Wenn du genau weißt was wir meinen, dann lass uns reden.

Aufgaben

  • Konzepte, die tragen: Aus Briefing oder Content-Backlog entwickelst du eigenständig die Leitidee, das Format, die Storyline, den Hook – für die große Kampagne genauso wie für den laufenden Always-on-Content

  • Plattform-Gespür statt Copy-Paste: Du weißt, warum ein Cut auf TikTok anders sitzen muss als auf Instagram. Und merkst sofort, wenn eine Idee zu werblich, zu generisch oder zu kampagnig gedacht ist

  • Marke übersetzen, nicht behübschen: Du machst aus einer Marke socialfähige Kommunikation. Tonalität, Bildsprache, Mechanik, statt sie nur abzubilden

  • Briefings, die tragen: Du schreibst so klar, dass Produktion loslegen kann, ohne dreimal wegen der Grundidee nachzufragen

  • Präsentation statt Bauchgefühl: Du stellst deine Konzepte im Kundenteam und bei Kund:innen vor und verteidigst sie mit Argumenten, nicht mit Lautstärke. Und du denkst mit, was ein Dreh oder Content-Batch wirtschaftlich hergeben muss

  • Von der Idee zur Vorgabe: Mit wachsender Erfahrung gibst du zunehmend Kreativ-Richtung vor, statt alles selbst umzusetzen. Verantwortlich für das Ergebnis bleibst du trotzdem

  • Pitch-Bühne, je nach Erfahrung: Von Zuarbeit über einen eigenständigen Part bis zur vollen Verantwortung für kleinere Pitches

Qualifikation

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.
  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.
  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.
  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.
  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.
  • Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage
  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden
  • Direkter Impact: Deine Videos beeinflussen unmittelbar Reichweite, Leads und Umsätze unserer Kunden
  • Führung: Du führst ein eigenes Cutter-Team und prägst, wie bei uns Content entsteht
  • Wachstum: Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Personal Brands, Formaten und Zielgruppen und entwickelst dich als Creator und Führungskraft kontinuierlich weiter

Das bringst du mit:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer oder Head of Content, idealerweise mit Fokus auf YouTube-Longform, Shortform und Video-Ads
  • Ein Portfolio mit Videos, die du verantwortet hast, idealerweise mit messbaren Ergebnissen wie Views, Klickrate und Zuschauerbindung
  • Fundiertes Verständnis dafür, was ein Video viral macht: Hook, Titel, Thumbnail, Storytelling und Retention
  • Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten
  • Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen
  • Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey
  • Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL
  • Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht
  • Souveräne Kundenkommunikation: Du führst Weeklys und vertrittst deine Content-Entscheidungen auch gegenüber anspruchsvollen Unternehmern
  • Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen, sondern bringst eigene Ideen und Trends ein
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau
  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Podcast- und Event-Drehs sowie tiefes Technik-Verständnis (Kamera-Setups, Equipment, Workflows)

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du lieber schöne Bilder produzierst, statt Videos, die Reichweite und Nachfrage erzeugen
  • du nur schneiden willst und Ideen, Skripte und Strategie anderen überlässt
  • du dich auf Bauchgefühl verlässt und Klickrate, Retention und Views ignorierst
  • du Videos rausgibst, hinter denen du selbst nicht stehst
  • du Trends anderer kopierst, statt eigene Ideen und Formate zu entwickeln
  • du Feedback persönlich nimmst oder deinem Team kein klares Feedback geben willst
  • du lange an einem einzelnen Video feilst, aber Schwierigkeiten hast, im Volumen zu liefern
  • du Deadlines eher als Empfehlung siehst
  • du Kunden nicht klar sagen magst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert
  • dich klare Ziele, Zahlen und ein performanceorientiertes Umfeld eher abschrecken
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

Stellenanforderungen

title: Credit Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Primary analysis – Review new debt transactions in the high yield and leveraged loan market, ensuring we produce quick and insightful reports

  • Secondary analysis – With guidance from senior analysts, deep dive into high yield earnings reports, provide financial updates on specific credits, and produce market-leading predictive analysis and industry research

  • Relationship & product evangelism – Support clients, answer questions on our platform and provide insight. Gather feedback and work with the product team to develop the 9fin offering, taking the lead on new and exciting developments

About You

This role will be a great fit if you demonstrate:

  • A strong interest in financial markets, and a desire to learn about how they work

  • Strong communication and writing skills – Demonstrate clear and effective written and verbal communication, producing clean, timely, and accurate copy in a concise manner. Exhibit excellent attention to detail

  • Problem solving – Enjoy interpreting information and constructing effective solutions to complex problems. Be a team player, but also able to effectively work alone (although help is always on hand if you need)

  • Drive – Bring an inquisitive and passionate mindset, demonstrating a strong interest in the development and dynamics of financial (and especially) capital markets. A self-starter, you are up for the challenge of a role that will morph and transform as we continue to grow

We’re open to candidates from a range of backgrounds – if you’re curious, analytical, and enjoy working with financial data, we’d love to hear from you!

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive salary benchmarked at 75-90th% of market

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Customer Delivery Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure? Customer Delivery Engineers (CDEs) own the end-to-end deployment and execution of customer satellite missions at Loft. We serve as the primary technical interface to our customers and translate mission objectives into operational reality, from early requirements and ConOps development through commissioning, on-orbit operations, and continuous improvement. CDEs operate real spacecraft and work directly with customers to build mission applications on top of Loft’s API and operational infrastructure. You will translate mission objectives into executable workflows, configurations, and tooling that ensure reliable, scalable on-orbit execution. You will sit at the intersection of satellite operations, customer engineering, software development, systems engineering, and program execution, delivering meaningful outcomes for every mission you support.
About this role:
  • Serve as the primary technical interface for customer missions, aligning on objectives, managing expectations, and ensuring mission success
  • Own the full mission lifecycle, from requirements definition and ConOps design through launch, commissioning, on-orbit execution, anomaly triage, and long-term optimization
  • Operate Loft spacecraft and payloads on orbit, driving mission execution, anomaly resolution, and performance optimization across the fleet
  • Work directly with customers to design and implement mission applications on Loft’s API and operational framework, enabling effective and scalable on-orbit operations
  • Develop mission tooling and automation in Python to improve reliability, adoption, and operational scale
  • Translate operational experience and customer feedback into concrete product improvements and roadmap input

    • Must haves:
  • 3+ years of experience in an operational engineering environment, such as satellite operations, forward deployed engineering, production infrastructure, backend or platform engineering for live products, or other mission-critical systems
  • Experience with satellite operations, spacecraft commissioning, or AIT
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to production systems operating in real-world, mission-critical environments
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving issues in complex, multi-layered systems by tracing failures across interfaces and dependencies
  • Strong Python scripting skills and comfort building automation for operational systems
  • Experience working across software systems, APIs, and infrastructure such as Docker or similar DevOps environments
  • Ability to operate effectively in dynamic, high-pressure environments where requirements evolve and real-time decisions matter
  • Strong communication skills and experience working directly with customers or cross-functional stakeholders

    • Nice to haves:
  • Experience with spacecraft subsystems such as guidance and control, power systems, or communications systems
  • Experience integrating external systems into larger operational architectures
  • Experience with configuration languages such as CUE
  • Experience operating within a full product lifecycle, translating real-world usage and feedback into system or tooling improvements
  • Experience working with international or cross-cultural teams

    • Some of our awesome benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

The BMZ Group specialises in innovative, bespoke battery systems and energy storage solutions. Drawing on our technological expertise, international collaboration and a clear focus on our customers, we develop high-performance, cost-effective and sustainable solutions for the energy supply of tomorrow.

What sets us apart? We take responsibility, think entrepreneurially and are constantly evolving.

As Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d), you will be the key internal liaison between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality and Production. You will coordinate our products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle, reconcile technical and commercial requirements, and ensure that customer requirements are translated into successful solutions through collaborative effort.

Your responsibilities

  • Centralised internal coordination of bespoke products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle – from requirements definition through development and industrialisation to series production support

  • Coordination and management of internal interfaces between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Production and other relevant departments

  • Ensuring the cross-departmental implementation of customer requirements, taking into account technical feasibility, cost-effectiveness, quality and adherence to deadlines

  • Supporting development processes, product changes, industrialisation and the start of series production, as well as tracking agreed measures

  • Early identification and assessment of technical, economic and organisational risks, and coordination of appropriate countermeasures

  • Transparent presentation of project and product status, decision-making requirements and relevant information for Sales, segment management and the relevant specialist departments

Your Profile

Education & Qualifications

  • A degree in engineering or industrial engineering, or a comparable qualification

  • Several years’ experience in technical project management, product management or a comparable cross-functional coordination role

  • A broad technical understanding of industrial products, ideally battery systems, including development, electronics, quality and manufacturing processes

  • In-depth knowledge of industrial product life cycles, as well as the technical and economic interrelationships between development, industrialisation and series production

Personality & Methodological Skills

  • Customer Focus: The ability to understand customer requirements conveyed by the sales team and to consistently align their internal implementation with the best possible customer solution

  • Ownership & Responsibility: A strong sense of responsibility, an entrepreneurial mindset and consistent follow-up on cross-functional tasks and results

  • Trust & Teamwork: Strong communication, facilitation and coordination skills to bring different specialist departments together constructively

  • Performance & Execution: A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach to work, with strong implementation skills and the ability to confidently manage complex technical and organisational interfaces

Your benefits

You will have access to career training, mentoring sessions, and flexible working hours. We provide a company pension plan, private pension options, a company car, a company cellphone, and a company laptop. Additional perks include employee discounts, free parking, and the option to bring pets to the workplace, along with 28 vacation days per year.

Your first months at BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

From day one, you will coordinate internal teams to turn customer requirements into successful battery solutions. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Quality and Production, you will ensure smooth collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. If you combine technical understanding, ownership and a strong customer focus, we encourage you to apply.

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.

Gäste scannen einen QR-Code oder tippen am Self-Order-Terminal, bestellen selbst und zahlen direkt – die Bestellung landet ohne Umweg in der Kasse und auf dem Küchendisplay. Dazu kommen Webshop, Tablet-Bestellung und die Anbindung von Lieferdiensten wie Lieferando, Wolt und Uber Eats.   • Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden aktiv, vor allem am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls, und suchst den Kontakt, bevor Probleme entstehen.

Payflows is building the AI-native Finance OS for enterprise — connecting every process, person, and system so work just flows. Approvals route automatically, payments execute intelligently, and leaders gain real-time visibility into how, when, and why payments are made.

In a world where speed, control, and intelligence define competitive advantage, Payflows enables global enterprises to operate with precision — powered by AI.

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own relationships with enterprise finance teams — helping CFOs, Treasurers, and Procurement leaders achieve measurable results. You’ll drive adoption, unlock value, and identify opportunities to grow Payflows’ footprint within each account.

This is a role for someone who combines strategic thinking, relationship mastery, and commercial acumen — someone who thrives on impact, influence, and excellence.

Drive Adoption and Value

  • Partner with customers to deeply understand their objectives and translate them into success plans.

Build and Strengthen Relationships

Retain and Expand Accounts
