title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
descriptionHtml:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

  • Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

  • Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

  • Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

  • Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

  • Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

  • Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz.

  • Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

  • A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

  • If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

title: Head of Information Security
descriptionHtml:
💰 £100k-£120k

📍 Salary based on London. Other locations may vary.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. As we grow into payments infrastructure, new verticals and AI tools that work with sensitive data, security has to grow with us.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Head of Security to own security across Fanvue. This is a head-of role, not a CISO. Our technical foundations are in place, built and run by our technical security lead. What we need is someone who owns the decisions around them: who has access to what, which third parties we trust, and whether security gets the focus it needs. You'll set the security roadmap, direct our technical security lead's priorities, and build the team as the function grows.

You'll sit in Operations and work closely with engineering, the People team and every department head. You'll be the person who says "this matters, this needs time" and makes sure it happens.

Access and governance

  • Build the joiner, mover and leaver process with the People team so access follows the org chart

  • Write our security policies and run regular access reviews across every department

  • Work with our technical security lead to turn access decisions into controls

Third parties and certification

  • Approve vendors, tools and AI apps before they touch our data, and keep a live third-party register

  • Run security due diligence on payment and platform partners

  • Lead our path to SOC 2 and ISO 27001, from gap assessment to choosing tooling

Risk and culture

  • Own the security risk register and report on it to the exec team

  • Own the response to security incidents. Engineering incidents and on-call stay with the engineering team

  • Run security awareness across the company, from phishing to safe credential sharing

Roadmap and team

  • Set the security roadmap and direct the priorities of our technical security lead

  • Build the security team as the function grows

  • 30 days: handover with our technical security lead and the Ops and People teams. Take over day-to-day security management of our core tools, including Google Workspace, Okta and 1Password

  • 3 months: review access across every role and team in the business and rework it where it needs to change

  • 6 months: the security roadmap and risk register are live and reported on to the exec team, and the function is yours

👀 Who You Are

  • You've owned security at head-of level, with a strong track record to show for it

  • Strong on governance, access management and process, and credible enough with engineers to coordinate technical work

  • Comfortable pushing priorities across departments until they're done

  • Pragmatic. You keep controls tight without slowing the business down

  • A clear communicator who explains risk to non-technical teams and to execs

  • Payments, fintech or high-risk platform experience is a strong plus

  • SOC 2 or ISO 27001 delivery experience is a strong plus

  • AI-forward, you use AI tools in your own workflow

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to own security, not advise on it

  • You see controls as a reason to slow the business down

  • You need an established security programme in place before you can be effective

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Real ownership: you'll be the dedicated owner of security operations and governance, with a direct line to the exec team

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • A benefits package we're actively building out, including gym memberships and apps

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

The Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Head of Operations to drive day-to-day operational performance and execution excellence across 1st Formations and its associated business lines.

The Head of Operations is responsible for driving operational performance, alignment, and execution across 1st Formations' customer-facing operations and associated service lines. This role provides operational leadership across customer sales, retention, customer service, mail, company secretarial (Co Sec), and the serviced offices/business centre, ensuring the company's vision is translated into scalable, efficient, and commercially successful outcomes.

The Head of Operations will lead the integration and optimisation of these service lines and functions, ensuring consistent performance, operational resilience, and the delivery of the company's commercial objectives.

Working in close partnership with the CEO, the Head of Operations will play a key role in translating strategic priorities into practical plans, ensuring disciplined execution, sustainable growth, and measurable performance across every function it owns. This is a hands-on leadership role; the Head of Operations sets the strategic direction for their functions but remains close to the day-to-day detail, working alongside function managers and front-line teams to ensure execution matches ambition. This is an office-based role, five days a week, at our head office in Covent Garden, London.

Key Responsibilities

· Own the operating strategy and day-to-day performance across customer sales, retention, customer service, mail, Co Sec, and the serviced offices/business centre; translating commercial objectives into functional plans while staying hands-on in execution.

· Set and manage the operating cadence for each function; targets, workflows, and standards, ensuring consistent delivery across all customer-facing teams.

· Build and own the reporting and KPI framework across these functions, giving leadership real-time visibility into performance, risk, and opportunity.

· Drive cross-functional collaboration, resolving operational bottlenecks to ensure smooth customer journeys and efficient ways of working.

· Partner with the CEO to evaluate growth opportunities; new service lines and market opportunities, assessing operational readiness to scale ahead of commitment.

· Develop and coach function managers and senior leaders, strengthening leadership capability and organisational effectiveness, and ensuring each function operates with clear ownership, commercial discipline, and measurable performance outcomes.

· Work with Product to lead operational improvement and transformation initiatives; systems, automation, process redesign, and technology enablement to enhance scalability, efficiency, and competitive advantage. This includes operational ownership of the migration of customers and functions onto the new platform.

· Ensure operational resilience, enterprise risk management, and regulatory compliance across all regulated activities, maintaining robust governance and controls across the Group.

· Develop a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.

· Help ensure operational resilience and regulatory adherence across regulated activities within the Group.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Team Performance & Productivity

· Output/productivity per FTE across owned functions

· Employee engagement score and trend

· Team retention and voluntary attrition

· Function manager bench strength and internal promotion rate

Customer Experience & Service Delivery

· CSAT and NPS trends

· Complaint resolution time and effectiveness

· SLA adherence across owned functions

· Retention/churn rate linked to operational performance

· Facility occupancy and service standards

· Statutory filing accuracy and on-time completion rate

Operational Efficiency & Financial Performance

· Cost-to-serve across owned functions

· Revenue per employee within customer operations

· Process efficiency improvements (automation, cycle time, error rates)

· Scalability of operations relative to headcount growth

What we are looking for

· A commercially astute operator with experience running operations across multi-disciplinary or multi-entity service businesses; ideally within a scaling SME environment of a similar size to ours (circa 150 staff, £18m revenue) and with experience in a subscription, membership or B2B Services model

· Experience coordinating diverse business units or functions while maintaining performance accountability.

· Strong operational and organisational capability, with the credibility to work closely with senior leadership.

· Understanding of regulated, professional services, or compliance-led environments.

· A data-led leader who translates plans into measurable execution and consistent delivery.

· A collaborative leader who builds alignment across diverse teams and raises operational standards.

· A change-oriented operator who strengthens processes while supporting growth and innovation.

What We Offer

· £90k–110k and comprehensive benefits package

· Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

· The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

· A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

About this opportunity

As our Head of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our supply chain from Asia into our EU, UK and US warehouse network, driving operational excellence to support our ambitious growth plans.

You'll lead our entire supply chain operations from sourcing of raw materials and our cosmetic products to final delivery of orders at our customers’ door step.   • Develop and implement strategies that improve supply chain efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen reliability and agility as the business scales.

  • Own demand forecasting and inventory planning to ensure product availability while keeping inventory levels lean.

  • Oversee global logistics operations, optimising shipping modes from Asia and import flows into the EU, UK, and US.

  • Build strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics providers; negotiate contracts and favourable terms, and ensure adherence to quality standards and delivery timelines.

  • Evaluate and onboard new suppliers to support scalability and product innovation.

  • Leverage our ERP system and forecasting & planning tools to drive continuous process improvement, while working with Product Development on sustainability, packaging, and supply chain innovation.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering accountability and collaboration, and align supply chain strategy with Product Development, Marketing, and Finance.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Proven expertise across inventory management, demand forecasting, global procurement, and international logistics.

  • Track record of scaling supply chain operations in a high-growth, demand-volatile environment.

  • Proficient in ERP systems and specialised SCM tools for forecasting and planning, while still comfortable running ad-hoc analyses in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide teams and secure buy-in from adjacent functions.

  • Excellent negotiation and relationship management skills with international suppliers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition - 80-100K package + BSPCE
descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer calls, schedule and reschedule appointments for healthcare providers, so their teams can focus on care. We are 50 today.

We've just raised a $20M Series A led by Norrsken, with the founders of Alan and Datadog, and we're opening the US from New York. In 2027, we'll hire 60 to 80 people across France and the US. How well we execute these hires will directly decide whether we hit our business goals.

Talent Acquisition is the last function we haven't built in-house. Today it runs on freelancers, and every transition means starting over: new onboarding, relationship to rebuild, company story to re-explain. We're now hiring the person who will build and own this function for the long run, as a member of the COMEX.

Your mission

Build the team and the system that let Vocca hire 60 to 80 people a year at the pace and quality level the business needs, across several countries. You set the recruiting strategy with the founders, you build and lead the TA team, and you personally own the hardest hires.

Expected outcomes

  • Improve our recruiting model, based on quality over quantity: with the founders, you've sharpened how Vocca hires (who owns what between TA and hiring managers, where we raise the bar, where we cut steps) and turned it into a hiring plan mapped to business needs, by team and by country. Every hire meets the bar, even when volume goes up.

  • A TA team built from scratch: from today's freelance setup to a team of 4 to 6 recruiters by end of 2027, in France and the US, with the right mix of permanent recruiters and freelancers for speed, quality and cost.

  • 60 to 80 hires delivered in 2027 at the expected quality bar.

  • A scalable recruiting system: playbook, scorecards, referrals system, tooling and dashboards live, with tracked KPIs (time-to-hire, offer acceptance, probation validation, quality of hire).

  • AI across the funnel: a recruiting AI strategy you designed and own, with a measurable gain in team productivity.

  • Critical roles closed: senior and critical hires closed by you at first.

  • Autonomous hiring managers: HMs trained on the key recruiting skills, and high satisfaction among HMs and leadership.

  • Employer brand and budget: employer brand live in France and the US, team budget respected.

What you'll own

Strategy and planning

  • Refine the recruiting operating model with the founders

  • Translate the business plan into a hiring plan and a team budget, then own both

Build and lead the TA team

  • Hire your own team (5 to 6 recruiters by end of 2027) across countries, and set the freelance vs permanent mix

  • Train your recruiters until they're autonomous, structure the team, and manage the development of your direct reports

  • Build the playbook, methods, and tooling that make the team scale

AI in recruiting

  • Define and own Vocca's AI strategy for recruiting, from sourcing to closing

  • Test, keep what works, drop what doesn't

Own the hardest hires

  • Recruit senior and critical roles yourself, especially in the US, and know when to delegate and when to own the desk

  • Help hiring managers formalize their needs (scorecards)

  • Build direct sourcing channels that don't always rely on headhunters

  • Run processes end to end

Beyond hiring

  • Train and advise hiring managers on the key recruiting skills

  • Build Vocca's employer brand in France and the US

  • Work with the People team on topics connected to recruiting: key people, onboarding/offboarding, probation validation etc

This role is for you if

Prerequisites:

  • 6+ years in recruiting, including building and leading a TA team in a scaling tech company: you've managed recruiters, set up a playbook and tooling, and managed direct reports.

  • You've deployed AI tools in a real recruiting workflow, and your opinions come from what worked and what failed.

  • Fluent in French and English, based in Paris.

What we'll assess:

  • Business acumen: you understand how a company works, you know the tech market, and you tie hiring to revenue and budget.

  • Data-driven: you diagnose funnel problems with data and make both strategic and operational decisions from it.

  • Ownership: you move without being asked, stay engaged when things get hard, welcome feedback and see things through.

  • Leadership: you know how to sell the company and yourself. Senior candidates see you as Vocca's first showcase, and your team follows you.

  • Multi-country hiring: you can run recruiting across several countries at once, with different markets, comp standards and candidate expectations, even when you're not based there.

Nice to have:

  • A US hiring track record.

  • Experience outside TA: ops, sales, consulting, or building a company.

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want to step away from the desk once your team is in place. Here, you stay close to the hardest hires.

  • You see TA as a support function that executes requests, not a COMEX seat that shapes business and hiring decisions with the founders.

  • AI in recruiting is something you've read about more than used.

Compensation

  • OTE between €80K-100K

  • Equity (BSPCE)

Perks and benefits

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8-12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays)

  • 4 days a week in our offices in Paris

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib)

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Screening call with our Hector, Head of Talent Part-time (visio, 30-45min)

  2. Hiring manager interview with Maxime, Chief of staff (visio, 45min)

  3. Business case with Hector and Maxime (on site, 1h30)

  4. COMEX fit with Eliott (CEO), Hugo (CTO), Julie (Head of Ops), Charles (Head of Product) and Max (on site, 30 min for each duo)

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: HR People Associate - Working Student
descriptionHtml:

Tu seras responsable du suivi de tes propres sujets, de la collecte des documents aux dernières relances, en veillant à ce que rien ne passe entre les mailles du filet. Une fois ces responsabilités bien maîtrisées, tu pourras élargir ton périmètre à certaines activités administratives de nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne.

Tes missions

  • Garantir la fiabilité des dossiers RH : tenir les données et les outils à jour, suivre les échéances et relancer les interlocuteurs concernés jusqu’à la résolution de chaque sujet.
  • Organiser le suivi de la médecine du travail : planifier les rendez-vous, gérer les convocations et veiller au respect des échéances administratives.

  • Être le premier point de contact pour les demandes RH courantes : apporter une réponse aux questions administratives, assurer le suivi des demandes et solliciter le People Partner lorsque la situation le nécessite.
  • Améliorer nos processus au quotidien : identifier les tâches qui pourraient être simplifiées, clarifier les checklists et améliorer nos outils de suivi pour gagner en fiabilité et en efficacité.
  • Élargir progressivement ton périmètre à l’international : une fois les processus français bien maîtrisés, prendre en charge deux ou trois activités administratives récurrentes pour nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne, avec un accompagnement adapté.

title: Implementation lead
descriptionHtml:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused problem solver to join our Implementation team. You’ll lead end-to-end deployments of Watershed for our largest and most complex strategic accounts - translating goals into clear plans, finding solutions to customer needs, orchestrating cross-functional work, and building customer confidence.

You’ll design scalable systems and processes for repeatability while also solving complex, bespoke needs for our largest customers. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, advisory, customer success, and external partners to keep momentum high and outcomes measurable. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role driving the success of Watershed’s customer base.

 

You will:

  • Own and deliver implementations from kickoff to wrap-up: run discovery, map milestones, manage risks, and drive crisp execution

  • Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact during implementations, building high‑trust relationships across technical and non‑technical stakeholders

  • Design out-of-the-box, creative solutions that meet customer needs, leveraging existing product and services and generating insight into potential future needs

  • Develop a deep understanding of Watershed’s product and services to guide customers on what’s possible and make smart trade‑offs

  • Conduct enablements for customers on using complex Watershed features

  • Coordinate internal and customer teams, sequence dependencies, and renegotiate timelines when inputs change

  • Act as the voice of the customer to product and engineering, surfacing patterns, blockers, and feature requests that inform the roadmap

  • Build scalable playbooks, tooling, and processes that make implementations faster, more consistent, and measurable over time

 

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 3-6+ years in management consulting, solutions, or software implementation, preferably at a B2B SaaS company. You have experience leading customers through complex programs or projects

  • Take pride in your ability to learn new concepts quickly and thrive operating in a high-volume environment

  • Love to sweat the details, but are also able to zoom-out and see the big picture

  • Are a systems thinker who brings structure, clarity, and momentum to ambiguous problems

  • Are excellent at communicating clearly with technical and non‑technical audiences to introduce new concepts and drive alignment

  • Love working on multiple workstreams simultaneously, juggling multiple balls and keeping stakeholders accountable

  • Have a keen eye for identifying risks and drive mitigation plans to keep projects on track

  • Are an early adopter of AI solutions and excited to use them to drive impact

 

This position is required to be in person in our London office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: Implementation Specialist (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health, and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center, and for some a dedicated CSM.

title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.

As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on.

We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems.

You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services.

We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world.

title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps).
  • Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge.
  • Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

title: Insurance Compliance Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Role

Alan’s Insurance Compliance Counsel, you will be Alan's expert on insurance compliance and consumer protection regulation. You will define how regulatory obligations translate into Alan's tools, processes, and products. You will own the compliance posture on your perimeter, proactively manage our exposure, and be the primary interface with regulators on the topics you cover.

You will also be a key connector between the compliance function, internal control, and the audit processes Alan conducts - ensuring audit findings are properly digested, remediated, and embedded into how we operate.

As Alan expands into new markets, you will play a central role in ensuring our compliance standards travel with us: adapting Group frameworks to local requirements and helping stand up the right compliance foundations in new geographies.

The role sits within the Legal Area in the Corporate Unit, and involves close daily collaboration with the Legal, Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care, and Product teams across all of Alan's markets.

 

What You Will Do

Own Alan's Insurance Compliance Posture

  • Define how regulatory obligations relating to Alan’s core product (IDD including duty of advice, product governance, AML/CFT, etc.) translate into Alan's operational processes, product design, and tooling

  • Suggest optimal ways to meet regulatory requirements within Alan's products while improving members' experience - from pricing components and options design to UX choices and complaint handling

  • Proactively identify compliance risks, assess their exposure, and develop mitigating action plans in coordination with internal stakeholders

  • Lead the structuring and continuous improvement of Alan's complaints management framework across France, Belgium, and Spain, ensuring compliance with ACPR recommendations and local equivalents

Reporting & Audits

  • Serve as the compliance function's key contributor to Alan's internal control system: document compliance-related risks and controls in the Group's centralised mapping, and co-deploy the internal control approach across teams (Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care)

  • Prepare and support internal and external audits: assess Alan's standing against planned operational improvements, define remediation plans, and drive and monitor their effective implementation

  • Report on compliance obligations and risk exposure to Alan's Board and governance committees, with clarity and foresight; Manage regulatory reporting obligations including the ACPR Questionnaire Protection de la Clientèle (QPC)

  • Respond to regulatory inspections (ACPR, FSMA, or equivalent in Alan’s operating countries), coordinating internally and ensuring Alan is always audit-ready

AML/CFT & KYC

  • Support the AML framework: conduct second-level analysis on suspicious cases, manage relationships with regulatory bodies and financial intelligence units, approve high-risk client relationships (including PEPs), and maintain the AML/CFT risk assessment framework

  • Oversee KYC Ops referents' training and upskilling, including Belgium-specific AML requirements

  • Coordinate with the AMLO on annual priorities, documentation, monitoring tools, and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain Alan's compliance roadmap: prioritise, track progress, update the risk mapping, and re-prioritise as the regulatory environment evolves

  • Lead compliance projects with internal stakeholders across Insurance, Product, Sales, Care, and Operations, translating regulatory requirements into concrete deliverables and timelines

  • Contribute to pragmatic compliance positions on regulatory requirements that affect our products and contracts - turning complex constraints into well-reasoned, pragmatic solutions that support the business.

Regulatory Training & Internal Capability

  • Design and maintain mandatory regulatory training programmes for Sales and Care roles (IDD competency requirements including duty of advice and product governance, Loi Evin, AML/CFT)

  • Build internal compliance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making tools that increase team autonomy and reduce reliance on external resources

  • Contribute to Alan's written culture by producing high-quality documentation that teams can rely on independently

International Compliance & Localisation

  • Ensure Alan's compliance standards travel consistently across all Group markets, whether existing (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) or newly opened, adapting Group frameworks to local regulatory requirements and deploying them locally in coordination with local counsel.

 

Profile

Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in compliance in an insurance or fintech company; solid coverage of at least two of the following: AML/CFT, insurance distribution (IDD), complaints handling, regulatory reporting

  • Solid understanding of the French insurance regulatory framework and ability to work across EU/local requirements

  • Proven ability to lead compliance projects cross-functionally: you translate regulatory requirements into clear priorities, align internal stakeholders, and deliver without creating bottlenecks or increased friction

  • Bilingual French/English (both required, written and spoken)

  • International exposure is a strong plus

You Will Thrive Here If You Are

  • A pragmatic problem-solver: you find the right answer within regulatory constraints rather than defaulting to the most conservative one

  • Rigorous and well-organised: you maintain high documentation standards, track your commitments, and keep stakeholders informed

  • Business-minded: you understand what matters for the company's growth and your members' protection, and you calibrate your compliance work accordingly

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

title: Intern - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Finton

Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt.

Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion.

Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist.

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projektunterstützung: Du arbeitest im Hintergrund in laufenden Kundenprojekten mit: Du bereitest Finanzdaten aus ERP und Buchhaltung auf, baust Auswertungen und Dashboards auf unserer AI-Plattform und lieferst dem Projektteam die Grundlage für das Gespräch mit dem CFO.

  • Finanzmodelle und Analysen: Du wirkst an Finanzmodellen, Cash Forecasts, Deckungsbeitragsanalysen und Unternehmensbewertungen mit und prüfst Daten und Ergebnisse auf Plausibilität.

  • Business Development: Du recherchierst Zielkunden, Investoren und Multiplikatoren, pflegst unsere Lead-Listen und erstellst Angebots- und Pitch-Unterlagen sowie Case Studies.

  • Strategie: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen Fragen wie Positionierung, Pricing, neuen Service-Linien und Partnerschaften, von der Analyse bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage.

  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerber und AI-Entwicklungen im Finance-Bereich und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für unser Angebot ab.

  • Produktentwicklung: Mit deinem Feedback aus Projektarbeit und Markt hilfst du unserem Technologie-Team, die AI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du gestaltest mit, statt nur abzuarbeiten, auch bei internen Themen wie Recruiting, Wissensaufbau oder Prozessverbesserung.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Studium: Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung mit sehr guten Leistungen, mindestens drei abgeschlossene Semester.

  • Erfahrung: Erste relevante Praxiserfahrung, etwa durch Praktika in Consulting, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Private Equity oder in der Finanzabteilung eines Unternehmens.

  • Handwerk: Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint, Grundverständnis von Bilanz, GuV und Cashflow; erste Berührung mit Finanzmodellen oder Bewertung ist ein Plus.

  • Technologie: Interesse an AI und Prozessautomatisierung im Finanzwesen. Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss, aber du willst verstehen, wie unsere Lösungen funktionieren.

  • Analytik: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis.

  • Haltung: Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team Dinge selbst voranzutreiben.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine ersten Monate bei Finton

In den ersten Tagen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und bekommst einen festen Ansprechpartner im Team. Schon in der ersten Woche unterstützt du ein Kundenprojekt aus dem Hintergrund: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust erste Auswertungen und siehst, wie aus Rohdaten ein Reporting für den CFO wird.

Nach den ersten Wochen übernimmst du eigene Arbeitspakete, etwa einen Teil eines Finanzmodells, eine Wettbewerbsanalyse oder den Aufbau einer neuen Lead-Liste, und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse direkt den Gründern.

Benefits

  • Echte Aufgaben statt Zuschauen: Du arbeitest an realen Projekten, Modellen und Strategiethemen mit und siehst, was mit deiner Arbeit beim Kunden passiert. Kein Kaffeekochen, kein Folienschubsen ohne Kontext.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: Du bekommst einen festen Mentor aus dem Gründerteam, regelmäßiges Feedback und Einblick, wie eine Beratung aufgebaut und geführt wird.

  • Perspektive: Wer überzeugt, hat die Option, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen.

  • Vergütung: Eine faire Praktikumsvergütung, die deine Erfahrung berücksichtigt.

  • Technologie: Du arbeitest mit unserer eigenen AI-Plattform statt mit Excel-Handarbeit und lernst, wie Finance- und Beratungsarbeit in den nächsten Jahren aussehen wird.

  • Standort Köln: Unser Büro liegt am Friesenplatz, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort, weil du so am schnellsten lernst und wir als kleines Team schnell entscheiden wollen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören dazu.

  • Ausstattung und Extras: Firmenlaptop, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Fitnessabo, kostenlose Getränke im Büro, lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

Bewerbung

Wenn du diesen Weg mitgestalten willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Ein Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Anfang; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Du hörst innerhalb von einer Woche von uns, und dein erstes Gespräch führst du direkt mit einem der Gründer.

title: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor (Internal Audit)
descriptionHtml:
Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm working across enterprise architecture, cyber assurance, AI governance and data governance. We run information security management systems (ISMS) for clients certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we are appointing a qualified ISO 27001 Lead Auditor as an associate contractor to carry out independent internal audits.

Your first assignment is a remote internal audit of an ISO 27001 certified technology company with offices in the UK and Asia. The audit is planned for early February 2027 and needs about 3 to 5 days, including planning, interviews, evidence review and the report. Further internal audit assignments will follow as our managed ISMS service grows.

This is an associate panel role. Each assignment is agreed separately with a written scope, timetable and day rate.

Tasks

  • Plan and carry out independent internal audits against ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses 4 to 10 and the Annex A controls.

  • Build a risk based audit plan and checklist from the client's scope, Statement of Applicability and previous audit findings.

  • Interview control owners and review evidence in the client's compliance platform (for example Vanta) and document tools (for example Notion).

  • Check that earlier non-conformities have been closed properly and the fixes work.

  • Raise clear findings graded as major non-conformity, minor non-conformity or opportunity for improvement.

  • Write a short, plain English audit report that the client's leadership can act on before management review.

  • Present findings at a closing meeting with the client and Intelance.

  • Stay fully independent of the team that runs the client's ISMS day to day.

  • Follow Intelance quality, security, confidentiality and conflict of interest procedures.

Requirements

Essential

  • A current ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor certificate (PECB, CQI and IRCA, BSI or equivalent).

  • Hands on experience auditing against ISO/IEC 27001:2022, including the updated Annex A controls.

  • At least three ISO 27001 internal or certification audits led in the last three years.

  • Experience auditing cloud based and SaaS businesses.

  • Able to write concise, evidence based findings that non technical leaders understand.

  • Based in the UK and able to work as a self-employed contractor.

  • Willing to declare any certification body work so we can confirm you are independent before each assignment.

Desirable

  • Experience auditing organisations that use Vanta, Drata or a similar compliance platform.

  • Experience auditing companies with offices in more than one country.

  • Knowledge of UK GDPR and how it links to ISO 27001.

  • ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer certificate.

Benefits

  • Join Intelance's specialist cyber assurance associate panel.

  • Clearly scoped, remote assignments with a written scope, timetable and agreed day rate.

  • Regular internal audit work as our managed ISMS client base grows.

  • Work alongside an experienced assurance team with structured templates and quality review.

  • Flexible, project based work you can fit around other commitments.

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for certificate evidence and references. Anonymised audit summaries are enough at application stage. Please do not send confidential client material.

title: IT Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, “checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are seeking an IT Support Analyst to provide hands-on technical support with a focus on coverage for our EMEA wide employees - both onsite and remotely. This is a front-line role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems directly with end users and wants to build depth across endpoint, identity, and collaboration tooling.

This role will resolve day-to-day technical issues remotely for the broader distributed workforce — covering hardware, software, account access, and collaboration tools. The ideal candidate brings solid troubleshooting fundamentals, reliable follow-through, and a customer-service mindset, and is comfortable escalating complex or ambiguous issues to senior support staff or the Global Help Desk Manager.

 

This role will be responsible for.....

  • Provide onsite technical support including hardware setup, network connectivity, conference room/AV equipment, and printer/peripheral troubleshooting.

  • Resolve incoming help desk tickets and requests for the broader distributed workforce, covering hardware, software, account access, and [ticketing system] queue management

  • Support onboarding and offboarding logistics for employees, including equipment provisioning, account setup, and device retrieval

  • Administer routine identity and access tasks (password resets, MFA support, access requests) within [identity/access platform], escalating complex or policy-sensitive requests

  • Support endpoint management tasks such as imaging, patch verification, and asset tracking within tools like Jamf or Iru

  • Maintain accurate records of tickets, assets, and resolutions to support reporting and audit needs

  • Follow documented runbooks and knowledge base articles for common issues, and flag gaps or outdated content to the Global Help Desk Manager

  • Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the appropriate lead or manager in a timely manner, providing clear context and troubleshooting steps already attempted

  • Partner with Security and IT Engineering on device compliance and access control practices as directed

  • Demonstrate a commitment to integrity, process improvement, and customer satisfaction

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Must have foundational experience in IT support, help desk, or end-user services

  • Must have working knowledge of common endpoint operating systems (MacOS and/or Windows) and standard enterprise collaboration software

  • Must be able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical employees

  • Must be able to prioritize and manage a queue of concurrent requests with minimal direction

  • Must demonstrate sound judgment in knowing when to resolve an issue independently versus escalate it

  • Must demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to question the norm in pursuit of an exceptional user experience.

 

Minimum Education and Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, help desk, or IT operations

  • Experience supporting both in-office and remote/distributed employees preferred

 

Required Tech Stack Experience

  • Familiarity with Jira or Jira Service Management

  • Comfortable managing identity in Okta, Entra, or similar

  • Experience using Jamf, Iru, or Intune

  • Expert in Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom

 

What Sets You Apart?

  • You've supported a hybrid or distributed workforce and are comfortable switching between in-person and remote troubleshooting

  • You've contributed to onboarding/offboarding or endpoint management processes that improved speed or consistency

  • You're proactive about documenting fixes and updating knowledge base content for the next person

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or similar

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Application Note

Du hilfst gern, behältst auch bei kniffligen Problemen die Ruhe und erklärst Technik so, dass sie jeder versteht? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner.

Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) als Support-Spezialist - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Support-Spezialist bist du die freundliche und kompetente Stimme von Deeken Technology für alle Anwender unserer Kunden. Du kümmerst dich um sämtliche IT-Support-Anliegen - und sorgst dafür, dass niemand mit seinem Problem allein bleibt.

- Du bist im First- und Second-Level-Support die erste Anlaufstelle: Du nimmst Anfragen telefonisch entgegen und löst sie nach Möglichkeit direkt im ersten Gespräch.

- Du bearbeitest schriftliche Anfragen per E-Mail über unsere Service-Plattform Hindeo.

- Du analysierst Probleme gemeinsam mit den Anwendern per Fernwartung und findest Lösungen.

- Bei Bedarf besprichst du Supportthemen in kurzen Teams-Meetings direkt mit unseren Kunden.

- Du gibst Anwendern Tipps, wie sie ihre Systeme besser und sicherer nutzen.

- Du stellst die Erreichbarkeit unseres Supports sicher, dokumentierst sauber in Hindeo und gibst komplexe Themen strukturiert an unsere Spezialisten weiter.

- Erkennst du beim Kunden Bedarf, übergibst du die Vertriebschance an unsere Kollegen im IT-Vertrieb.

Das bringst du mit

Verlässlichkeit ist uns extrem wichtig: Wenn du etwas zusagst, hältst du es ein. Dazu kommunizierst du klar und freundlich - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich - und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Anliegen unserer Kunden.

- Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus

- Ein gutes Grundverständnis in einem möglichst breiten Spektrum: Microsoft 365, Nextcloud, Terminalserver, Drucker, Smartphones, Tablets und Thin Clients

- Sicherer Umgang mit Fernwartungs-Tools und Ticketsystemen

- Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, Geduld und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du den Überblick

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander.

Warum Deeken Technology

- Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.

- Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo.

- Dein perfekter Support-Arbeitsplatz: Cloud-Telefonie-Arbeitsplatz, mehrere Monitore, Firmenlaptop, Firmenhandy und modernste Ausstattung - alles, was du für einen reibungslosen Support brauchst.

- Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback aus dem Support fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

- Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst.

- Deine Perspektive: Im Support lernst du die gesamte IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden kennen. Mit Weiterbildungen und Herstellerschulungen kannst du dich bei uns gezielt weiterentwickeln - bis hin zum Spezialisten in einem unserer Fachbereiche.

- Neues Büro im ecopark: Knapp 500 m² im OM-Medienhaus - hell, klimatisiert, mit kontrollierter Belüftung, barrierefrei und mit Mensa im Haus. Getränke, Snacks und ein frischer Obstkorb stehen für dich bereit.

- Extras: Edenred und Mitarbeiterrabatte.

- Familie & Beruf: Über die Kita-Kooperation im ecopark stehen in einem benachbarten Kindergarten reservierte Plätze für Kinder von Beschäftigten im ecopark zur Verfügung.

- Sicherheit & Miteinander: Unbefristeter Vertrag, 28 Urlaubstage, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, lockerer Dresscode sowie gemeinsame Teamevents - vom Stoppelmarkt über das Cityfest bis zur Weihnachtsfeier.

Deine ersten Monate

- Ankommen: Du lernst dein Team, unsere Prozesse, Hindeo und unsere ISO-27001-Standards kennen und bearbeitest deine ersten Supportfälle an der Seite erfahrener Kollegen.

title: Junior Clinical Fellow
descriptionHtml:
Be at the forefront of a new era in patient care

Are you a doctor who has completed Foundation Training and is looking for a unique clinical opportunity? This is your chance to work at the cutting edge of cannabis based medicines, supporting patients with complex and often life changing conditions while gaining experience in an emerging area of medicine.

Join a passionate and forward thinking clinical team in a rapidly growing field where no two patients, or days, are the same. You will work alongside experienced consultants, pharmacists and multidisciplinary specialists, contributing to meaningful patient outcomes while developing your clinical expertise in a progressive and innovative healthcare environment. This role is offered as a 12 month fixed term contract

 

What is the job?

We are recruiting a Junior Clinical Fellow to join our London team. This is a hands-on, patient focused role where you will play a critical part in prescribing and reviewing cannabis-based medicines for patients with complex clinical needs.

Your work will centre on delivering safe, effective and highly personalised treatment, supporting patients across a wide range of conditions.

Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team, contributing not only to outstanding patient outcomes but also to the development of clinical pathways, education initiatives, and service improvements. This role offers a genuine opportunity to grow your expertise and make a lasting impact in a fast-evolving specialty.

This is a full time role contracted at 40 hours per week. Your time will be split across three days on site and two days working remotely, with one Saturday per month required on site. Saturday working is compensated with a day in lieu.

What will you be doing?

  • Conduct clinical reviews via video call with patients during their journey through the clinic.

  • Prescribe medicines and tailor treatments to individual patient needs.

  • Provide expert guidance to patients on treatment options.

  • Clinically check and review CBPM prescriptions for safety and accuracy.

  • Help to answer complex clinical queries and provide guidance to our patient support and other external teams.

  • Maintain accurate patient records in line with GMC standards.

  • Deliver education and training on CBPM to patients, clinicians, and staff.

  • Collaborate with the wider team to streamline processes and improve outcomes.

What do you need?

  • Registered medical practitioner with the GMC and a full licence to practice

  • Completion of Foundation Year 2 (F2) training or equivalent clinical experience including a placement in GP or A&E.

  • Experience working in a clinical setting

  • Knowledge of CBPM is desired not essential or willingness to undergo specialised training

  • Clear and confident communicator across clinical and non-clinical settings

  • Highly effective at managing time and prioritising competing demands

  • Proactive and resourceful when identifying and resolving problems

  • Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex workflows

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

  

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

 

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.
