Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

There are opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. You'll work on a best-in class Open Banking decision-making platform and learn how to build systems that operate with low latency, at scale.

Our technology stack:

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Java,

React, Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested code in Python and Java, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers, as part of a supported team rota during business hours

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

  • Build and improve frontend features in React, and grow your skills across the full stack

Who you are

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Java and Python – you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable writing and debugging code in both

  • Hands-on experience building frontend interfaces with React

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and writing unit tests

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Comfortable using Git for version control

  • A genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work

  • A sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers

  • You learn fast, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and enjoy doing so

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment, are comfortable finding your way around a large, evolving codebase, and take initiative to work things out

  • Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging

  • Clear communicator who asks questions, takes on feedback and works well in a team

  • Keen to work across the full stack, from backend services and databases through to the frontend

  • Able to work from our London office at least three days a week

Ideally you'll also have

  • Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI

  • Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker

  • Knowledge of lending products or Open Banking

How we work at Abound

To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:

  • High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.

  • MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.

  • Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership through WellHub

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Key Account Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first)

Team description

Our Paris sales team helps small and growing merchants across France get set up with SumUp's payment tools, often as their very first introduction to the brand. We're a close-knit, target-driven group that thrives on outbound conversations, quick thinking and celebrating wins together. This role gives you a real seat at the table from day one: you'll own conversations end to end, learn the fundamentals of a fast-paced sales cycle and see the direct impact of your work every time a merchant signs up.

What you'll do

  • 💼 Reach out to small business prospects by phone, email and social media, starting the conversation and building the pipeline

  • 🤝 Get to know each business's needs and show how SumUp can genuinely help them

  • 🎤 Run product pitches and demos that turn curiosity into commitment

  • 🔥 Manage the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal

  • 📊 Track performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving

  • 🧠 Share ideas with the team and help build an energised, collaborative office culture

What we're looking for…

  • Experience in outbound sales or business development, with a genuine drive to learn and grow quickly.

  • Comfort working with high volumes of phone-based outreach.

  • Curiosity and confidence when speaking with new people and solving their problems.

  • A results-driven mindset with a track record of working towards targets.

  • Fluency in French and English, given daily contact with local merchants and a global team.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

  • 💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future

  • 🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance

  • 🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Kfz-Meister (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst als Kfz-Meister Fahrzeuge eigenständig reparieren und Teil des Teams hinter den YouTube-Videos von Omid Mouazzen werden?

Wir sind die Spiegel Media GmbH, die Produktionsfirma hinter dem Kanal von Omid Mouazzen. Mit über 1,3 Mio. Abonnenten und monatlich über 150 Mio. Aufrufen gehören wir zu den größten YouTube Kanälen Deutschlands.

Unser 20-köpfiges Team der Spiegel Media GmbH mit Sitz in Viernheim verantwortet die Organisation, Produktion und Post Produktion aller Videos des Kanals Omid Mouazzen.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Wir wollen Deutschlands größten YouTube-Kanal aufbauen. Dafür suchen wir einen erfahrenen Kfz-Meister, der Fahrzeugreparaturen eigenständig und markenübergreifend durchführt und dabei höchste Ansprüche an Qualität, Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit stellt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du diagnostizierst Schäden und technische Defekte an Fahrzeugen unterschiedlicher Hersteller und führst die notwendigen Reparaturen eigenständig durch

  • Du gehst Fehlerursachen systematisch auf den Grund und entwickelst passende Reparaturlösungen

title: Kundenberater/in – Vollzeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hamburg-Altona · Vollzeit · vor Ort · 4.300–4.900 € brutto/Monat

Du telefonierst gerne, kannst Menschen gut zuhören und arbeitest am liebsten mit klaren Abläufen und einem festen Aufgabenbereich?

Als Kundenberater/in bei der ESH Unternehmensgruppe führst du die ersten Gespräche mit Interessenten, die sich auf die Steuerberaterprüfung vorbereiten möchten. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt dabei aktuell auf unserem größten Unternehmensbereich, der ESH StB-Examensvorbereitung.

Du findest heraus, wo die Interessenten aktuell stehen, klärst erste Fragen und bereitest die weiteren Beratungsgespräche mit unseren Strategieberatern vor.

Dabei arbeitest du nach klar definierten Abläufen und Gesprächsstrukturen.

Keine Vertriebserfahrung? Kein Problem.
Wir arbeiten dich strukturiert in unsere Gesprächsabläufe und Prozesse ein. Steuerrechtliche Kenntnisse brauchst du für diese Position nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst telefonische Erstgespräche mit Interessenten.

  • Du findest anhand klarer Fragen heraus, wo der Interessent aktuell steht und wobei er Unterstützung benötigt.

  • Du prüfst, ob unser Angebot grundsätzlich zur jeweiligen Situation passt.

  • Du bereitest passende Interessenten auf das weiterführende Gespräch mit unseren Strategieberatern vor.

  • Du planst Termine und sorgst für eine vollständige Vor- und Nachbereitung.

  • Du dokumentierst Gespräche und Informationen zuverlässig in unseren Systemen.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Strategieberater bei wiederkehrenden operativen Aufgaben.

  • Gelegentlich begleitest du uns auf Messen, Seminaren und Veranstaltungen.

So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus

Der Großteil deiner Arbeit besteht aus telefonischen Gesprächen, Terminvorbereitung und dokumentierten Abläufen.

Du arbeitest mit festen Gesprächsstrukturen und klar definierten Prozessen. Dadurch weißt du, was in welcher Situation zu tun ist und welche nächsten Schritte vorgesehen sind.

Innerhalb deines Aufgabenbereichs arbeitest du selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass Gespräche, Termine und Dokumentation zuverlässig erledigt werden.

Wenn ein Sonderfall auftritt oder etwas unklar ist, stimmst du dich mit dem zuständigen Kollegen ab.

Die Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn …

  • du gerne mit klaren Aufgaben und festen Abläufen arbeitest,

  • du zuverlässig bist und Absprachen einhältst,

  • du auch wiederkehrende Tätigkeiten dauerhaft sorgfältig erledigst,

  • du gerne telefonierst und offen auf Menschen zugehen kannst,

  • du aufmerksam zuhörst und Informationen schnell erfassen kannst,

  • du Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse übernimmst,

  • du gerne weißt, was von dir erwartet wird,

  • du einen langfristigen Arbeitsplatz und einen festen Aufgabenbereich suchst.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten

  • eine klare, professionelle und angenehme Gesprächsführung am Telefon

  • schnelle Auffassungsgabe

  • sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Verlässlichkeit und Disziplin

  • die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • die Fähigkeit, auch bei höherem Gesprächsaufkommen konzentriert und verbindlich zu arbeiten

Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung ist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Beratung oder Kundenkontakt ist von Vorteil, aber ebenfalls nicht zwingend erforderlich.

Kenntnisse im Steuerrecht benötigst du nicht.

Deine Einarbeitung bei ESH

Deine Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.

Mit unserer digitalen Schulungsplattform, Gesprächsleitfäden, Anleitungen und Checklisten lernst du deine Aufgaben Schritt für Schritt kennen.

Du kannst Inhalte jederzeit wiederholen und nachlesen und hast feste Ansprechpartner für deine Fragen.

Unser Ziel ist, dass du deinen Aufgabenbereich nach der Einarbeitung sicher und eigenständig übernehmen kannst.

Das erwartet dich bei ESH

Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

Die ESH Unternehmensgruppe entwickelt sich kontinuierlich weiter und baut ihre Unternehmensbereiche Schritt für Schritt aus.

Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in einem Umfeld rund um Steuerberatung und berufliche Weiterbildung mit langfristigem Bedarf. Neue Stellen schaffen wir mit dem Ziel, unser Team dauerhaft zu verstärken und langfristig zusammenzuarbeiten.

Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, möchten wir, dass du deinen Aufgabenbereich langfristig bei ESH übernimmst und ein fester Teil unseres Teams wirst.

Klare Strukturen

Du arbeitest mit festen Zuständigkeiten, geregelten Arbeitszeiten und nachvollziehbaren Prozessen. So weißt du, was von dir erwartet wird und kannst dich auf deine Aufgaben konzentrieren.

Attraktive Vergütung

Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation liegt dein Gehalt bei 4.300–4.900 € brutto pro Monat.

Zusätzlich bieten wir dir über unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit-System verschiedene Vergünstigungen und Zuschüsse, unter anderem über Probonio.

Moderne Arbeitsplätze

Dich erwarten moderne Büroräume in Hamburg-Altona, hochwertige Arbeitsgeräte und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische.

Strukturierte Einarbeitung

Auch als Quereinsteiger kannst du bei uns starten. Wir arbeiten dich Schritt für Schritt in unsere Gesprächsführung, Systeme und Abläufe ein, die du für deine Position benötigst.

Steuerrechtliche Kenntnisse sind für deine Aufgabe nicht erforderlich.

Gemeinsame Veranstaltungen

Gelegentlich sind wir als Team auf relevanten Messen, Kongressen und Veranstaltungen der Steuer- und Bildungsbranche vertreten.

Rahmenbedingungen

Arbeitsort: Hamburg-Altona
Beschäftigung: Vollzeit
Arbeitsmodell: vor Ort
Gehalt: 4.300–4.900 € brutto/Monat
Einarbeitung: in der Regel 2–4 Monate

title: Lead Engineer, Maritime
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is growing rapidly, and we’re looking for a Lead Engineer, Maritime to take hands-on technical ownership of a maritime product and help turn operational lessons from Ukraine into a reliable, manufacturable system that customers can test, deploy and reorder.

You’ll initially focus on one product, working across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and field teams to solve the most important technical problems and take it from its current configuration to repeatable production and customer delivery.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role, not a management-only position. You’ll stay close to the hardware, lead system-level trade-offs, investigate failures and make sure design changes are supported by test evidence and reflected in what we build.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong maritime engineering judgement with the ability to bring people together and deliver at pace. As UFORCE’s maritime portfolio expands, there is potential to grow into broader technical leadership, including Chief Engineer, Maritime, based on business need and demonstrated performance.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product’s technical baseline across hull, propulsion, power, onboard electronics, control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces and control systems.

  • Work with naval architecture and marine engineering specialists to maintain the stability, structural, weight and safety evidence supporting the product configuration.

  • Translate customer requirements, operator feedback and field experience into clear engineering priorities and an executable delivery plan.

  • Lead technical trade-offs and systems integration across mechanical, electrical, marine-control and software interfaces.

  • Work closely with Ukrainian product experts and international engineering teams to preserve operational knowledge and develop the product for Western customers.

  • Establish practical requirements, configuration and change control so engineering, manufacturing and field teams work from a consistent, approved design.

  • Lead failure investigation, root-cause analysis and corrective action, verifying fixes through repeatable bench, dockside and sea testing.

  • Demonstrate product performance and reliability through clear test plans, measured results and documented operating limits.

  • Partner with manufacturing and supply chain on design for manufacture, component qualification, approved substitutions, cost and production readiness.

  • Release the engineering package needed for repeatable production, including drawings, bills of materials, assembly requirements and acceptance tests.

  • Provide technical readiness assessments for customer trials and demonstrations, distinguishing proven capability from development goals.

  • Coordinate engineers and specialist partners, make ownership clear and escalate technical, safety or resource risks early.

  • Identify opportunities to reuse architecture, components and engineering practices as the maritime product range grows.

Required Skill

  • Experience personally leading engineering delivery for a complete uncrewed vessel or substantial integrated maritime product, with clear ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

  • Strong systems integration judgement across mechanical, electrical, propulsion, control, communications, navigation and software interfaces.

  • Experience taking a maritime product from prototype towards repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production test.

  • A track record of investigating sea-trial or field failures, identifying root causes and proving corrective actions through testing.

  • The ability to lead engineers across disciplines and drive delivery through influence as well as formal authority.

  • Practical understanding of how design decisions affect component availability, qualification, unit cost and manufacturing quality.

  • An understanding of how marine conditions, degraded navigation, communications resilience and operator feedback affect vessel design and testing.

  • The judgement to recognize stability, structural and vessel-safety implications and involve the appropriate technical specialists.

  • The ability to turn incomplete information into clear priorities, sound technical decisions and measurable progress.

  • Clear, honest communication about product capability, limitations, risks and delivery feasibility.

  • A hands-on approach, high ownership and the judgement to balance speed with appropriate engineering discipline.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, sea-trial sites and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian maritime teams, products or operators.

  • Experience adapting products for Western defence customers.

  • Familiarity with applicable defence sourcing restrictions and export-control requirements.

  • Experience supporting customer sea trials, military qualification, vessel classification or marine assurance activity.

  • Experience with naval architecture, high-speed craft, marine autonomy, USVs / UUVs or mission-payload integration.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across countries.

  • Evidence of growing from hands-on product ownership into broader technical leadership.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

title: Lead Product Manager - Business Lines
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

💲The Business Lines tribe

Business Lines owns Joko's current revenue engine across three product lines, each run by a dedicated task force:

  • 🌐 Online, Joko's historical core, covers the app, web app and browser extensions. Its challenge is to make sure users discover the right offers, clicks are tracked, purchases are attributed, commissions are approved, and cash back lands reliably.

  • 💳 In-Store owns card-linked offers, where users link their bank card and earn cash back when they pay at partner merchants in physical stores. It is a very different product line, closer to banking, payment integrations and merchant operations.

  • 🎁 Gift Cards lets users buy or earn gift cards from a catalog of brands, and already represents a significant and fast-growing share of company revenue.

Across these scopes, the tribe works on hard, high-impact product problems: improving catch and track rates, reducing funnel leaks, adapting to privacy and browser changes, strengthening payment and affiliate flows, and creating better customer experiences.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Business Lines tribe, your mission is to grow and strengthen the revenue Joko runs on today, across Online, In-Store and Gift Cards. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, lead the Product Managers who own each task force, and personally take the calls that cut across them.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will arbitrate between three task forces with very different mechanics and very different economics, decide where the next engineer and the next euro go, and defend those trade-offs in front of leadership.

  • Own the revenue chain end to end: Catch rate and track rate decide whether a purchase becomes revenue, and a fraction of a point there is worth hundreds of thousands of euros a year. You will make sure the tribe knows exactly where the chain leaks, sizes each lever properly, and prioritises accordingly.

  • Go deep where it matters: Affiliate tracking and attribution, card-linked payment integrations, checkout and coupon flows. You will not be the PM writing every spec, but you will be expected to understand these mechanics well enough to challenge a diagnosis and make the final call.

  • Champion the user experience: You will stay close to user needs and pain points across each business line, and make sure the tribe turns them into dedicated features, sharp product improvements and astonishing customer experiences.

  • Navigate the structural challenges: Privacy regulation, browser tracking restrictions, payment ecosystem changes and last-click competition keep changing the rules. You will build the product strategy that keeps the business healthy as conditions shift, rather than reacting to each change as it lands.

  • Lead and grow the PMs: You will manage and mentor the Product Managers on Online, In-Store and Gift Cards, set the bar on funnel analysis, experimentation and delivery, and grow people who can own a revenue stream on their own.

  • Define what healthy looks like: You will set the metrics that matter for each business line, hold the tribe to them, and be accountable for the tribe's contribution to company revenue.

  • Work across the company: You will partner with the B2B teams who own merchant relationships, with Care on the user pain that untracked transactions create, with Data, and directly with the affiliate and payment partners themselves.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers, ideally on consumer products. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, payments, adtech or affiliate marketing is a strong plus.

  • Data fluency: This is the criterion that carries the most weight here. You can interrogate a funnel yourself, break a metric into its components, and tell a real signal from noise. Much of this job is diagnosis before it is delivery, and you need to be able to do it yourself, not just ask for it.

  • Business sense: You think in revenue, margin and trade-offs. You can size a lever in euros before committing a team to it, and you are comfortable being accountable for a number in front of the exec team.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Technical appetite: You want to understand how the tracking and the payment integrations actually work: browser behaviour, cookies, redirects, backend pipelines, card networks. Coding is not required, but you will be close to the mechanics every week.

  • Experimentation: You have run real A/B tests, you know how to design one that answers a question, and you can tell a team when theirs will not.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no, with merchants, partners and internal teams alike.

  • Resilience: Much of this domain sits outside your control: browsers change, merchants change, regulation changes, competitors change. Problems that never fully close are what motivate you. If you are looking for a blank page and a 0-to-1 product, this is not that seat: this is a mature business with real revenue on the line every day.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on with AI tools in your own product work. At Joko this is expected daily, across the whole company.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

High autonomy. A fragmented industry full of unsolved problems, and the freedom to prototype, test, and deploy your own solutions end-to-end.

What you'll do:

  1. Develop advanced feature-extraction and data-processing solutions for 3D CAD, 2D, and batch data feeding our machine learning systems.

  2. Build, train, and industrialize deep learning models that understand geometry and drive our quoting, calculation, and optimization engines.

  3. Enhance and extend our 2D/3D/CAD tools and geometry solutions.

Imnoo is sustainability focused, creating real value as well as a profitable company with stable base.

descriptionHtml:

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

title: Manager, Sales Development (1 year FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

 

The Sales Development Manager is responsible for, but may not be limited to, the management of all of Sophos’ UK based Sales Development Representatives. This comprises a team of 8 SDRs across the EMEA region.  

 

Key to this role is the ability to develop new sales skills and thinking across the team, oversee change programmes and build strong partnerships with other leaders in Sales, Marketing, Operations Team and the wider global SDR community.  

It will also require assisting the SDR Director in driving innovation, bringing a new strategic focus to the function and increasing the quality and productivity of the work performed by the wider EMEA SDR Team. As part of this, support for SDRs outside of the UK will be required.  

 

The aim of this role is to build and manage a team of highly adaptable, energised and productive SDRs, capable of consistently delivering a high volume of quality sales opportunities for the Sophos Sales teams and its Channel Partners to successfully progress to order. It is also to increase the levels of communication with senior stakeholders and, through working with them, create new synergies, stronger working practices, and new levels of value for those on both the Sales and Marketing sides of the SDR team.  

 

They must also take responsibility for integrating the team into the wider Sales & Marketing communities, increasing collaboration across the EMEA SDR function, and delivering continued improvement at both a team and individual level. Within this, their skills and experience as a coach or mentor will be essential.  

With ambitious plans to innovate and redefine how the EMEA SDR team is seen, performs and defines its success. The job holder must be unafraid of change, able to build a collective purpose, and passionately believe in the importance of Sales Development as a key driver of business growth.  

 

The role requires office attendance in Manchester (3 fixed days per week; Monday, Wednesday and Thursday). 


What Will You Do:

  • Team Management: Is accountable for the performance and results of the team. Monitors, tracks and reports on KPIs. Performs regular team meetings and 1-1s. Promotes success, but also addresses underperformance. Uses all of this, in combination, to ensure team targets are hit. 

  • Team Development: Sets performance standards and, within wider (EMEA) context, targets for team. Develops new skills and awareness, unlocks potential, enables progression and delivers, as part of a wider coaching culture, regular coaching sessions. 

  • Peer Engagement: Engages positively with other Sales and Marketing leaders. Invites their feedback and shapes their thinking to improve the performance and financial contribution of the SDR team. Presents regular performance updates, new ideas and future plans as part of the Sales and Marketing Management meeting cycles. Able to learn from, raise debate with and positively influence the way this group views and works with the SDR team. 

  • Sales Methods and Mindset: Builds a sales mentality and methodology throughout. Readies team members for Sales roles. Works with enablement team to design and deliver training programmes that are fit for a modern, progressive and future facing SDR team. 

  • Maintains Motivation: Sustains energy and purpose across the team through positive leadership, spotting and celebrating good performance, setting meaningful goals, maintaining a strong supportive presence, and providing attractive incentives/SPIFFs. 

  • Collaborates: Works in tandem with the EMEA SDR Manager to enable and create more time for strategic development of the SDR function. Forms partnerships with colleagues in Marketing and Sales to ensure campaigns are successful (ROI targets are hit), hand offs are seamless (Sales Acceptance Rates are high), and the UKIN SDR team is helping drive revenue growth (high Closed Won rates are sustained). Builds close and productive working relationships with others across the Global SDR Leadership team. Communicates frequently with own team and establishes a strong team ethos across the group. 

  • Enable Innovation: To achieve higher standards, new levels of success and greater collaboration, is willing to experiment, benchmark and take risks. Is unafraid to break with traditional models of acting and thinking. Regularly creates, shares and, after getting buy in, implements own ideas for improvement. 

  • Selection and Onboarding: Successfully recruits high calibre and high potential candidates. Designs and arranges extended induction programmes that enable new recruits to add value from early in their Sophos careers. 

  • Inspire Success: Leads from the front, brings energy, maintains credibility, ensures professionalism and gets people to see new possibilities.

     

What will you bring:

  • Has had or has a strong desire to perform a Management role. 

  • 3+ Years experience within a sales environment. 

  • Successful track record in delivering targets.  

  • Has collaborated with, influenced and achieved productive working relationships with Senior Stakeholders.  

  • Defined, measured, interpreted and presented performance goals. 

  • Has successfully overseen change projects.  

  • Has used coaching to drive positive change and realise potential in others. 

  • Used to managing mixed priorities and activities. 

  • Lead, create purpose, maintain motivation. 

  • Manage/maximise performance and results. 

  • Collaboration. 

  • Recruit, develop and retain talent. 

  • Communication – individual, team and stakeholder. 

  • Emotional intelligence. 

  • Uses data to inform decision making. 

  • Prioritise, delegate and empower.

  • Adapt, innovate, create. 

  • Define and raise standards of performance.

title: Marketing Specialist Cybersecurity
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een creatieve marketing specialist met ervaring in de IT en toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Bij Nomios ontwikkel je samen met toonaangevende vendoren en partners campagnes die er echt toe doen, in de snelgroeiende wereld van cybersecurity.

Bij Nomios werken we aan cybersecurity- en netwerkoplossingen voor organisaties in Nederland en ver daarbuiten. We groeien hard en zoeken een medior marketing specialist die ons team versterkt en onze zichtbaarheid vergroot.

Je werkt veel samen met onze strategische vendoren, partners en de partner manager van Nomios. Samen bedenk je campagnes, rol je ze uit en laat je zien wat ze opleveren. Zo speel je een belangrijke rol in het aantrekken van nieuwe klanten en het versterken van ons partnerecosysteem. Kennis van cybersecurity is geen must; die bouw je bij ons snel op.

Wat ga je doen?

Als medior marketing specialist ga jij aan de slag met:

  • Vendor- en partnermarketing

    • Samen met onze strategische vendoren, partners en de partner manager van Nomios bedenk, ontwikkel en voer je gezamenlijke campagnes uit.

    • Je beheert de marketingactiviteiten met onze vendoren op strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau, inclusief planning, marketingfondsen (MDF) en de bijbehorende administratie.

    • Je rapporteert de resultaten van campagnes aan vendoren, partners en het managementteam en vertaalt die naar verbeteringen.

  • Campagnes en performance marketing

    • Je bedenkt en ontwikkelt digitale (ABM-)campagnes die onze doelgroep raken.

    • Je beheert en optimaliseert onze Google Ads- en LinkedIn-campagnes.

  • Content marketing

    • Je bedenkt, creëert en publiceert artikelen, video's en andere content, samen met onze experts.

    • Je optimaliseert bestaande content om vindbaarheid en relevantie te verbeteren.

  • Social media

    • Je werkt mee aan de langetermijnstrategie voor LinkedIn en nieuwe kanalen waar onze doelgroep te vinden is, met als doel meer awareness en groei van ons bereik.

  • Event marketing

    • Je bedenkt, organiseert en voert professionele evenementen uit samen met onze vendoren en partners, waar klanten graag naartoe komen.

  • Marketing support

    • Je ondersteunt het marketingteam bij digitale campagnes binnen de Nomios Groep en draagt bij aan de verbetering van onze website.

    • Je werkt met tools zoals HubSpot, Canva, Craft CMS, Google Analytics en Google Ads.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • 3 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in (digitale) B2B-marketing.

  • Ervaring in de IT-branche is zeer wenselijk; ervaring in cybersecurity is een pré, geen must.

  • Ervaring met vendor- of partnermarketing, bijvoorbeeld met gezamenlijke campagnes en marketingfondsen, is een pré.

  • Je bouwt makkelijk relaties op met vendoren, partners en collega's. Je bent initiatiefrijk, creatief en resultaatgericht.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en nauwkeurig en houdt overzicht over meerdere campagnes tegelijk.

  • Nederlands is je moedertaal en je beheerst het Engels uitstekend, in woord en geschrift.

  • Hybride rol: bij voorkeur 3 dagen op kantoor in Zoeterwoude en 2 dagen thuis.

Top, duidelijk. Vertel, waarom Nomios?

Bij Nomios krijg je de vrijheid om je creativiteit en kennis toe te passen binnen een snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. Je werkt met grote, toonaangevende klanten en met de belangrijkste vendoren in cybersecurity en networking. Je zit niet in een uitvoerende rol aan de zijlijn: je bepaalt mee welke campagnes we draaien en ziet direct wat ze opleveren. En er is volop ruimte om te groeien in je rol.

title: Mediengestalter Web & Digital (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Du kennst deinen Bereich. Du weißt, wie digitale Designs wirklich funktionieren, nicht nur optisch, sondern technisch, strukturell und im Kontext einer echten User Journey. Bei uns bekommst du die Verantwortung, das auch zu zeigen.

  • Volle Ownership über deine Projekte
    Von der ersten Skizze in Figma bis zur fertigen Umsetzung im CMS: Du trägst die Verantwortung für deine Projekte. Kein Design-by-Committee, keine fünf Feedback-Runden, bevor du anfangen kannst.
  • Professionelles Tool-Setup
    Adobe Creative Cloud inklusive, auch zur privaten Nutzung. Dazu Zugang zu Premium-Bibliotheken wie Freepik und Mobbin, damit du nicht bei null anfängst, wenn du Inspiration oder Assets brauchst.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    MacBook oder Windows-Tower, du entscheidest. Dazu 4K-Monitore, auf denen Pixel-Perfect-Arbeit auch wirklich Sinn ergibt, und ein ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch. Falls du noch anderes Equipment brauchst, sag einfach Bescheid.
  • Große Reichweite, direktes Feedback
    15.000 Website-Klicks täglich. Deine Designs verschwinden nicht in der Schublade, sie werden gesehen, getestet und verbessert. Du siehst schnell, was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit und kurze Wege
    Du arbeitest in einem überschaubaren Team direkt mit UX, Frontend-Entwicklung und Performance-Marketing zusammen. Klare Ansprechpersonen, keine Hierarchieschleifen, damit gute Ideen nicht in langen Abstimmungen versanden. Auch mit der Geschäftsführung sprichst du direkt.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Ob Landingpage, Social-Media-Asset oder komplexes Webmodul: Als Mediengestalter Web & Digital (w/m/d) gestaltest du, was unsere Nutzer:innen sehen, und sorgst dafür, dass es nicht nur gut aussieht, sondern auch funktioniert, konvertiert und auf jedem Gerät stimmt.

  • Konzeption & Gestaltung von Landingpages
    Du entwickelst Screendesigns und Prototypen in Figma für neue Landingpages und Weblayouts, die auf Desktop, Tablet und Smartphone funktionieren, mit klarem Blick auf Conversion, Nutzerführung und visuelle Konsistenz.
  • Technische Umsetzung deiner Designs
    Du setzt Webmodule, Sections oder komplette Landingpages selbst in WordPress mit Elementor um und weißt, was Responsivität wirklich bedeutet. Wenn du HTML und CSS beherrschst, greifst du bei Bedarf auch selbst in den Code.
  • Design digitaler Assets
    Banner, Icons, Illustrationen, Infografiken: Für Website, Blog, Social Media und Ad-Kampagnen lieferst du Assets, die zur Marke passen, technisch sauber sind und im jeweiligen Kontext funktionieren.
  • Pflege des Design-Systems
    Du hilfst aktiv dabei, unser Design-System in Figma aufzubauen, zu dokumentieren und aktuell zu halten, damit die Konsistenz über alle digitalen Kanäle gewährleistet bleibt.
  • UI/UX-Optimierung
    Du analysierst bestehende Interfaces und entwickelst konkrete Vorschläge für bessere Lesbarkeit, intuitivere Navigation und höhere Conversion.
  • Pixel-Perfect-Design-Checks
    Du prüfst, ob die Umsetzung durch das Frontend-Team deinem Design wirklich entspricht, und gibst präzises Feedback, falls nicht.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Materialauswahl
    Du bearbeitest Bilder, wählst passendes Stockmaterial aus und sorgst dafür, dass alles stilistisch stimmig und markentreu bleibt.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern ein Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Wir suchen jemanden, der digitale Designs nicht nur erstellt, sondern versteht: Was funktioniert auf Mobile? Warum springen Nutzer:innen hier ab? Wie baut man ein Design-System, das wirklich genutzt wird? Und wir suchen jemanden, der bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Erfahrung in der Gestaltung digitaler Oberflächen
    Du hast bereits Weblayouts, Apps, Dashboards oder responsive Landingpages gestaltet, die live gegangen sind, und kannst sie uns in deinem Portfolio zeigen. Du kennst die Spielregeln.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Figma-Profi
    Figma ist dein tägliches Handwerkszeug. Auto-Layout, Komponenten, Prototyping, Design-System-Strukturen: Das sind keine Features, die du nachschlägst, sondern Dinge, die du einfach machst.
  • Technisches Verständnis
    Du verstehst die technische Seite deiner Arbeit. Du weißt, was in einem CMS umsetzbar ist, wie dein Design im Browser landet und hast schon mit Page-Buildern wie Elementor gearbeitet.
  • Scharfes Auge für Layout & Typografie
    Schrift, Farben, Abstände, Kontraste: Du kombinierst sie so, dass Designs klar, modern und stimmig wirken. Und du erkennst sofort, wenn etwas nicht stimmt.
  • Eigenverantwortung & Struktur
    Du weißt, wie man Projekte priorisiert, Feedback einarbeitet und Designs im Team fertigstellt, ohne dass jemand ständig nachfragen muss, wo du stehst.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Du kannst Design-Entscheidungen begründen, Feedback geben und annehmen und triffst klare Absprachen mit UX, Frontend und Marketing. Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie handwerkliches Können: Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, neue Tools und Methoden auszuprobieren und dich fachlich wie menschlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.
  • Plus: HTML/CSS-Kenntnisse
    Kein Muss, aber ein echtes Plus. Wer kleinere Anpassungen selbst umsetzen kann, arbeitet schneller und unabhängiger.
  • Plus: Print-Kenntnisse
    Absolut kein Muss, aber ab und zu fallen einzelne Print-Aufträge an, und sei es nur das Bestellen neuer Pullis, Stifte, Blöcke oder Briefpapier.

title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen.

Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten.

  • Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen.

  • Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag.

  • Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt.

  • Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert.

  • Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit.

  • Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan.

  • 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen.

  • Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

  • Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage.

  • De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt.

  • Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen.

  • Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool.

  • Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré.

  • Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen.

  • Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Follo?

Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact.

  • Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong.

  • AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows.

  • Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders.

  • Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities.

Zin om bij Follo te werken?

title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema.

Warum diese Rolle

Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf.

  • Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben.

  • Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden.

  • Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows.

  • Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen.

  • Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche.

  • Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment.

  • Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.

  • Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten.

  • Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert.

Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Analytics und Engineering, also auf Datenanbindung, Datenmodellen, Berichten und Governance. Sie setzen selbst um und klären die Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen. Data Science und Machine Learning spielen in dieser Aufbauphase eine Nebenrolle.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Praxis mit Power BI aus zwei bis drei Jahren oder mehr: Power Query, DAX und Datenmodellierung

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric, etwa mit Lakehouse, Data Factory oder Dataflows Gen2, sowie sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Erfahrung im Auf- oder Ausbau von BI-Lösungen im eigenen Unternehmen, gern auch als einzige Person für das Thema in einem kleineren Haus

  • Freude daran, mit Fachbereichen Anforderungen zu klären und Wissen weiterzugeben

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit den internationalen Standorten

  • Von Vorteil: Verständnis von SAP-Daten (ECC oder S/4HANA) sowie Zertifizierungen wie PL-300, DP-600 oder DP-700

Das erwartet Sie

  • Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Eintritt ab Anfang 2027.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Microsoft-Zertifizierungen

title: Mid Market Sales Manager (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time.

You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers.

You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Mobile Application Developer
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
