title: National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei Tekpoint

Du kennst den deutschen DIY-Handel, verfügst über ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern und weißt, wie man Marken erfolgreich im Baumarktgeschäft positioniert? Du verstehst die Strukturen des Handels, kennst die Abläufe im Zentraleinkauf und weißt, worauf es bei Listungen, Sortimenten, Platzierungen und der Umsetzung am Point of Sale ankommt?

Dann suchen wir dich.

Als National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die strategische und operative Entwicklung unserer bestehenden Handelspartner sowie die Gewinnung neuer Kunden im deutschen DIY-Markt. Du entwickelst Geschäftsbeziehungen auf zentraler Ebene weiter, erschließt neue Umsatzpotenziale und baust die Distribution unserer Marken und Produkte nachhaltig aus.

Dabei arbeitest du mit einem vielseitigen Portfolio namhafter Technologiemarken wie Roborock, Segway Navimow, Xiaomi und Govee sowie weiteren innovativen Marken und Produktkategorien. Von Bodenpflege und Rasenrobotik über Beleuchtung bis hin zu weiteren Consumer-Electronics- und Home-Technologie-Produkten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren Handelspartnern attraktive Sortimente und erfolgreiche Vermarktungskonzepte.

Du verbindest strategisches Key Account Management mit ausgeprägter Neukundenorientierung und einem tiefen Verständnis für die operativen Anforderungen des deutschen DIY-Handels. Du weißt, wie Entscheidungen im Zentraleinkauf getroffen werden, wie regionale Strukturen funktionieren und wie aus einer Listung ein nachhaltig erfolgreiches Geschäft entsteht.

Bei der Umsetzung deiner Kundenstrategien arbeitest du eng mit unserem Area Sales Management sowie den internen Teams aus Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an den Director Sales Deutschland und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unseres DIY-Geschäfts aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Key Account Management & Geschäftsentwicklung

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für bestehende Key Accounts und entwickelst diese strategisch und operativ weiter.

  • Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Handelspartner und erschließt zusätzliche Geschäftspotenziale im deutschen DIY-Markt.

  • Du baust nachhaltige Geschäftsbeziehungen zu relevanten Entscheidern im Zentraleinkauf und Category Management auf und entwickelst dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du erarbeitest kundenindividuelle Geschäfts- und Wachstumspläne und setzt diese konsequent um.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kunden neue Sortiments-, Listungs- und Vermarktungsmöglichkeiten für unser Markenportfolio.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz-, Absatz- und Margenentwicklung deiner Accounts und stellst eine nachhaltige, profitable Geschäftsentwicklung sicher.

2. Kundenbeziehungen, Verhandlungen & Vertragsmanagement

  • Du führst Jahresgespräche, Sortimentsverhandlungen und Vertragsverhandlungen eigenständig und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Du verhandelst Listungen, Konditionen, Rahmenvereinbarungen, Marketingbudgets und Promotions.

  • Du verstehst die Entscheidungswege und Prozesse deiner Handelspartner und nutzt dieses Wissen gezielt zur Weiterentwicklung der Geschäftsbeziehungen.

  • Du identifizierst zusätzliche Potenziale innerhalb bestehender Kundenorganisationen und baust die Zusammenarbeit auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen aus.

  • Du entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften, erkennst Marktchancen frühzeitig und setzt diese in konkrete Geschäftsergebnisse um.

3. Sortimentsentwicklung, Distribution & Point of Sale

  • Du treibst die Listung und den Ausbau unserer Marken und Produktkategorien bei relevanten DIY-Handelspartnern voran.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Kunden attraktive Sortimente und überzeugende Produktplatzierungen.

  • Du kennst die Abläufe und Anforderungen im deutschen Baumarkthandel und weißt, wie nationale Vereinbarungen in die regionalen Strukturen und Märkte übertragen werden.

  • Du verhandelst und koordinierst Regalplatzierungen, Zweitplatzierungen, Aktionsflächen und saisonale Verkaufsmaßnahmen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Area Sales Management zusammen, um vereinbarte Maßnahmen in den Märkten erfolgreich umzusetzen.

  • Du analysierst Sell-in- und Sell-out-Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Distribution, Abverkauf und Markenpräsenz ab.

  • Du begleitest Produkteinführungen und entwickelst neue Vermarktungsansätze für unser vielseitiges Marken- und Produktportfolio.

4. Markt- und Kundenentwicklung

  • Du beobachtest Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Sortimentsentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

  • Du analysierst Kundenpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für die Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner.

  • Du baust bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen aus und erschließt zusätzliche Umsatzpotenziale durch neue Produkte, Sortimente und Vertriebskonzepte.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsame Wachstumsinitiativen mit unseren Handelspartnern und überführst diese in konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du bringst deine Marktkenntnis und dein Netzwerk aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsstrategie ein.

5. Steuerung & Zusammenarbeit

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz-, Margen- und Budgetplanung deiner Accounts sowie eine belastbare Forecast-Qualität.

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Area Sales Management, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Warenverfügbarkeit, Lieferperformance und interne Prozesse die vereinbarten Kundenaktivitäten unterstützen.

  • Du überwachst relevante KPIs, erstellst Business Reviews und leitest bei Abweichungen geeignete Maßnahmen ein.

  • Du berichtest regelmäßig an den Director Sales Deutschland und sorgst für Transparenz über Geschäftsentwicklung, Kundenpotenziale und Vertriebsmaßnahmen.

Das bringst du mit

Deine fachliche Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige, erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im Key Account Management des deutschen DIY-Handels.

  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern im deutschen Baumarkthandel, insbesondere im Zentraleinkauf und Category Management.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Strukturen, Entscheidungswege und Abläufe deutscher Baumarktketten sowie idealerweise regionaler Handelsorganisationen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Gewinnung neuer Kunden, der Umsetzung von Listungen und dem Ausbau bestehender Geschäftsbeziehungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresgesprächen, Konditionsverhandlungen, Sortimentsentscheidungen und der wirtschaftlichen Steuerung von Kundenaccounts.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Distribution, Platzierungsmanagement, POS-Aktivierung und Sell-out-Steuerung.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Vertriebsstrukturen und im Zusammenspiel zwischen zentralen Vereinbarungen und deren Umsetzung in den Märkten.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke und ein sicherer Umgang mit Umsatz-, Margen- und Abverkaufsdaten.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung bei einem Markenhersteller oder Lieferanten aus dem DIY-, Home-, Garden- oder Consumer-Electronics-Umfeld mit. Entscheidend ist nicht, dass du bereits exakt unsere Produktkategorien betreut hast, sondern dass du den deutschen DIY-Handel verstehst, über die richtigen Kontakte verfügst und nachweislich Geschäft entwickeln kannst.

Deine Persönlichkeit

  • Du bist eine überzeugende Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die auf Augenhöhe mit Einkäufern und Entscheidern kommuniziert.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktchancen und kommerzielle Zusammenhänge.

  • Du kombinierst strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzungsstärke und einem ausgeprägten Abschlusswillen.

  • Du gehst aktiv auf neue Kunden zu, baust Netzwerke aus und entwickelst bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du verhandelst souverän, handelst unternehmerisch und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen Verhandlungen deine Ziele im Blick.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Kunden und Ergebnisse.

  • Du schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team und weißt, wie du gemeinsam mit dem Area Sales Management und internen Schnittstellen nachhaltiges Wachstum erzielst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die Entwicklung unseres Geschäfts im deutschen DIY-Markt.

  • Die Möglichkeit, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen auszubauen und neue Handelspartner für unser Markenportfolio zu gewinnen.

title: Optimisation Engineer, Routing & Scheduling
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Millions of parcels, thousands of couriers, and routing, pricing and scheduling decisions needed in real time and under uncertainty. Relay's last mile is a growing optimisation problem that never sits still.

Relay's in-house solver has carried the business through more than 100x growth, built by a team of Operational Research Scientists who designed the decision architecture the network runs on. You'll join them and take it further.

Optimisation Highlights

  • An in-house solver, built and owned by our own Operational Research team, running live at scale.

  • Routing, pricing and scheduling decisions made in real time and under uncertainty.

  • ML and recommender intelligence integrated into the decision models.

  • A flexible network: pitstops can change, warehouse automation can be reconfigured, and new processes roll out overnight.

The Opportunity

As an Optimisation Engineer at Relay, you'll:

  • Lead optimisation for Relay's last mile, making the best routing, pricing and scheduling decisions for couriers and the wider network.

  • Model and optimise the decisions that define our last-mile delivery network and marketplace.

  • Develop our solvers and algorithms so they perform live, and at scale.

  • Partner with other Scientists to unite ML and recommender systems with Operational Research.

  • Raise the standard for Operational Research at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in operational research, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from operational research or industrial engineering, or from an advanced quantitative discipline, including trading, that has branched into optimisation.

  • Have built optimisation systems or ML models that run in production, and owned the outcome.

  • Are energised by large, messy problems, and know how to bring structure to them.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

descriptionHtml:
About Quandela

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

Requirements

  • Enrollment for the whole duration of the internship in a MSc in Physics, Telecom/Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Quantum Technologies or related fields. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement.
  • Minimal duration is 5 months. Shorter internship will not be accepted.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good.

  • Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state.

  • Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets.

  • Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM.

  • Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team.

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, security operations, SRE, infrastructure or platform engineering, including some exposure to a cloud environment (AWS, GCP or Azure) in production — an internship or apprenticeship in one of those roles counts.

  • Work daily with infrastructure as code and GitHub: you have written and shipped your own Terraform through reviewed pull requests, and you are comfortable operating and debugging workloads on Kubernetes.

  • Use AI coding assistants (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you work.

  • Have carried at least one project through to production — security or not — and stayed with it past the first deployment until it was actually adopted.

  • Have solid fundamentals: Linux, networking, cloud, Kubernetes and development/scripting, a pragmatic mindset, the ability to make decisions under uncertainty and follow through, and strong written communication skills — you can carry a proposal from draft to cross-team adoption.

  • Are fluent in English (working language in writing); daily team conversations happen mostly in French, so being a French speaker or willing to learn is a strong plus.

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have worked with a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk, or equivalent), writing and tuning your own queries.

  • Have done detection engineering, incident response, threat hunting, or CTFs.

  • Can point to public write-ups, open-source contributions, or a home lab.

  • Have prior experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, or public sector).

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

title: PR Manager DE
descriptionHtml:
A fight lasts minutes. A great story travels much further.

The comeback nobody saw coming. The rivalry that divides an arena. The person behind the fighter, with a story that deserves to reach people who have never watched MMA.

At OKTAGON, those stories are everywhere.

We’re building a sports brand with international ambitions, passionate fans and events that bring thousands of people together. Germany is a major part of that journey. And we’re looking for a PR Manager who knows how to make our stories matter to German media.

Someone who can earn the trust of a sports editor, spot an angle for a business title and understand why a digital format might reach an audience a traditional press release never will.

You’ll help decide which stories we tell, who we tell them to and how far they go.

Your stories need to travel beyond the cage.

Sports media will be your home ground. But your curiosity should take you further.

A fighter’s journey can belong in a mainstream interview. Our growth can start a business conversation. Training, personality and culture can open doors to fitness and lifestyle coverage.

You’ll find those opportunities and turn them into pitches that give each outlet a reason to care.

Here’s what you’ll take ownership of:

  • Build real relationships with German media. Develop and maintain a network across sports, digital and mainstream outlets. Get to know the journalists, their audiences and the stories they actually want.

  • Earn coverage for OKTAGON, our events and our fighters. Create opportunities around upcoming fights and recognise stories that deserve attention outside the event calendar.

  • Find new routes to our audience. Follow how the media landscape is changing, from digital publishers and podcasts to emerging editorial formats. Know where a story will work and adapt it accordingly.

  • Create sharp German press materials. Write press releases, translate and localise event Media Info Cards, research fight cards and prepare tailored angles for individual outlets.

  • Make interviews happen. Connect journalists with fighters, coordinate opportunities and prepare written interviews when needed.

  • Get the right assets into the right hands. Distribute photos, video and relevant information, including captioned fight photography for dpa-picture alliance and Imago.

  • Keep the foundations organised. Own accreditations, maintain the media database and keep fighter information accurate and up to date.

  • Show what your work achieves. Monitor online and offline coverage, prepare monthly reports and summarise results after German events. Use what you learn to improve the next campaign.

  • Keep our communication connected. Work closely with the PR lead, Marketing DE and Social Media so our messaging stays consistent, including across German-language video content.

When fight week starts, you’re in the middle of it.

The plans are ready. The journalists arrive. Interview requests change. A result creates a new headline.

You’ll be the person who keeps media operations moving.

At German events, that means overseeing accreditations and the media room, coordinating interviews, supporting weigh-ins and press conferences, and making sure journalists have what they need before and after the fights. Where needed, you may also moderate a press conference.

You’ll handle post-fight releases, follow-ups and coverage reviews. During selected events outside Germany, you’ll be available for relevant German media requests and breaking stories.

And when a sensitive situation comes up, you’ll be the first point of contact for German media, working closely with the PR lead on the response.

This role includes travel and weekend work. Fight weeks can run from Thursday through Sunday, and you need to be comfortable with the pace and responsibility that come with live events.

What you bring into the team

You already know how a newsroom works. You understand deadlines, editorial judgement and the difference between a story we want to tell and a story someone will want to publish.

We’re looking for:

  • At least 2–4 years of relevant experience in PR or sports journalism. You’ve pitched stories, worked with journalists and delivered under pressure.

  • An existing network in German sports newsrooms. Relationships you can build on, alongside the initiative to open new doors.

  • Native-level German and very good English. Your German writing is precise, natural and adaptable. You’re comfortable collaborating with an international team in English.

  • Strong editorial instincts. You can spot an angle, ask the useful question and turn a complicated story into a clear pitch.

  • Digital confidence. You understand how people discover and consume stories today and stay curious about what is changing.

  • Independence and ownership. You can organise your work remotely, follow through on commitments and keep colleagues informed.

  • Willingness to travel and work weekends. You want to be there when the action happens.

An interest in MMA or combat sports, experience with press conferences and crisis communication, and a driving licence are all advantages.

You don’t need to know every fighter’s record on day one. You do need the curiosity to learn the sport and understand the people in it.

Ready to tell the next story?

Send us your CV (English version) or LinkedIn profile and a few examples of your work: coverage you secured, a campaign you helped deliver or journalism you’re proud of.

Tell us what you contributed and why it worked.

We’d also love to hear what interests you about bringing OKTAGON’s stories to German audiences.

Let’s talk.

title: Prediction Model Expert
descriptionHtml:
About the Role



As a Prediction Model Expert, you bring deep expertise in AI forecasting, software development in Python, backed by a dissertation on prediction models or time series forecasting. You have hands-on experience with foundation models for forecasting, multi-modal prediction frameworks (can be across disciplines like medicine), cloud environments. You excel at building production-grade prediction engines that detect anomalies, forecast threats, and power proactive threat detection logic at compute scale.

You will be one of Haste's first senior AI researchers pioneering prediction models that anticipate stealthy threats across HPC clusters, AI and quantum workloads before they strike.

Key Responsibilities

  • Predictive Model Development & Engineering: Designing, building, and deploying Machine Learning (ML) and Foundation models to forecast potential security breaches.
  • Anomaly Detection & Behavior Analysis: Establishing "normal" baselines and flagging deviations that indicate malicious behaviour together with our security experts and research teams.
  • Threat Intelligence & Forecasting: Analyzing historical data, threat intelligence feeds, to extract and predict future attack trends, emerging vulnerabilities, and malicious campaigns.
  • Vulnerability & Risk Assessment: Scoring and prioritizing security vulnerabilities (e.g., predicting which CVSS vulnerabilities are most likely to be exploited) to guide risk-based view.
  • Data Pipeline Construction: Managing the full lifecycle of data, including gathering, cleaning, and processing vast amounts of diverse data sources like network logs, indicators of compromise, and threat intel.
  • Model Optimization & Maintenance: Continuously refining algorithms, hyperparameter tuning, and adapting models to combat "model drift" as attacker tactics evolve.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Translating complex mathematical models into actionable insights, and producing research reports, white papers, or conference presentations.

title: Principal Engineer, Growth Mega Alliance (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The Role

The Growth Mega Alliance (GMA) builds the platforms that power how HelloFresh acquires, converts, and retains customers across 18 markets and multiple brands, across five pillars: AdTech, Conversions, Payments, Communications, and Customer Value Optimization (CVO).

As Principal Engineer, you are the technical visionary for these platforms. You define architectural direction across all five pillars, lead the most consequential cross-cutting initiatives, and raise the technical bar for the entire organization. This is a hands-on leadership role - you code, review, and design alongside the senior and staff engineers who look to you as the technical lead.

What You'll Do

GenAI & Agentic Engineering Leadership

  • Own GMA's GenAI strategy: identify the highest-leverage opportunities across all five pillars where AI/ML unlocks step-change outcomes, for both engineering productivity and customer-facing capabilities.
  • Establish agentic development workflows — where specs drive AI-assisted code generation — and scale them from early adopters to standard practice. Build the guardrails and reference architectures that enable squads to work AI-natively.
  • Develop and articulate a clear point of view on how engineering teams need to evolve in skills, process, and culture to realize the gains that agentic tools make possible.

Growth Platform Architecture

  • Own the long-term technical architecture across GMA's five pillars: real-time personalization, experimentation at scale, AI/ML-driven automation, and cross-pillar data integrity.
  • Lead the most complex architectural decisions (shared identity schemas, experiment assignment, AdTech-to-Conversions signal loops, payment authorization flows) and drive migrations with large impact.
  • Ensure GMA platforms integrate cleanly with internal infrastructure and meet reliability, latency, and observability requirements at a global scale. 

Experimentation & Personalization

  • Define GMA's experimentation strategy and execution framework to optimize experimentation-based decision-making at scale.
  • Own the data path from customer event to business decision: instrumentation standards, identity resolution, attribution windows, and signal quality.

Technical Strategy & Cross-Alliance Collaboration

  • Define GMA's multi-year technical vision and communicate it with the precision engineers need and the clarity executives can act on. Represent GMA in company-wide programs.
  • Partner with Intelligent Platforms, Consumer, and Operations Mega Alliances to drive shared architectural standards and prevent fragmentation.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

  • Coach and grow Staff and Senior Engineers across all five pillars. Foster engineering excellence through rigorous design review, strong observability practice, and honest post-incident learning.
  • Champion AI-native development workflows, TDD, DDD, and DevSecOps. Set the written communication standard through your design docs and architectural decision records.

What You'll Bring

GenAI & Agentic Engineering

  • Practical, hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) in production or near-production environments — not just experimentation.
  • Experience integrating GenAI into customer-facing products or internal business processes at scale, with a clear point of view on the team and cultural changes required to realize the productivity gains.

Growth Domain Expertise

  • Deep familiarity with at least two of: AdTech / paid media infrastructure, funnel optimization, payment orchestration, CRM and lifecycle communications, or pricing and incentive optimization.
  • Fluent in growth domain constraints: PSP behavior, consent and privacy requirements across markets, deliverability limits, attribution windows, and incrementality measurement. Experience in a multi-market subscription or e-commerce business preferred.

Technical Depth

  • ~10+ years in software engineering, with ~5+ years at principal level in a high-growth, cloud-native environment.
  • Expert in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven patterns (Kafka). Deep AWS experience. Strong proficiency in Go, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.
  • Track record of designing and operating large-scale, multi-region systems. Comfortable doing hands-on architectural reviews and solving critical bottlenecks directly.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation design and analysis; able to work directly with data (SQL, BI tooling) and trace the full signal chain from instrumentation to business metric.

Ways of Working

  • Exceptional written communication — your documents make complexity smaller, not larger.
  • Able to influence without authority; direct, low-ego, and comfortable disagreeing with senior stakeholders while keeping the relationship intact.
  • Fluent English. German is a bonus.

What Success Looks Like

3 months — You have mapped GMA's critical architectural dependencies and GenAI opportunities, conducted design reviews across multiple pillars, and established a point of view on the highest-leverage technical bets for the year.

6 months — Your architectural direction is reflected in roadmaps. GMA's first AI-native workflows are in production. At least one cross-pillar initiative is running under your technical ownership with clear instrumentation.

12 months — GMA's platforms are measurably more scalable, observable, and AI-capable. Engineering standards are set and followed. You are the person leaders across HelloTech bring their hardest growth-engineering problems to.

Why Work With Us

  • Make an Impact: GMA's platforms touch every customer HelloFresh acquires and every euro it collects. Your decisions move top-line numbers at a company that has changed the way millions of people eat.
  • Real Scope: You own technical direction, make consequential architectural calls, and ship things that matter — at a scale that makes the problems genuinely hard.
  • AI at the Frontier: You will have the mandate, resources, and organizational support to lead AI-native engineering transformation — not advocate for it from the sidelines.
  • Direct Access: You work daily with engineering, product, and business leadership, with the visibility and accountability that implies.
  • Learn & Grow: Annual learning budget, HelloFresh Academy, and internal mobility across a large, technically ambitious engineering organization.

title: Principal Researcher
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash’s current and future products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal Researcher to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You’ll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You’ll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You’ll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You’ll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy: Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You’ll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities: Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You’ll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research: Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You’ll triangulate across sources so the “what,” the “how much,” and the “why” tell one coherent story.

Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the “why” behind results. You’ll help teams learn from what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next.

Apply AI to the Research Craft: Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You’ll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You’ll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash’s products.

Influence and Communicate: Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. You’ll adapt depth and format to the moment, from a fast directional read that unblocks a team this week to a foundational body of work that anchors a multi-year strategy, and you’ll follow through to see that findings change what gets built.

Lead Through Others: Serve as a thought partner and mentor to researchers across levels, review and elevate research quality, and help partners run good research on their own where that makes sense. You’ll help set the team’s research agenda, methods, and standards, and contribute to hiring and growing the team.

Operate Across Brands and Regions: Bring a global lens to your work, partnering across brands, markets, and cultures and adapting approaches to local context so that insights scale beyond a single market.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in user, market, or product research at a technology company (or equivalent depth), with a track record of leading ambiguous, high-visibility work at staff level or above
  • Demonstrated impact on product strategy: examples where your research changed a roadmap, unlocked a new product or line of business, or redirected significant investment
  • Proven ability to detect and shape new product or growth opportunities, from early signal through validated concept
  • Expert command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, ethnography, and usability testing as well as survey design, statistical analysis, and experimentation. Working knowledge of SQL, R, or Python for pulling and analyzing your own data is a plus
  • Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in research (for example, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, or scaling qualitative work), with sound instincts about where they help and where they mislead. Experience researching AI-powered products is a plus
  • Experience in consumer, two-sided or multi-sided marketplace, logistics, commerce, or local services contexts is a plus
  • Exceptional storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and build trust across product, design, engineering, data science, and business teams
  • A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor
  • Experience mentoring or coaching researchers and raising the quality of a research practice
  • Advanced degree in HCI, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Statistics, Survey Methodology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Rohlik Group

Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.

We believe the world needs a better food system: more sustainable, more inclusive, and bringing healthier, more personalised food to everyone. In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.

About the Team

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

 

What We Offer

  • Unlimited Vacation: Unlimited vacation days for a balanced work-life balance

  • Tax-Free Benefits: Monthly vouchers of €45 tax-free (via become.1)

  • Remote Allowance: €20 monthly allowance towards internet costs

  • Exclusive Shopping Perk: Knuspr Xtra account with 10% cashback in the form of Knuspr Credits

  • Corporate Discounts: Great discounts via CorporateBenefits (fitness, travel, tickets, shopping, and much more)

 

What You'll Do

  • Identify improvement potential across the fulfillment network — on the floor, in the data, and with operations teams — wherever automation or process redesign can meaningfully improve cost, throughput, quality or safety

  • Own the business case for each opportunity: quantify throughput gains and labour impact, calculate payback period, prepare capex/opex estimates, and defend the investment to senior stakeholders

  • Own the full solution end to end, whatever form it takes — physical automation, software/control changes, or a combination of both

  • Standardise delivered work into reusable templates, playbooks and best practices that accelerate future projects

  • Lead implementation from design through testing, installation, integration and piloting, coordinating internal teams, vendors and contractors to deliver a working solution on site

  • Partner with Procurement and Operations across the full lifecycle — from requirements, RFIs/RFQs, vendor evaluation and commercial negotiation, through to a clean handover with documentation, SOPs, support processes and training for operational teams

  • Feed insights from delivered projects into the group automation roadmap and warehouse planning concepts

  • Support site and regional leadership by translating process and performance data into prioritised improvement opportunities

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Degree in engineering, a technical/analytical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics), or an equivalent completed vocational training (Ausbildung) / relevant hands-on experience

  • 3+ years of experience in warehouse automation (e.g., robotics, AMRs, AutoStore, sorters, conveyors, packing systems) and process improvement, including end-to-end project ownership from concept to handover

  • Strong analytical skills, capable of both spreadsheet business modeling and floor-level process evaluation

  • Proven project management ability to align Operations, Engineering, Finance, and external vendors

  • Strong negotiation and engagement skills with third-party vendors and contractors

  • Broad interest in both the hardware and software sides of automation

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken)

  • Willingness to spend regular time on-site at fulfillment centers

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with control logic, orchestration software or WMS integration

  • Working knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

At incident.io, what you build is yours: the whole loop, from hearing directly from customers what's worth building, to building it, with the trust to run with it and make something you're actually proud of.

What that looks like day to day

You'll spend real time in the codebase, but also on calls with customers, in Slack threads with them, reading their feedback. Understanding what customers need matters as much as building it. Once something's yours, it's yours end to end: the design and planning, the implementation, the testing, the delivery, and the follow up conversation with the customer who asked for it.

Day to day you're working in Go, TypeScript and React. That's just what we use, not a requirement for what you've used before. We care about how you think, not which stack you've clocked hours in.

We build with AI, not around it. Claude Code, Cursor, and Wispr are all standard kit here.

Flat structure, no ladder. People come from all kinds of backgrounds: some have founded companies, some have been CTOs, some are earlier in their careers. Here everyone's the same thing: a builder. The only thing that actually matters is whether you're curious about how the whole thing works, not just your bit of it.

Who you are

  • "If not me, then who" is basically how you operate. You don't wait around for something to be officially yours before you deal with it.

  • You own your work, but you build as a team. You unblock people, back your teammates up, and care as much about the team shipping great things as about your own bit of it.

  • You spot things before anyone asks you to. If a customer's about to notice a problem, you've usually already fixed it.

  • You communicate clearly, whether that's a Slack message to a customer, a design doc, or explaining a tricky trade off to your team.

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity, not just tolerant of it. Early ideation, half formed problems, and shifting priorities don't throw you off.

  • You share work when it's about 70% done, not 100%: drafts, MVPs, rough cuts, because you'd rather get feedback early than polish something in isolation.

  • You’re product minded, not just technically minded. You have real opinions about what should get built and why, and you share them, but you’re just as quick to change your mind when someone makes a better case.

  • You adapt fast. Feedback changes your plan, not your mood.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - Pierre & Vacances : a fiabilisé et unifié ses données clients en 13 semaines grâce au développement d’un MVP de plateforme client unifiée intégrant matching, traçabilité et architecture scalable. Une équipe mixte de 5 experts Theodo a consolidé des flux batch et temps réel multi-sources, structuré la gouvernance via tests automatisés et dashboards métier, et conçu une architecture évolutive capable d’intégrer rapidement de nouveaux outils, pour un pilotage business plus fiable et en continu. - Carrefour : conçu et déployé en 9 semaines Store Adaptor, un moteur algorithmique de recommandation d’assortiment pour 1 200 magasins, afin d’optimiser l’espace et la rentabilité. Une équipe mixte de 5 experts Theodo a développé deux algorithmes (prévision des KPI et optimisation des briques d’assortiment) capables de traiter des volumes massifs de données et de s’adapter à la diversité des formats de magasins. Résultat : +7,5 % de chiffre d’affaires. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? title: Product Manager digital learning
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Compani accompagne les structures du médico-social (EHPAD, services d’aide et de soins à domicile, structures du handicap) à recruter, diplômer et fidéliser leurs professionnels, via des parcours de formation qui transforment les pratiques à l’échelle des professionnels, des équipes et des structures.

Société à mission, nous sommes convaincus que les métiers de l’aide et du soin sont des métiers d’avenir, que l’on devrait être fier de choisir, d’apprendre et d’aimer. Au cœur de notre ADN pédagogique ? Le terrain comme source d’apprentissage et la compétence relationnelle que l’on transmet avec la même exigence qu’un geste technique de soin. Aujourd’hui, nous avons accompagné plus de 700 structures et formé plus de 15 000 professionnels, avec un développement fortement accéléré depuis 2 ans.

Compani fait partie du groupe Alenvi (aide à domicile, maisons partagées pour personnes âgées avec troubles cognitifs). Nous sommes une trentaine de collaborateurs, animés par une culture de solidarité, d’autonomie et d’initiative et basés au Kawaa (café et coworking ESS, Paris Bastille).

Notre besoin

Compani a développé un logiciel SaaS propriétaire. Il permet de planifier, gérer, facturer les formations, en lien avec les formateurs et les structures. Il offre également aux apprenants une expérience digitale, sur laquelle nous souhaitons innover fortement dans les prochaines années en capitalisant sur les nouvelles technologies disponibles comme l’IA.

Nous souhaitons que l’app Compani devienne un vrai compagnon de nos apprenant·es (gestion de leur parcours, modules complémentaires, coaching…) et complète notre accompagnement pédagogique entre deux sessions animées par nos formateur·rices et coachs externes.

Ton rôle : porter la refonte de l’expérience apprenant.e via notre app, mais pas que ! Tu es la porte d’entrée vers tout ce qui concerne l’innovation pédagogique en lien avec le digital learning, avec un objectif : démultiplier l’impact de nos parcours de formation et assurer l’ancrage des apprentissages. Tu vas chercher ce qui se fait de mieux ailleurs, tu construis un réseau d’expert·es et tu ramènes cette innovation chez nous, dans notre bibliothèque pédagogique et dans notre application. Face à une IA de plus en plus standardisée, c’est toi qui construis notre singularité sur le blended. Pour que nos outils soient au service d'une vraie montée en compétences des apprenants. Le terrain de jeu est vaste !

Tes missions

🤝 Au sein du Pôle Offre, tu travailles en binôme étroit avec le·la Responsable offre pédagogique, qui construit nos nouvelles offres de formation et les BU qui les déploient auprès de nos apprenant.e.s.

Rattaché·e à la direction adjointe, tes responsabilités :

  • Tu portes la refonte de l’expérience apprenant·es dans l’application Compani : tu es le·la product manager. Tu recueilles les besoins (BU, partenaires externes) et tu construis la roadmap.
  • Tu contribues aux arbitrages et à la gouvernance produit (LMS, app), en lien avec le Pôle Offre et la tech.
  • Tu déploies la roadmap validée sur l’app, en lien avec 2 développeur·ses internes.
  • Tu contribues aux offres de formation Compani (déjà existantes et nouvelles), avec le·la responsable offre pédagogique, notamment pour les parcours blended.
  • Tu fais vivre une veille active sur l’edtech et les innovations pédagogiques : tu animes ton réseau d’expert·es, tu restes ouvert·e sur l’extérieur et tu traduis cette veille en réalité concrète pour notre secteur et nos offres de formation, en te demandant ce qui est possible avec notre public d’apprenant·es et ce qui apporte réellement de la valeur dans l’apprentissage.

Ce qui te fera aimer ce poste 💛

  • Une mission à impact : chaque outil que tu déploies touche des milliers de soignant·es et d’aidant·es
  • Un terrain de jeu à construire : un pôle récent en transformation, une app à refondre, une bibliothèque d’innovations à créer
  • Une double casquette rare : pédagogie et produit, recherche et terrain
  • Une vraie liberté d’initiative et une démarche entrepreneuriale pour inventer nos façons de faire
  • Une équipe engagée, collaborative, avec le sourire 😄

Profil recherché

🔎 Ce job est fait pour toi si :

  • Tu as au moins 5 ans d’expérience en product management, de préférence dans une edtech. Ce sont tes réalisations qui nous intéressent ;
  • La tech et l’IA, tu les pratiques déjà au quotidien, pas seulement en veille ;
  • Tu as déjà porté un produit numérique (discovery utilisateur, roadmap, specs, mesure d’usage, méthodes agiles) et tranché face à des développeur·ses ou des freelances : priorités, compromis, budget ;
  • Ta grande autonomie te permet d’avancer seul·e sur tes sujets ;
  • Tu es tourné·e vers l’extérieur : tu aimes aller chercher l’innovation ailleurs et faire vivre un réseau d’expert·es ;
  • Tu es une personne engagée, avec une forte appétence pour la mission de Compani et le secteur du Prendre soin ;

Comment nous rejoindre ? Le process de recrutement 👉

  • Échange téléphonique (20 min) avec Béatrice, notre responsable RH
  • Entretien avec Sara, ta future manager et un autre membre du CODIR : tu nous racontes un parcours blended que tu as conçu, puis on échange sur tes pistes d’innovation pour Compani (1 h 30 dans nos locaux)
  • Échange avec 1 ou 2 autres membres de l’équipe, dont Guillaume, cofondateur et qui pilote la tech chez nous, pour vérifier qu’on est bien aligné·es et qu’on veut vraiment aller dans le même sens
  • Prise de références

Informations pratiques

Rémunération : Entre 45 et 55 K€ selon expérience et grille salariale Compani

CDI, basé au Kawaa (Paris 12e), 3 jours de présentiel par semaine

descriptionHtml:
Job title: Product Manager (Billing)
Location: London — 3 days in office (occasional travel to Paris required) 
Team: Product Management - Billing & Payments
Reporting to: Head of Product

This role is based in London, UK and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to London. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. 

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Please submit your profile in English. 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Lead the localisation efforts for our global energy billing platform, ensuring it meets the specific regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of France, from meter read to bill.
You'll be in charge of the French localisation of the Billing Module—one of the core product domains at the heart of the Kaluza platform. The Billing module processes consumption, pricing, and account data to schedule, calculate, and generate accurate, timely, and compliant invoices throughout a customer’s lifecycle. The module automatically manages billing cycles, generates bills, handles corrections, and produces the data that feeds invoices, billing-related communications, payment schedules, and downstream financial reporting, while powering customer and agent UIs.

This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing  journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients.

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap.

  • Deep dive into French energy market regulations, translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system.

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting).

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys.

  • Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end B2C billing lifecycle including meter data, tariffs, invoicing, and debt management.

  • A track record in regulated markets where billing complexity matters, energy, telecoms, financial services, or similar. Familiarity with the French energy market (ENGIE, CRE, switching, tariff structures) is advantageous.

  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable, outcome-driven requirements for development teams.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.

  • Excellent stakeholder and client management skills, able to lead conversations across requirements, scope, expectations, and roadmap alignment, and communicate technical & market complexity clearly to varied audiences.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.Fluent in French and English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • A builder's mindset — you're autonomous, learn fast, and aren't afraid to go deep. You're comfortable interrogating a codebase with AI tools, reading an API schema or data model, and writing a SQL query to get the answer you need.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you can operate effectively when not everything is defined, know when to make a call, and aren't afraid to escalate or ask for help when it matters.

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: 

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.

We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.

It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.

This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.

 

The problem you're solving

Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.

We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

  • Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

  • Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

  • Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

  • Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

  • Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

Who you are

You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.

You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.

You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency, interruption handling, expressiveness, and consistency. You know how to make that bar concrete and defend it.

You think commercially. A new API isn't just a technical surface. It's a business, and you have instincts (or scar tissue) around how developer products get adopted, packaged, and monetized.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in product, with direct experience owning a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform product. The vertical doesn't matter, the platform depth does

  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where discovery and delivery happen in parallel and the roadmap is still being shaped

  • Strong technical fluency: you can hold a credible conversation with engineers about real-time systems, latency, and integration trade-offs, and make good calls without needing every answer handed to you

  • Strong written communication: you can write a spec, a strategy doc, or an API design rationale that others can act on without a follow-up conversation

  • Real-time / streaming media, conversational AI, or applied-AI product experience is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

  • Instinct for the commercial side of a developer product - adoption, packaging, and monetization is a plus.

  • Based in London or open to regular in-person time.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.
