descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role Overview

As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.
  • Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.
  • Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.
  • Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.
  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.
  • Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.
  • Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish.
  • A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions.
  • Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. title: Real Estate Transaction Lead, Central
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the Central region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate, US. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets.

Neko is opening clinics at pace: the US plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade.

The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

• Pipeline management: identify, evaluate, and advance sites across Central markets including Texas, Chicago, the Midwest, Nashville, and Denver. Markets are TBD and could extend west or east depending on demand.

• Transaction execution: lead deals from initial market entry through signed lease, managing brokers, landlords, and timelines, at a pace set by the opening plan for the Central region.

• LOI negotiation: draft, negotiate, and revise LOIs; own the deal process end to end from first tour to final execution.

• Deal approval memos: build and present LOI and Lease Approval Memos with clear economics, risks, and a recommendation that stands up to executive scrutiny.

• Landlord relationships: build and maintain relationships with institutional and private landlords across the Central region.

• Broker coordination: manage tenant rep broker relationships across multiple markets simultaneously; hold brokers accountable to pipeline and timeline standards.

• Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Legal, Construction, Design, and Facilities to move deals from signed lease into buildout.

• Platform adoption: use Neko’s GIS site selection platform and lease administration system as the system of record and contribute to their rollout as the function scales.

Minimum Qualifications

• 3 to 7 years of real estate transaction experience, with meaningful time spent in-house at a healthcare, wellness, or high-growth retail company.

• You have personally led deals end to end, from site identification through LOI to signed lease, in competitive markets.

• Comfort working in a startup environment with real pressure, fast timelines, and limited infrastructure. You build as you go.

• A self-starter who does not need a fully defined playbook to do great work.

• Strong communication skills. You can represent Neko professionally with institutional landlords while keeping internal stakeholders informed concisely.

• Ability to read and pressure-test lease terms, rent schedules, and deal economics. You do not need to build financial models from scratch, but you need to know when a deal works and when it does not.

• Familiarity with GIS tools and lease administration platforms is a plus; willingness to learn them quickly is a must.

• AI: We use AI tools including Claude in daily work and expect you to use them too.

• Based in the Central United States. You should be within reasonable travel of the markets you cover.

You’ll set benefits strategy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, partner directly with Finance, Legal, Payroll and our brokers, lead day-to-day benefits operations, and have real autonomy.   •         Lead benefits operations. Lead the team that runs enrollment, life events, leaves, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination. Build processes that scale without adding headcount.
  •         Use AI to reinvent the experience. Automate enrollment, eligibility checks, reconciliations and employee questions with AI agents and workflows. Make it easy for employees to understand and use what we offer.
  •         Support growth and change. Set up benefits for new countries, entity conversions from EOR, and acquisitions, with clean harmonization plans.

What we’re looking for

  •         Extensive global benefits experience in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.

  •         Experience leading a team and influencing senior stakeholders in lean, fast-moving environments.
  •         Strong analytical skills for cost modeling and claims analysis, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Why join us

  •         Real impact: shape benefits for a global AI company helping the world’s largest enterprises make AI work.

title: Robotics Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

You will develop software for system and regression testing of our robots, including test scripts, test tools, and automation solutions. Your core output will be high-quality, reusable test software that helps the team improve the efficiency, coverage, and repeatability of robot system testing.

This is a development engineer role. You will collaborate with the robotics test and system test engineers in the team to develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions for key software and hardware test scenarios across our robot systems.

In addition to software development, you will have the opportunity to participate directly in validation and debugging work on physical robots and in simulation environments. You will run and refine the tools and automated test solutions you develop on real systems, gaining first-hand insight into how robots behave and the challenges they face in real-world environments.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop system, integration, and regression test scripts in Python or C++ for various robotic platforms
  • Develop ROS 2-based test tools, such as nodes for stimulating and monitoring the system, tools for data recording and replay, log and rosbag analysis, and test result reporting
  • Debug, validate, run, and maintain automated test solutions in simulation environments and on physical robots
  • Develop scripts and tools for long-duration stability, performance, and fault-injection testing
  • Work with system test engineers in the team to turn manual test scenarios suitable for automation into stable, reusable test scripts
  • Integrate test scripts into CI/CD pipelines so that they run automatically with each build
  • Maintain test code quality through code reviews, documentation, and version control
  • Use the tools you develop to support issue reproduction, diagnosis, and analysis

What You Bring

  • Hands-on ROS 2 development experience gained through work, internships, a thesis, or student projects; able to write nodes using rclpy or rclcpp, with familiarity in topics, services, actions, parameters, launch files, and rosbag
  • A robotics background, with practical experience in robot development or testing through work, internships, a working student role, a thesis, or student projects
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python or C++
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field; recent graduates are welcome
  • Familiarity with Linux and Git
  • A long-term interest in robot testing and quality engineering, as well as an interest in debugging and validating your own code on real robots
  • Good written and spoken English skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robot arms, legged robots, or other mobile robot platforms
  • Experience developing automated tests for real hardware
  • Familiarity with simulation tools such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Experience with Docker and test environment management
  • Experience with HIL or SIL test setups

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Sales Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Sales Consultant

THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is building the go-to destination for car-changing, reaching drivers everywhere through a portfolio of automotive brands: Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

Carwow started as a car reviews site and is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe, with over 10m customers helping them buy and sell cars. Our Sell My Car service lists cars for sale through a daily online auction, matching sellers with dealers who want to buy. In 2024 we acquired Autovia, doubling our audience. Our team of around 500 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal is revolutionising car-changing, and we are expanding across every brand and country we operate in.

WHY JOIN US?

Shortlisted in the prestigious Culture 100 list of the top Growth companies to work for by Hyer; we also recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify, Bessemer Venture Partners, to accelerate our growth plans! 

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in! 

THE ROLE

As a Sales Consultant in the Sales Team, you are the main person guiding our customers into the auction and getting their car sold.

Our daily online auction can list over 1,000 cars a day, and behind every one is a seller who wants the best price and a hassle-free sale. You will take them from first conversation to sale: getting their listing right, setting realistic price expectations, then negotiating the sale to land the best price. Owning the whole journey means stronger rapport, better phone calls and fewer cancellations, and you will see the result of your work in every sale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage a daily pipeline of sellers, making calls to guide each one from first conversation to a completed listing and an accepted offer, and hit daily, weekly and monthly targets.

  • Review listings uploaded by sellers and work with them to fix any omissions or errors, so every car enters the auction accurately and complete.

  • Explain the Carwow auction process and give honest, market-based pricing advice, so sellers feel informed and confident.

  • Listen to sellers' concerns and overcome objections, using our sales frameworks.

  • Negotiate on the seller's behalf to get their offer accepted at the best price the market will pay.

  • Uphold our call quality standards in every interaction, so sellers have a positive experience with Carwow.

  • Meet daily KPIs for call volumes, for email and text contact.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including pre-qualification and post-sales fulfilment, sharing insight and feedback on what sellers need.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • We are looking for someone with a track record of hitting targets who is equally comfortable building rapport with a seller and negotiating confidently on their behalf.

  • Previous experience in a target-driven role, with goals based on revenue or volume of sales.

  • Experience managing a high-volume lead pipeline independently, with a consistent sales process and performance.

  • Proven ability to negotiate and handle objections.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build rapport with sellers from diverse backgrounds.

  • Comfort working across phone, email, live chat and SMS.

  • A proactive, customer-focused approach, with a genuine desire to help sellers achieve their goals.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisation, for accurate listings, tidy pipeline records and efficient follow-up.

  • You are self-motivated, driven by both your own targets and the teams, and work just as well independently as you do as part of a team.

  • Flexibility to work weekends on a rota (see Working pattern and location).

  • Enthusiasm for the automotive industry and for keeping up with trends is a plus.

WORKING PATTERN AND LOCATION

This is a full-time role of 37.5 hours a week, worked over 5 days. Shifts rotate across Monday to Sunday and fall between 9am and 7pm.

  • Weekends: Weekend days are shared across the Sales Team on a rota that repeats every eight weekends and is published in advance. When you work a weekend day, you'll get a weekday off in the same week / time off in lieu, so you still work 5 days in total.

  • Public holidays: Carwow operates seven days a week, so you may be scheduled to work on public holidays

  • Location: hybrid, with a minimum of three days a week in the office at Bournemouth, Winnersh, London or Porto.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working 

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year 

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year  

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in the UKI. You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background.   • Neukunden gewinnen: Du sprichst Entscheider per Telefon an und weckst echtes Interesse.

  • Ehrgeiz: Du willst gewinnen, vor allem gegen deine eigenen Zahlen von gestern.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe bei Software: Du findest dich schnell in Tools wie HubSpot ein und bedienst deinen Computer zügig und sicher.

  • Ab Monat 6: ca. 7.000 € pro Monat

  • Nach über einem Jahr: 100.000 €+ pro Jahr

Fast alle unserer Vertriebler, die länger als ein Jahr dabei sind, verdienen aktuell über 100.000 € im Jahr, mit steigender Tendenz. Das hat einen Grund: Bei uns bleiben die, die liefern. Wir sind ein Leistungsteam, und wer hier ankommt, verdient entsprechend. Und weil wir schnell wachsen, werden die Möglichkeiten jeden Monat größer.

  • Echtes Onboarding und Coaching, wir machen dich fit im Vertrieb, auch ohne Vorerfahrung.

  • Entwicklungsperspektive, wer mitwächst, kann Verantwortung übernehmen (z. B. als Teamlead).

Klingt nach dir?

Bewirb dich in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, ein Lebenslauf reicht.

Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung persönlich an. Passt es, melden wir uns per E-Mail mit einem kurzen Persönlichkeitstest (ca. 10 Minuten) – so lernen wir dich über den Lebenslauf hinaus kennen.

title: SecOps Engineer - Stage Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech. Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein.
En 2021, Theodo Cloud lance Theodo Security : notre équipe experte en cybersécurité pour aider nos clients à sécuriser leur environnement Cloud. Pour continuer à nous développer, nous faisons grandir l’équipe et recrutons un ou une SecOps Engineer en stage de fin d’études. Les missions d’un(e) SecOps Engineer : Theodo Cloud intervient sur deux typologies de projets : - des projets spécifiques, liés à la sécurisation des infrastructures de nos clients (pentest, forensic et remédiations) - des projets transverses à Theodo Cloud pour implémenter la sécurité By-Design chez nos clients Dans tous les cas, nous intervenons toujours en équipe : Lead SecOps, SecOps, SRE, Agile Project Managers travaillent main dans la main pour garantir l’impact de nos actions chez nos clients ! En tant que SecOps Engineer, tu interviendras sur des projets : - d’audit et de pentest - en boîte blanche, grise ou noire selon les besoins du client, sur des périmètres qui peuvent aller des applications mobiles aux clusters Kubernetes, en passant par les applications web et les infrastructures cloud - de sécurisation d’infrastructure, avec une équipe 100% SecOps ou intégré à une équipe Ops - ces projets mélangent construction d’infrastructure, sécurisation, outillage et formation des équipes client Ton rôle sera de comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client à l’aide des outils les plus pertinents sur le marché. Kubernetes, Checkov, Falco, AWS, Google Cloud, Github Actions, Argo CD, Terraform… feront partie de ton quotidien ! Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à coeur : la formation des équipes business, le Green IT, la diversité, le marketing technique... Les opportunités d’évolution : Nous recrutons exclusivement des stagiaires de fin d’études sur ce poste, avec l’objectif de convertir ensuite le stage en CDI. Sur du plus long terme, la première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead SecOps sur les projets, et d’être ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Ton profil : Nous recherchons une personne ayant : - une solide formation académique en école d’ingénieur - une 1ère expérience (pro ou perso) avec les technologies infra / Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP...) et une appétence pour la cybersécurité ou une 1ère expérience (pro ou perso) en cybersécurité avec une appétence infra/Cloud - une forte envie de progresser - l’envie de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Le processus de recrutement : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 3 jours. Si ton profil nous plait, nous te proposons le process suivant : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo Cloud - un entretien technique de débug de 45 minutes sur Docker compose avec un Ops - un entretien technique de 45 minutes avec de l'offensif et du défensif avec un SecOps Engineer - un entretien de motivation de 30 minutes avec un dirigeant de Theodo Notre process dure 2 semaines en moyenne. title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry still relies on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance.

The Role

We are hiring a Security Engineer to own the security of the systems every OLIX employee depends on: identity, devices, email, collaboration tools and our cloud estate. Our IP is the company, and protecting it is a hands-on engineering job.

You will own detection and response, harden our tooling, run vulnerability management and build the technical controls behind our ISO 27001 certification in 2027. You will work alongside our AI Security Engineer and IT Systems Engineer, and you will use automation and AI to make a small team cover a fast-growing company. This is a high-ownership role with the freedom to define how security engineering works at OLIX.

Responsibilities

  • Own detection and response: triage every security alert, work incidents end to end with our managed detection and response partner, and fix the root cause.

  • Harden the core estate: configure and baseline security across identity, endpoints, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub and AWS.

  • Run vulnerability management: set remediation service levels, close vulnerabilities in order of real risk, and report progress every week.

  • Build certification controls: operate and evidence the controls for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and NIST CSF.

  • Extend detection coverage: connect new log sources to our SIEM and write the detection rules for them.

  • Automate security work: build the scripts, agents and workflows that remove manual security tasks.

Skills and experience

  • 5 or more years in security engineering or security operations, owning controls end to end.

  • Hands-on experience running a SIEM and writing detection rules.

  • Hands-on experience administering EDR and responding to incidents on macOS and Windows.

  • Working knowledge of identity security, ideally Okta.

  • Experience securing SaaS platforms and AWS accounts.

  • Technical controls delivered for at least one certification audit (ISO 27001, SOC 2 or Cyber Essentials).

  • Scripting in Python or a similar language, and a habit of using AI to automate work.

  • Nice to have: experience in a hardware, semiconductor or deep-tech company.

Compensation and equity

  • Competitive salary: commensurate with your experience, skills and location.

  • Equity and ownership: meaningful stock options.

  • Proximity bonus: an annual Living-Local Bonus if you live within 20 minutes of the office.

  • Retirement benefits: employer-contributed retirement plans.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

  • Are genuinely excited about InfoSec and motivated to keep growing; we're open to less experience if the drive and aptitude are clearly there

What you'll own

You'll own our security posture end to end: the day-to-day operational work of keeping us secure, the security capabilities our enterprise customers demand, and the bigger initiatives on our security roadmap as we build out the function. This is as much a software engineering role as a security ops one - expect to spend real time in our codebase building features, alongside hands-on investigation, remediation, and shaping how security scales as we grow from 20 to 40+ engineers.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Design and build security features that ship in our product - like BYOK per tenant, SIEM-compatible audit logs, and SSO/SCIM - working directly in the codebase alongside product engineers

  • Own enterprise security end to end - completing customer security questionnaires, working through requirements around data handling and contractual agreements, and acting as the technical point of contact for our clients’ CISOs and security teams

  • Monitor and harden our cloud environment - tracking security recommendations, driving remediation, and making pragmatic risk-acceptance calls where they're justified

  • Investigate and respond to security alerts across our endpoint, cloud, and application stack

  • Build out our detection and monitoring capabilities, evolving our SIEM with alerting that cuts through the noise

  • Own vulnerability management end to end - triaging, tracking, and driving issues through to resolution

  • Proactively hunt for threats, from unusual behaviour in our environment to emerging risks like package and supply chain compromises

  • Run and refine security scanning across our infrastructure, applications, and dependencies

Who we hire

  • 3-7 years in a security engineering role

  • Background can come from any type of security engineering; what matters most is that you're comfortable reading and writing code - you'll be building product features and tooling, not just operating them

  • Experience working with enterprise customers is a plus, not a requirement

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets.

Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it.

The opportunity

You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it.

The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need.

You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them.

  • Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us.

  • Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

  • Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it.

  • Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround.

  • Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember.

  • Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate.

What you bring

  • Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like.

  • A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines.

  • Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP.

  • Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate.

  • An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output.

  • Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists.

  • Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment.

  • Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

  • Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products.

  • Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up.

  • Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer.

  • Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access.

  • Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls.

  • You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action.

  • You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default.

  • You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors.

  • Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally.

  • Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

UPGREAT mit Hauptsitz in Fehraltorf und Niederlassungen in Bern sowie Aarau ist Dein kompetenter Partner für Outsourcing, Modern Work und Cloudlösungen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur basiert auf den drei Grundwerten: Begeisterung, Menschlichkeit und Kompetenz.

Deine Aufgaben

title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)

  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

  • Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

  • Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

  • Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

  • Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw geotechnisch advies bepaalt of civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten;

  • je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp;

  • je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken.

Geotechniek bij Movares is breed en adviserend. Je werkt voor verschillende opdrachtgevers aan uiteenlopende projecten, zoals spoor- en railinfrastructuur, civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyse met advies en denkt mee over oplossingen die veilig, uitvoerbaar en duurzaam zijn.

Binnen het team deel je actief je kennis en draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Geotechniek. Heb je meer ervaring, dan begeleid je ook junior-adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior-of senior rol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

title: Senior AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior AI Transformation Lead, you’ll run our most ambitious client engagements. You’ll own relationships with C-suite leaders, PE sponsors and management teams, and lead a team of transformation leads and AI engineers. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the business case, and lead the change through to the people who have to adopt it. Every engagement starts with a value case and ends with the metric that moved in the client’s P&L. As one of our first 100, you’ll also coach your team, turn each engagement into playbooks the next team starts from, and help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows.

What we’re looking for: You’re a senior operator, typically with 5+ years of experience in equivalent roles, including running AI client engagements or transformation programmes end to end. You might be a senior consultant, engagement manager or associate partner at a top-tier strategy firm, a VP or Director on a PE value creation team, an AI director, or an operator who has led a transformation from inside a business. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, prototype with new models and tools the day they land, and know where to challenge your engineering counterparts. Just as important, senior executives trust you with their most important outcomes, you frame hard trade-offs clearly, and you bring resistant organisations through change. We want both in one person. title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
If you've built something before, start here

The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day.

What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day.

What you'll do

You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with.

  • Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket.

  • Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved.

  • Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on.

  • Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate.

  • Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix.

  • Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version

  • You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations

  • At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need

  • You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users

  • You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both

  • You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data

  • You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls

  • You make things simpler over time, not more clever

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home

  • You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you

  • You want a well-defined backlog handed to you

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount

Our stack

Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: come to our office in Zürich, work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote

  • Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive salary and equity

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.

title: Senior Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.
