If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Team Management
    • Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.
  • Formal Training & Growth
    • Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.
  • Recruitment & Retention
    • Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.
  • Culture of Learning
    • Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Strategic & Operational Management

  • Budget & Capacity Planning
    • Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.
  • Risk & Contingency
    • Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.
  • Procedure & Frameworks
    • Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.
  • Prioritisation
    • Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.

Technical Support & Oversight

  • Performance Optimisation
    • Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.
  • Visual Documentation
    • Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.
  • Hybrid Estate Management
    • Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.
  • Unblocking Issues
    • Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover.

General Duties

On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations.

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

Leadership & Management Competencies

  • Proven Management Experience
    • Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc).
  • Project Management
    • Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment.
  • Communication
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members.
  • Goal Oriented
    • You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met.
  • ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma
    • Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts.

Technical Environment & Team Capabilities

Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions.

For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration.

Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation.

  • Innovation & Debt Management
    • A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt.
  • Advanced Containerization
    • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems.
  • Observability
    • Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana).
  • Data Streaming
    • Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid.
  • Web & Storage
    • Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster.
  • Tooling
    • Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.
  • Version Control
    • strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.

Why This Role?

If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business

This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical Insurance through Vitality
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Eye Care Vouchers
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Senior IP Manager/ IP Professional (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
You will be responsible for managing the Agile Robots Group’s patent, trademark and design portfolio. Based in Munich, you will work across a group with production sites in Europe, the Americas and Asia.

The portfolio comprises more than 1,700 files. You will be supported by an IP Paralegal and a Chinese Patent Attorney based in China. External patent and trademark attorneys handle the drafting and filing of new applications. You will coordinate their work with inventors, business teams and other internal stakeholders, and report to the General Counsel of Agile Robots Group.

Your Responsibilities: 

  • Manage the IP portfolio: Oversee pending applications and granted rights, regularly review their strategic value, and instruct external counsel on prosecution, maintenance and portfolio decisions. The portfolio covers Germany, European patents (including unitary patents and national validations), the US, China, Japan, Korea, India and other jurisdictions.
  • Develop new IP: Serve as the main contact for inventors, product designers and marketing teams. Review invention disclosures, assess them against business priorities and applicable legal requirements, including the German Employee Inventions Act (ArbnErfG), and instruct external counsel on new applications.
  • Conduct patent research: Carry out prior art and state-of-the-art searches using professional patent databases. Monitor competitor portfolios and technology trends, and turn your findings into practical advice for R&D and management.
  • Coordinate freedom-to-operate reviews: Work with product teams to identify relevant features, markets and risks during development and before launch. Conduct reviews in-house or coordinate external specialists where needed.
  • Support IP strategy and transactions: Contribute to IP due diligence, portfolio valuation and monetisation, cost control and the integration of acquired IP portfolios, including changes of ownership and representation.
  • Identify and address infringement: Establish a practical process for monitoring potential infringement and support enforcement matters and litigation alongside internal and external lawyers.
  • Support licensing and other IP matters: Work with legal colleagues on inbound and outbound licences, trade secrets, know-how and copyright matters.

Essential Skills:

  • A degree in engineering, physics, computer science or a related technical field, together with qualification as a European Patent Attorney and/or German Patent Attorney.
  • At least five years’ experience as a patent attorney, preferably including two or more years in an in-house role.
  • Experience with computer-implemented inventions and the ability to assess complex technical matters in a commercial context.
  • The ability to explain IP issues clearly to engineers, business teams, lawyers and management across different cultures and jurisdictions.
  • A hands-on, pragmatic and collaborative approach. You set priorities, improve processes and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
  • Fluency in German and English.

Beneficial Skills:

  • Experience in an international company in robotics, automation, industrial technology or a related sector.
  • A technical background in computer science, software engineering or electrical engineering, particularly with experience in AI-related patent applications.
  • Chinese language skills.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the role

At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.

You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.

Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.

Build smarter systems through AI and automation

Think like a product owner

  • Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.

Collaborate across Typeform

Nice to have

title: Senior Java Engineer - Security - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch Security team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and design of Elasticsearch's main features. These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to participate in providing high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Participating in the technical design, planning, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
  • Developing the foundational security models for features.
  • Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention

What You Bring 

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have experience building authorization systems that are scalable and performant under high concurrency and large permission sets, including designing access models, validating credentials/tokens at scale, and keeping authorization decisions consistent across a distributed system.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still collaborating on the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, supporting decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

title: Senior LCA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Your core mission is to turn LCA methodology into software that works at scale. You own the full chain from methodological question to working software solution and take ownership of the team's most complex methodological and technical challenges. You make sure each new product category, market and verification takes less time and effort, working with high autonomy and high accountability.

As an early senior member of a fast-growing climate-tech company, your career trajectory is entirely in your hands. This role offers unparalleled visibility and growth. You can deepen your expertise as a technical expert in the team, or leverage your domain knowledge to pivot into high-impact roles across Customer Success, Sales, or Product. Exceptional early joiners are primed for future Team Lead and leadership positions.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Lead strategic projects: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous projects such as new markets, program operators or complex product categories. Define requirements, navigate trade-offs, delegate across the team and drive delivery.

  • Shape the product core: Work closely with our software engineers to translate environmental science and ISO/EN standards into clean, scalable software requirements, and propose complete implementation strategies for whole concepts, not individual features.

  • Scale our LCA work: Reduce the time and effort for recurring work such as tool verifications, new product category implementations and matching, through automation, reusable standards and better processes. Turn verifier feedback into requirements that solve the issue for good.

  • Scale tool verifications: Work with program operators and verifiers to establish processes that make tool verifications faster, more predictable and repeatable across markets and product categories.

  • Set the standard: Define what clear requirements and architecturally sound solutions look like, and take ownership of refining our methodologies for PCFs, LCAs and EPDs.

  • Improve how we work: Identify problems others don't see, turn them into actionable proposals, and solve recurring problems at the root instead of case by case.

  • Grow the team: Mentor junior colleagues and give them regular, actionable feedback.

  • Shape the industry: Help establish Emidat as a thought leader in LCA, e.g. by representing us in ECO Platform working groups and in the committees that author PCRs.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Extensive LCA expertise: You bring deep expertise and experience conducting Life Cycle Assessments, LCA calculation methodology, PCRs and ecoinvent/matching logic. You showcase ownership of complex, ambiguous methodological or technical challenges.

  • Mastery of standards and regulation: You have comprehensive knowledge of the key LCA / EPD standards and program operator requirements (i.e ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15804+A2). You interpret these standards rigorously, and evaluate sources critically.

  • From methodology to software: You have experience working with automated software solutions for LCA/EPD generation, with proven ability to translate regulatory and methodological logic into technical requirements. You bring a product mindset: you prioritise, scope and communicate requirements clearly.

  • Verification and customer experience: You have created multiple EPDs that were successfully verified and published with a European program operator (e.g. EPD Global, EPD International, IBU). You have worked directly with customers, ideally in a consulting environment, and can represent methodological positions confidently towards customers and verifiers.

  • Leadership and project management: You have a track record of leading large projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, delegating, coaching others and keeping quality high. You manage several projects at the same time and coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Language: Business fluent in English (C1+).

Nice to have’s

  • Education: Bachelors, Masters Degree or PhD in a relevant subject, i.e Sustainable Energy Systems, Architecture, Urban Planning, Engineering (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) etc.

  • Languages: Proficiency in German, or any other of the following European languages (French, Italian, Dutch, a Nordic language).

  • Verifier: Qualification as a verifier for EPDs acc. to EN 15804+A2

  • Engineering partnership: Experience completing partnering with software engineers to develop implementation strategies.

  • AI-enabled way of working: You are experienced in leveraging AI tools to accelerate your work, e.g. for research, requirements and documentation.

  • Tool Verifications: You have experience with EPD tool verifications.

  • Industry: Experience working on Construction products, or familiarity with the latest regulatory developments affecting the construction industry (e.g. EU Taxonomy, national and regional regulations) and can assess their impact on methodology and product.

How we support you

Your manager / team lead will be

  • Benedikt Team Lead, LCA and Product Manager

You will work closely with

  • Anna (LCA Expert)

  • Areeba (LCA Expert)

title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

  • Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.

  • Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.

  • Support company secretarial administration.

About you

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.

  • Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.

  • Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.

  • Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it.

  • Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.

  • End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes.

  • Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.

  • Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.

  • Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. title: Senior Manager, Accounting
descriptionHtml:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

The Senior Manager, Accounting owns the completeness and accuracy of the global operating expense base across the profit and loss statement and related balance sheets for a fast-paced, global business. Operating within the Controllership leadership team, this role leads a team of accounting professionals and runs the global expense close end-to-end across all entities and time zones. The successful candidate will drive a comprehensive continuous improvement agenda to scale the accounting function through standardization, automation, and the adoption of enabling technology. This is an exciting opportunity to take full ownership of global operating expenses and help shape the future transformation of the accounting function to support significant organizational growth.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end global operating expense close cycle under US GAAP, ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timely delivery of all balance sheet reconciliations and reporting requirements worldwide.
  • Deliver clear monthly and quarterly financial variance analyses to explain commercial drivers, risks, and opportunities while partnering with financial planning teams on spend trends.
  • Act as the primary subject matter expert for operating expense accounting, applying technical principles and critical evaluation to judgment-intensive areas, vendor agreements, and commercial arrangements.
  • Drive the continuous improvement agenda by simplifying, standardizing, and automating close processes through the adoption of artificial intelligence and scaling technologies.
  • Manage and develop a geographically dispersed team of accounting professionals, establishing a high-performing culture focused on mutual accountability, clear goals, and career progression.
  • Foster strong collaborative relationships with procurement, finance operations, and commercial partners to integrate commercial insights into accounting decisions and establish clear process governance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Professional accounting qualification (such as CPA, ACA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent).
  • Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in financial or operational accounting within a complex, multi-entity global business.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the end-to-end financial close cycle, including operating expenses, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Proven track record of successfully leading, coaching, and developing teams of accounting professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public accounting experience, ideally with a top 6 accounting firm
  • In-depth technical grounding in US GAAP principles and corporate financial reporting standards.
  • Strong proficiency in driving continuous process improvement, automation, or financial system transformations.
  • Experience managing accounting operations and collaboration across multiple international entities and time zones.
  • Exceptional communication and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate financial figures into clear commercial insights for senior stakeholders.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 5 weeks paid vacation
  • Time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Bike2Work
  • Season ticket loan
  • Social events & Thursday happy hours
  • Free lunch 2 days per week

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: (Senior) Manager Business Development (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your role

As the market leader for health supplements in Germany, we have ambitious plans to expand our reach and bring high-quality products to more customers internationally. Backed by our founder and our leading strategic private equity partner CVC, we are positioned for rapid growth. We are looking for a Berlin-based (Senior) Manager Business Development (all genders) to drive our most critical strategic initiatives with us. Working closely with the Lead Business Development and the CFO, you will play a central role in shaping and executing our company-wide growth strategy hands-on. If you excel at turning complex challenges into clear operational plans, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy leading cross-functional projects, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a lasting impact.


Lead Strategic Projects (70%)

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects across the business (incl. internationalization, marketing, operations, finance) to deliver our long-term strategy with your hands-on operational execution power - leave your mark.

  • Proactively identify strategic opportunities to grow the business, scope the project and execute your plan - own the outcome.

  • Mobilize teams across the organization to deliver your project objectives - connect the dots.

Drive Business Development Operations (30%)

  • Lead operational activities to realize our long-term strategy (e.g. steering our quarterly OKR process)

  • Prepare board (incl. private equity), senior management and company-wide updates on business performance and strategic priorities for our town halls and trainings

  • Support the yearly target setting and the financial performance tracking, in close collaboration with the CFO

Your profile

  • About 2 years of professional experience in top-tier management consulting (ideally MBB) or another analytical, fast-paced environment

  • Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Management, or a related field

  • A highly motivated and collaborative mindset, with the ability to take ownership and move ideas forward

  • Proven track record of bringing structure to complex and ambiguous topics and independently drive strategic initiatives from analysis to execution

  • Strong interest in the health, wellness, and nutrition space; previous experience in DTC, consumer goods, or e-commerce is a plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams and seniority levels

  • Ability to work from our Berlin office four days per week, with one day of home office

What we offer

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

descriptionHtml:
The role

As a Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will work in a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

You will work across the team's full agenda: Group and business unit strategy, portfolio and capital allocation decisions, and M&A. You are hands-on: you build the financial models, analysis and executive-level outputs yourself. You work under the guidance of the team leadership, owning the quality of analysis and models within your workstreams as well as the respective internal stakeholder relationships.

What you’ll do

  • Corporate Strategy: Support the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, own the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
  • Business Unit Strategy: Act as an internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.
  • M&A Strategy: Drive workstreams for M&A projects, building and owning financial models, analyzing targets, preparing negotiations and supporting the M&A processes the team owns.
  • Portfolio Optimization: Contribute to the strategic analysis for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 4+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team.

You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
  • Financial Acumen: Strong financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended models used for investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
  • DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
  • Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentationsand memos for an executive audience.

4076 - Senior Manager, Global Resource Management – GOC (Parental Leave Cover)

Role Summary and Impact

The Senior Manager, Global Resource Management will play a key role in supporting the effective planning, deployment and utilisation of talent across the Global Operations Centres (GOCs).

The role will have responsibility for the day-to-day Resource Management of selected GOC Global clients, while also leading key RM activities including utilisation reviews, balanced team management, bench governance and cross-GOC RM projects.

Working closely with Capacity Planners, Staffing Strategists, Talent Acquisition, HR and market teams, the Senior Manager will help ensure client demand is effectively resourced, workforce risks are proactively identified, and RM processes are consistently managed across the GOCs.

The role will act as a key operational partner to the GOC RM Lead, taking ownership of defined areas and escalating strategic, commercial or significant workforce decisions where required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Global Client Resource Management
  • Own Resource Management for selected strategic global clients using GOC talent.
  • Support new global client opportunities and transitions, translating demand into clear resource requirements and staffing plans.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements across multiple GOC locations and disciplines.
  • Work with Capacity Planning and Staffing teams to identify appropriate resources and drive open requirements through to fulfilment.
  • Maintain oversight of the client's GOC workforce, including open roles, upcoming demand, resource movements, backfills and capacity risks.
  • Establish an effective RM cadence with relevant client and market stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify resource issues and drive actions to resolution.
  • Escalate significant commercial, capacity or stakeholder risks to the GOC RM Lead.
  1. Utilisation & Workforce Optimisation
  • Coordinate regular utilisation reviews across GOC teams.
  • Identify under-utilisation, over-utilisation and available capacity and work with relevant teams to agree appropriate actions.
  • Monitor utilisation trends and highlight emerging risks or opportunities.
  • Ensure actions from utilisation reviews are tracked through to completion.
  • Support proactive redeployment of available talent against suitable client demand.
  • Provide concise utilisation insights and exception reporting to the GOC RM Lead.
  1. Balanced Teams
  • Support regular reviews of team structures across GOC clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team balance, workload distribution and appropriate management oversight.
  • Work with RM, client and operational teams to address identified team structure or workload issues.
  • Monitor agreed actions and ensure they are followed through.
  • Highlight structural workforce issues requiring longer-term intervention.
  1. Bench Management & Redeployment
  • Own the ongoing coordination and governance of GOC bench activity.
  • Support the rollout of the existing bench framework across additional GOC locations.
  • Maintain visibility of available resources and actively connect relevant skills and capacity with upcoming client requirements.
  • Coordinate appropriate bench project opportunities where immediate billable deployment is not available.
  • Track bench movements and provide visibility of key risks, ageing cases and redeployment opportunities.
  • Work with relevant GOC stakeholders to ensure consistent adoption of the bench process.
  1. Resource Planning & Operational Support
  • Provide support on complex staffing requirements that require coordination across multiple markets, clients, disciplines or GOCs.
  • Assist Capacity Planners and Staffing teams with more complex resource challenges.
  • Monitor key staffing risks, blockers and ageing requirements and help drive them towards resolution.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR and other functions where additional support is required to fulfil resource needs.
  • Support workforce and capacity planning activities by ensuring emerging demand and supply risks are visible.
  1. RM Projects & Continuous Improvement
  • Own and deliver selected Resource Management projects and improvement initiatives.
  • Support the rollout of consistent RM practices across GOC locations.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual RM processes and improve ways of working.
  • Support improvements to RM reporting, dashboards and workforce visibility.
  • Lead agreed workstreams such as:
    • Bench management rollout
    • Balanced Teams
    • Utilisation governance
    • RM reporting and dashboards
    • Process standardisation
    • Skills and capability visibility

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Experience in Resource Management, People Operations, or a related area is desirable.
  • This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is motivated to make an impact, not simply tick boxes; it requires initiative, ownership and an appetite for challenge.
  • Strong communication, proactive, organisation and influencing skills.
  • Experience managing resource requirements across multiple clients, teams or geographies.
  • Good understanding of utilisation, capacity management and workforce deployment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert workforce data into practical actions.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive actions to completion.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional projects or process improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused approach.
  • Ability to operate independently while recognising when issues require senior escalation.

What Success Looks Like

The Senior Manager will be successful when:

  • Selected global clients have clear, proactive RM ownership.
  • Complex staffing requirements are driven to resolution without requiring continuous intervention from the GOC RM Lead.
  • Utilisation and balanced-team reviews result in clear actions and follow-through, rather than simply reporting.
  • Bench capacity is visible and actively managed across GOCs.
  • RM initiatives are delivered consistently across locations.
  • Capacity Planning and Staffing teams have an effective senior operational escalation point.
  • Major workforce risks are identified early and escalated with clear recommendations.

descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met een focus op Commercial Excellence en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Mis je de ruimte om echt impact te maken in je huidige rol? Spreekt groei en het meewerken aan innovatieve ontwikkelingen je aan? Dan is dit dé vacature voor jou!

Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's die echt verandering en uitdagingen omarmen, hebben we een unieke "high-daring", "high-caring" cultuur gecreëerd, die buitengewone mensen aantrekt en hen inspireert om de grenzen voor zichzelf en onze klanten te verleggen. Wij geloven dat de optimale werkomgeving gelijkwaardig is en stellen duidelijke doelen om gendergelijkheid te versnellen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun commerciële organisatie naar een hoger niveau willen tillen: meer groei uit dezelfde markt, de juiste prijs per klant, kanaal en moment, en een salesorganisatie die structureel wint. Van uiteenlopende projecten gefocust op het aangescherpen van groeistrategieën tot Smart Pricing & Revenue Management en Sales Excellence met de bijbehorende capabilities: jij zet de koers uit en zorgt dat die landt.

Daarvoor werk je met multidisciplinaire teams uit strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie en organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Zo combineer je scherpe commerciële analyses met de data, tools en verandering die nodig zijn om de groei ook echt te realiseren.

Als senior manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor grote klanttrajecten en een vertrouwde sparringpartner op C-level. Je bouwt accounts uit, ziet de volgende vraag van de klant al aankomen en zet die om in nieuwe opdrachten. Daarbij krijg je alle vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel voor het project als voor de accountontwikkeling.

Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze Commercial Excellence-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?
Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). · Sterke management- en communicatievaardigheden; je weet stakeholders te verbinden en C-levelklanten te activeren.

· Sterk analytisch vermogen en conceptueel denken.

· Diepgaande kennis van Commercial Excellence.

· Een groot netwerk in de Retail, Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en/of FMCG-sector.

· Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie.

· Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

· En nog veel meer, waar we je graag meer over vertellen.


Waarom IG&H?

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's in de verschillende teams, die verandering en uitdagingen oprecht omarmen, hebben we een unieke, zeer gedurfde en zorgzame cultuur gecreëerd. We trekken bijzondere mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.

title: Senior Manager, Rider Onboarding and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drives everything we do.

We're looking for a Senior Manager to join our Rider Onboarding and Compliance team. The team sits at the heart of the Rider Support Centre (RSC) and are responsible for getting new applicants out on the road quickly and safely, and for keeping active riders compliant once they're there. It's a centralised, all-markets function, and it has a direct line to two things Deliveroo cares about most: rider retention and rider satisfaction.

What You'll Be Doing

Your number one goal: Deliver the right rider hours, in the right areas, with compliant riders.

Reporting into the Head of Rider Services, you'll lead the Rider Onboarding & Compliance team comprising; 3 Team Leads circa 30+ in-house Representatives split across our London and Manchester offices, circa 30+ person team in Deliveroo India In addition you'll hold a couple of outsource vendor partners accountable for performance; delivering business-as-usual onboarding and compliance support across every Deliveroo market. You'll own the strategy, run the large global projects that come with it, and act as the applicant and rider advocate across the business, not just the person accountable for the KPIs.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Deliver core marketplace operational metrics: Own and execute the global rider onboarding and compliance strategy to ensure we deliver the right rider hours, in the right areas, with fully compliant riders.
  • Lead distributed global teams: Lead, coach, and scale a multi-layered operational team across the UK, an in-house team of 30+ in India, and external BPO vendor partners.
  • Drive large-scale strategic initiatives: Plan and execute major projects, including onboarding pipeline standardisation and compliance process redesigns in close collaboration with Legal, Policy, and Data Science. Manage vendor performance and capacity: Direct outsource vendor productivity and set up robust forecasting and capacity models to effectively manage end-to-end team resourcing and global volume shifts.
  • Advocate for riders and continuous improvement: Act as the primary rider advocate across the business to resolve complex escalations, leverage new tooling or automation, and drive operational excellence.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring expertise in:

  • Proven operational leadership: Significant experience leading multi-layered, multi-site teams in a fast-paced environment (such as onboarding, trust & safety, compliance, or customer support operations).
  • Vendor & BPO management expertise: Hands-on capability in managing external outsource vendor partners, holding them accountable to strict quality and compliance standards while building collaborative, outcome-focused relationships.
  • Resource and capacity planning: Strong commercial and analytical skills with demonstrated ability to build forecasting models and optimise headcount across internal and offshore resources.
  • Cross-functional stakeholder management: Proven ability to partner with Legal, Policy, and Data Science teams to navigate complex regulatory, risk, and fraud requirements without sacrificing speed or rider experience.
  • Change management and execution: A strong bias to action with a track record of implementing process changes, automation, and tooling that lift efficiency across distributed teams.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, customer care is central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You'll work in a fast-paced, global environment where service excellence drives real impact.

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves outcomes for customers, riders and restaurant partners.

🌱 Grow through ownership Take responsibility for complex cases and help shape improvements to how we operate.

🧠 Develop deep operational expertise Work across teams and markets to build strong regulatory and service knowledge.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine — our interview typically includes 3–4 stages. Learn more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer (Electro-mechanical)
descriptionHtml:
With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation.

At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. For the expansion of our team, we are seeking to hire in Geneva a dynamic and motivated Senior R&D Engineer.

As a Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer, you will be involved with the R&D team in the development of cutting-edge high-speed switching devices such as high-speed DC circuit breakers, contributing to the full product lifecycle: from design to application.

You will work at the intersection of electrical and mechanical engineering, bringing expertise in power electronics, dielectrics and thermal advanced modeling, playing a key role in shaping the future of medium voltage switching technology.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to innovative R&D projects focused on high-speed circuit breakers and related switching technologies.
  • Design and simulate electrical switching systems using MATLAB/Simulink, COMSOL MultiPhysics including electromagnetic, thermal, material science and dielectric behavior.
  • Define and execute test plans for prototypes, including dielectric, thermal, and mechanical validation.
  • Interface with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical and electronics engineers.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to optimize material processing and industrialization.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical strategy and innovation roadmaps.
  • Contribute to patent filings, technical documentation, and compliance with IEC/IEEE standards.
  • Develop and validate electronic control boards for switching and protection systems.

Requirements

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in R&D for low voltage and/or medium voltage electric equipment.
  • Good understanding of Railway protection systems – Modern DC microgrids.
  • English fluent mandatory, French strong plus.
  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Applied Physics or similar.
  • Strong understanding of electro-mechanical and magnetic systems.

Strong plus:

  • Experience with testing and validation in high-voltage environments.
  • Knowledge of High-speed DC circuit breakers.

Plus:

  • Good knowledge in power electronics switching devices.
  • Thermal and dielectric analysis.
  • Modeling and simulation in MATLAB/Simulink - COMSOL.
  • Material processing and manufacturing techniques.
  • Electronic board design and integration.
  • CAD 3D design tools (SolidWorks).
  • Curious, attentive to detail, team player.

Benefits

We foster flat hierarchies and direct communication, enabling quick decisions and strong collaboration across all levels. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and encouraged to take initiative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US

Sofar Sounds is a global community that connects artists and audiences through unique and intimate experiences. We bring people together to create space for discovery, community and connection in non-traditional, unexpected places across 78 countries and growing.

We are deeply passionate about the work we do. When we’re not working, you can probably find us at a live show or telling anyone in earshot about the new song we can’t stop listening to. Discovering and supporting artists gets us out of bed every morning – and knowing that we’re creating memorable, intimate fan experiences worldwide drives our work forward.


The Role

As the Senior Operations and Partnerships Manager for London, you will have three key objectives:

  • Develop and drive sponsorships and partnerships successfully end-to-end, from initial pitching to successful execution

  • Project Manager for our large event programme, and support everyday booking operations.

  • Help scale and improve operations of all of our Experiences, including supporting London’s independent event producers.

    • This is a 12 month partial maternity cover for the General Manager, starting Jan 1 and reporting into the VP Experiences, with an opportunity for successful candidates to extend their engagement. This is an incredible opportunity for people who are passionate about live events, customer experience, and building community.

    Please note that this is a full-time role with annual bonus based on city performance targets. It requires on-call, night and weekend availability.


What You'll Do

  • Partnerships:

    • Lead account management for our high profile sponsorships, partnerships and pitch potential partners and sponsors, driving additional revenue for the London P&L

    • Grow our corporate events business in London, building out our preferred supplier list to be able to offer a “full service” corporate event

    • Large Event programme:

      • Drive forward our large event programme, ensuring they are executed to the highest standard and generate high revenue and profit margin. Work closely with our Senior Marketing Manager on the programme’s positioning and USP’s.

      • Build relationships with partners (venues, artists, bookers) to be able to deliver these large format events

      • Manage all staffing requirements, leading a team of contractors and recruiting freelancers to deliver the event

      • Operational excellence:

        • Be a leader within the team to drive forward Sofar London’s Live Event portfolio and hit our revenue targets.

        • Work with our independent event producers to deliver new event formats, concepts and locations for Sofar that grow our market share, looking to continuously improve operations to create a best-in-class customer experience

        • In collaboration with the Bookings and Operations Coordinator manage all gear and supplies, ensuring our teams have the equipment needed to execute each show safely and efficiently

        • Team management:

          • Oversee a diverse and inclusive Crew/Intern hiring, onboarding, training, management and mentoring process in your city

          • In collaboration with the Bookings and Operations Coordinator, ensure all events are properly staffed, managing communications and proactively coordinating substitutions when necessary, and approving time cards

          • During the mat cover, you will also oversee London’s booking team and share responsibility with the Senior Marketing Manager to run meetings.


Who You Are

  • You have 7+ years of experience in operations, partnerships, innovation, promotions, and/or live events.

  • You know what it takes to create a high quality event, grounded in principles of hospitality first and foremost.

  • You are resourceful and driven – whether it’s figuring out how to creatively sell tickets or dealing with a live event curveball, you know how to get things done and thrive on the challenge.

  • You have a strong pulse on your city, the unique nature of each neighborhood, and where people like to spend their free time.

  • You know how to connect with diverse community-driven organizations, media partners, or local businesses that would add strategic value to the work we are doing in your city

  • You understand how to promote and build strategic alliances that will ultimately sell more tickets at our shows.

  • You’re able to effectively communicate learnings, strategic recommendations, and feedback to your peers and partners.

    • You have a deep and demonstrated commitment to supporting a vibrant and diverse creative community in your city.

If our mission and job opening resonate, you're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We are committed to creating a culture of belonging and building a diverse team that reflects a variety of lived experiences, perspectives, and skills.

title: Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Bei Picnic betreiben wir einige der modernsten teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) für Lebensmittel Europas - mit einer Mischung aus Robotik, smarter Software und einer People-First-Kultur. Mit über 3.000 EPVs (Electric Picnic Vehicle) liefern wir in über 100 deutschen Städten täglich Lebensmittel aus. Unsere jüngste Investment Runde, an der auch die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation beteiligt ist, zeigt das Vertrauen in unser Konzept. Als Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d) in unserem FC in Falkensee spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Zufriedenheit unserer KundInnen und Mitarbeitenden.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Wertstromanalyse: Du leitest Wertstromanalysen zur Ermittlung des Ist-Zustandes von Prozessen, analysierst wertschöpfende und nicht wertschöpfende Tätigkeiten und entwickelst Pläne für den Soll-Zustand, um Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben.
  • Projektarbeit: Du entwickelst und setzt Strategien zur Rationalisierung von Arbeitsabläufen um, beseitigst Engpässe und steigerst die Gesamteffizienz von Prozessen innerhalb von Wertströmen.
  • Datenanalyse: Mit ausgeprägter Datenanalyse- und Problemlösungskompetenz identifizierst und behebst du Prozessprobleme.
  • Change Management: Du förderst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, indem du Lean-Methoden einsetzt, Problemlösungs-Workshops moderierst und funktionsübergreifende Teams befähigst, Prozessverbesserungen selbst zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
  • Teamleitung: Mit natürlichen Führungsqualitäten förderst du Bottom-up-Engagement und die tägliche Einbindung der Produktionsstätten und Mitarbeitenden, um Kaizen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voranzutreiben.
  • Verbesserung: Du zeigst eine konsequente Haltung zu den 5S-Prinzipien (Sauberkeit, Organisation usw.) und bringst Erfahrung in der Schulung, im Coaching und in der Umsetzung dieser Verbesserungsstandards mit.
  • Schichtleitung: Übernimm einmal pro Woche die Schichtleitung mit 150+ Lagermitarbeitenden, um weiterhin nah an unseren Operations zu sein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, vorzugsweise im Ingenieurwesen oder Lieferkettenmanagement.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in großen Lager Betrieben mit, vorzugsweise im Bereich der Automatisierung.
  • Praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Lean Management und/oder Wertstromdesign, einschließlich einschlägiger Zertifizierungen.
  • Außergewöhnliche Führungsqualitäten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Motivierung und Führung von Teams zur Erzielung herausragender Ergebnisse.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, kompetent im Umgang mit Datenanalysetools wie Tableau und Excel.
  • Praktische Mentalität, die Ideen in die Tat umsetzt und mit gutem Beispiel vorangeht, um den Erfolg zu fördern.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittag- oder Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kannst zusätzlich unser „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm nutzen. Kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.
