title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement.
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.

Why Join Samsara?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Payroll Officer
descriptionHtml:
Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL in our office 3 days/week.
As the true partner of the Payroll & Personnel Administration Manager for Europe, you will work within a French and European scope (5 countries) and manage the payroll of employees (250 employees) across various entities of the Match Group operating in this region (Meetic, Match, Tinder, Hinge, etc.). This role is based in Paris and is fully integrated into our European Human Resources team of 8 people, 7 of whom are based in the Paris office. Role overview: The role will initially focus on France, operating within a SOX-compliant environment, with the opportunity to progressively expand its scope across Europe.

  • Managing the semi-outsourced French payroll process, including collecting, entering, and verifying all variable payroll elements (absences, overtime, bonuses, on-call duties, etc.).

  • Managing HR administration for France, with a scope that will progressively expand to other European countries

  • Managing end-to-end administrative processes across the employee lifecycle, including personalized 1:1 onboarding for new joiners.

  • Building trusted relationships with employees and maintaining regular communication to ensure clarity and a high-quality employee experience.


Must-Have :
  • Bringing a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in French payroll.
  • Comfortable communicating in English
  • Keen eye for detail.
  • Proven ability to effectively organize, prioritize, and plan tasks.

    • Nice-to-Have:
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and/or multiple stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Workday.
  • Experience in European or international payroll management.
    • Why Match Group?
    • Work on products that impact millions, collaborating with global and diverse teams, shaping relationships and connections worldwide.
    • Access premium healthcare, mental health support, and emergency leaves.
    • Benefit from a healthy work-life balance in a flexible and welcoming environment.
    • Enjoy a modern office, close to transport and amenities.
    • Access lunch vouchers and a discounted ClassPass subscription.
    • Grow through e-learning, conferences, knowledge-sharing sessions, continuous learning programs, and global career opportunities
    • Join regular social events like breakfasts, lunches, and apéros.
    • Use our products for free.

    Match Group is an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our group.

    If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please let your Talent Acquisition partner know.

title: Senior PCB Designer II
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Senior PCB Designer II to our team. If you are excited about working in a startup environment, have a strong work ethic, and are passionate about cutting-edge electronics, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will perform PCB layout and library management for state-of-the-art power, digital, and RF electronics for aerospace applications. Electronics design is a core part of the company’s business, and as such, these functions are critical. You will have the opportunity to work with and learn from a highly talented team with state-of-the-art tools. As a small company, the Cesium team “wears many hats.” Candidates should be comfortable with a varied workflow that may involve multitasking between PCB layout, library management, schematic capture, review, and other related tasks.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Perform complex mixed-signal PCB layout in Altium Designer, working closely with engineers on staff.
  • Own intricate and challenging PCB layouts that often feature 30 GHz RF, power, and digital on the same board, with high density and complex stackups.
  • Generate and revise drawings and release packages for PCBs and assemblies.
  • Manage and maintain electronic component libraries in Altium Enterprise.
  • Generate and review schematic symbols and footprints.
  • Maintain templates for schematics, layouts, bills-of-materials (BOMs), and other documents.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • An Associate degree in Electronics Engineering Technology or similar.
  • 7 years of experience as a PCB Designer.
  • Strong experience with Altium Designer.
  • Strong understanding of the technical principles of PCB layout.
  • Experience with high-reliability, aerospace, and/or IPC Class 3 designs.
  • Experience with advanced PCB manufacturing techniques such as blind vias and microvias.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • An eye for detail and commitment to excellence.
  • Comfortability with collaboration tools such as MS Teams, Confluence, and Jira.
  • The ability to work well under deadlines.
  • Strong digital, written, and spoken communication skills, especially in the context of working with hardware engineers and mechanical engineers to complete a layout.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience managing an electronic component library.
  • Experience with PLM systems such as Arena.
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.
    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation.
    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Werde Teil von bonify, Deutschlands führender Plattform für Bonitätsauskünfte und Finanzmanagement mit über 4 Millionen Nutzer:innen.

Unsere Mission ist es, die FinTech-Branche zu revolutionieren und Bonität sowie Finanzdaten für unsere Nutzer:innen transparent und zugänglich zu machen, damit Menschen fundiertere finanzielle Entscheidungen treffen können. Dafür suchen wir dich als (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager in unserem dynamischen Team in Berlin.

Ihre Aufgaben

title: Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
  • Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
  • Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.
  • Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.
  • Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
  • Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
  • Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
  • Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile

Must haves:

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.
  • Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.
  • Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.
  • Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.
  • The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.
  • Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.
  • Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.
  • Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you.
  • You have built tools for operations or customer service teams.

Important attributes for this role:

  • You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from

  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

title: Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

Technology and a great e-commerce experience lie at the heart of our business. Thousands of restaurants order their supplies through Choco every day. You will own a core part of that experience, from how buyers find products to how they place their orders. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with a practical approach, strong analytical skills and commercial acumen. You understand what makes digital buying experiences work and turn buyer needs and enterprise customer requirements into scalable product improvements that make ordering easier and drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a core area of the e-commerce experience across journeys such as product discovery, search, cart, checkout and ordering, shaping its roadmap and driving measurable improvements for buyers and the business.

  • Lead a squad of engineers and a designer from discovery to delivery, shipping valuable features at a high pace and quality.

  • Talk directly with buyers and enterprise customers to understand their needs, test product ideas, and turn insights into improvements to the buying experience.

  • Make data-driven decisions that measurably improve the e-commerce experience and drive business impact, assessing the value of features before and after launch with a focus on conversion rate, average order value, purchase frequency and retention.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to win and grow enterprise accounts, from large distributors to manufacturers. Turn customer-specific needs into scalable product capabilities, balancing commercial opportunities with value for the broader customer base.

  • Use AI in your daily work and find opportunities to apply it in the buyer experience.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, including work with enterprise customers.

  • Experience building and optimizing customer-facing e-commerce journeys such as product discovery, search, catalog, cart, checkout and ordering.

  • A track record of leading a product area end to end, from discovery to delivery, in a scale-up and measurably improving its business results.

  • Sharp product sense and prioritization: you can dive deep into detail while keeping the bigger picture in view.

  • Strong ownership and flexibility: you thrive in a fast-changing environment, are comfortable with ambiguity, and take full responsibility for results.

  • Proven ability to lead through influence, aligning leadership, commercial teams and engineering behind clear decisions.

  • Solid business, technical and UX understanding, and a clear view of how product decisions translate into commercial performance.

  • A user-centric and data-driven approach, combining regular customer contact with strong analytical skills and the ability to work with data yourself.

  • Experience using AI to scale your own work.

  • Excellent communication skills: you move easily from technical discussions with engineers to explaining our product vision in a way anyone understands.

  • Nice to have: experience in the food industry, wholesale or distribution.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. title: Senior Product Manager (Growth)
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Self-serve is where the majority of our customers start their journey, and the Growth team owns that journey end to end. This role owns the self-serve existing business: once a customer converts to paid, the account is yours - through every stage of its lifecycle, as it adopts more of the platform, grows its usage, and deepens its reliance on Fin.

Your mandate is to grow the value of the self-serve base: drive expansion, strengthen retention, and accelerate adoption of Fin and our newest products across thousands of paying customers. You'll own a book of business, a roadmap, and a cross-functional motion that spans product, lifecycle, data, and go-to-market. It's a rare Growth remit with a clear number to move and a lot of room to build the motions that move it.

What will I be doing? 

  • Own the self-serve existing business book. Own the remit end to end - from the moment a customer converts to the point they renew, expand, or leave - and be accountable for the net growth of that book.
  • Grow Fin adoption. Get more customers using our AI Agent across the existing base, and help the customers who already use it automate more of their support.
  • Defend and expand. Build the retention and expansion motions that grow the book - combining in-product experiences, lifecycle messaging, and a data/signal layer that flags which accounts need attention and when.
  • Connect self-serve and sales. Design smooth, well-defined handovers between self-serve and sales in both directions, so the right customers get the right motion.
  • Fix the key journeys. Partner with core product teams to remove friction on the journeys that matter most to self-serve customers - onboarding and activation, Fin setup and go-live, plan changes and expansion, billing and plan management.
  • Land new products & features. Drive attach and adoption of new products & features across the self-serve base.
  • Understand the customer. Deeply understand the customers you're serving through research, data, and direct interactions, and turn that understanding into a clear, prioritised roadmap you communicate to build alignment.
  • Build and ship. Collaborate with engineers and designers to ideate, build, and ship solutions, and leverage AI to increase your efficiency and accelerate product development.
  • Measure impact. Evaluate impact through quantitative and qualitative measures, own product quality, and model our company values and R&D principles in how you lead.

What skills do I need? 

There is no minimum years of experience, and no need to have held the PM title. We care about your impact, drive, and potential - former founders, strategy & operations leaders, and consultants are as welcome as career PMs. The common thread is end-to-end ownership of a problem and the outcomes that follow. We'll be looking for evidence you've applied and grown these skills:

  • Growth and lifecycle expertise. You've owned retention, expansion, adoption, or monetisation for a self-serve or product-led business, and you know how to move those numbers.
  • Sharp customer focus and problem framing. You get to the real customer problem through research, data, and direct conversations before deciding what to build.
  • Strong data fluency. You're comfortable working with funnels, cohorts, and customer signals to find opportunity, size it, and measure impact - and you make decisions from evidence, not instinct.
  • Compelling roadmaps. You build and communicate a roadmap that makes the what, when, and why obvious to everyone who needs to align behind it.
  • Excellent product judgment. You balance customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints, and you know what to ship now versus later.
  • Cross-functional leadership. You drive outcomes across product, design, engineering, data, lifecycle marketing, CS, and sales - influencing teams you don't own.
  • AI fluency. You understand how LLMs and AI agents work well enough to assess feasibility, make informed product decisions, and use AI to accelerate your own work.
  • Outcome-oriented. You define success clearly, share progress openly, and hold yourself to measurable impact.

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

descriptionHtml:

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unternehmerisches Denken – Du hast eine eigene, begründete Meinung dazu, wohin sich Legal AI entwickelt, und denkst in Markt und Wirkung, nicht nur in Features.

Wenn du nicht alles erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir suchen Potenzial, nicht Perfektion.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum – Du bist die zentrale Stimme dafür, wohin sich Silvernova strategisch und produktseitig entwickelt – mit direktem Draht zum Gründungsteam und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Mitarbeiterbeteiligung – Über unser Beteiligungsprogramm profitierst du direkt vom Unternehmenswert. Wächst Silvernova, wächst dein Anteil mit.

So geht es weiter

Uns interessieren deine konkreten Erfahrungen, Entscheidungen und Lernprozesse mehr als eine perfekte Vita. Bei den Bewerbungsfragen reichen Stichpunkte – und zeig uns gern etwas, das du selbst gebaut hast.

Wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit dir herauszufinden, wie du bei Silvernova Impact schaffen kannst – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.

Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.

What you will do

Find the problems that matter

  • Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

  • See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

  • Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

Build with AI, in your work and in our product

  • Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

  • Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

  • Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

Deliver with rigour

  • Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

  • Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

  • Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

Bring people with you

  • Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

  • Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

  • Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

  • Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

  • Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

  • Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

  • A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

  • Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

  • Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

  • Experience in marketplaces, consumer products or B2B platforms is helpful but not essential

  • You're excited about changing how people buy and sell cars

Benefits

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive:

  • Great work-life balance

  • London office location with regular social events, office drinks and free snacks to keep you going

  • Hybrid work schedule with 2 days per week in our Central London office

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway's growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme, save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

  • Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and workplace nursery scheme... and much more!

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you'll be up to

  • Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.
  • Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.
  • Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.
  • Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.
  • Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.
  • Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.
  • Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you'll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

  • Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.
  • Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.
  • Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.
  • Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.
  • Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.
  • An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

  • Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.
  • Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.
  • Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team.

The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three.

You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers.


Your impact at Brevo:
  • Gather client signals and usage data and translate them into clearly defined problems, then shape the pitch — appetite, solution, risks and no-gos — and defend it at the betting table.
  • Act as the pod's sole design reference: frame the user experience, make interaction and interface decisions, and create prototypes in line with our Naos design system leveraging Claude or our in-house prototyping tool.
  • Run the build cycle against the pitch, using lightweight written status artefacts rather than recurring status meetings, and adjust scope rather than extend timelines.
  • Agree on one or two measurable outcomes before the build begins, then deliver a clear post-launch verdict: continue, adjust, or discontinue.
  • Own the launch: run the beta programme, equip PMM for go-to-market, and get Sales, CSM and Support ready ahead of release.
  • Be the pod's single point of contact for the wider BU — surfacing risks early, coordinating with peer Pod Leaders, and applying AI tools by default across discovery, prototyping and analysis.

    • Who you are:
  • You have a relevant background as a PM or Product Designer, or Lead Engineer — no single track is preferred.
  • You can own an experience end-to-end: framing user problems, making interface/interaction decisions, and producing or validating prototypes (Figma and design-system literacy required).
  • You have a go-getter, get-things-done mentality: you take initiative, push through ambiguity, and drive things to completion rather than waiting to be told.
  • You can write and defend a complete pitch: problem, appetite, sketch, rabbit holes, no-gos and success metrics.
  • You have a track record of shipping against a committed appetite using lightweight, async cadence artefacts (e.g. hill charts) rather than heavyweight Scrum rituals.
  • You're comfortable pulling and interpreting usage data (Amplitude, funnel, retention) and running discovery interviews to turn signals into problem statements.
  • You're tech-credible: comfortable reading AI-generated code and partnering with a Lead Engineer on trade-offs — and you integrate AI tools by default into your day-to-day work, with a critical validation step on their outputs.
  • You are fluent in English and in French

title: Senior Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen.

Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt.

Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd.

  • Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging.

  • Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen.

  • Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken.

  • Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen.

  • Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment;

  • werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties;

  • werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team;

  • kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen;

  • heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré;

  • beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 15 HAY (incl. CAO verhoging per 1 Januari 2027) is de range € 4.435,55 tot € 5.913,69 op basis van 36 uur.

title: Senior Restaurant Onboarding Specialist
descriptionHtml:

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our Onboarding Operations team (Restaurant/Retail Onboarding) is the heart and soul of Wolt. We ensure that we set all our (restaurant and retail) partners up for success through a seamless onboarding, menu and photo experience. As Wolt grows in both size and scope of our offering, the strength of our engine must grow with it.

About the Team

As a member of our team, you will master the core functions, including onboarding partners and managing cross-functional partners both internally and externally for the German market. You will interact with partners, welcome them to Wolt and ensure their experience is seamless and they are set up for success!

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to help shape something extraordinary in an international environment
  • A high learning and growth curve in a global technology company
  • An attractive salary and flexible working hours

Are you excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Inform partners about processes and procedures via form, email and phone, mostly in German language

Our modest expectations

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

We already work with some of the biggest names in the industry; Philips, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Orbis, Abiomed, Vicarious Surgical, Novartis, and Allergan, among others.

Our target markets are pouring investment into VR, AR, XR, and AI right now. That timing, combined with warm accounts that have room to grow and large enterprise logos still
untapped, means the ceiling on this role is high.

Where we see this hire having a real impact

You'll help set the standard for how we sell. Your cadence, outreach approach, and account strategy will become the model others follow.

  • Generate your own pipeline. You'll be responsible for identifying, developing, and selling new business opportunities. We expect the successful candidate to have strong SDR fundamentals, tailored email, proficient on the phone and create bespoke LinkedIn outreach as well as building the confidence to work our target market in person at industry events.

  • Grow warm accounts. Take existing relationships with room to expand and turn them into larger, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Open up untapped enterprise accounts. Using a ‘scalpel-selling’ approach, with focused, research-led targeting rather than relying on broader, generic outreach.

  • Run a consultative, complex sales process. With deals starting at $150,000 and scaling to $1m+, you'll be managing long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and technical/clinical buying committees and need to qualify opportunities through agreed frameworks (BANTC, MEDDPICC etc.).

  • Use data to drive and defend your strategy. You'll need to tell a clear, data-backed story of who you're targeting and why, spot when a channel or approach isn't working and pivot quickly, and double down, increasing cadence and investment on the tactics that prove fruitful.

  • Set the pace for the sales team. As a senior hire, you’ll need to get up to speed fast, develop and present outreach strategy within the first 30 days and execute that strategy

  • Collaborate with other teams. Following our new ‘Solution Sales’ process, where an SME / MedEd / PO is engaged early in customer conversations to appropriately understand customer requirements, define scope and liaising with CSM to define how business outcomes will be measured and articulated to client on live project

  • Strengthen the sales team culture by focusing on delivery and hands-on mentoring of junior team members.

  • Help review our sales software stack helping figure out what works for us, what software or services are critical and supporting the successful roll out

Who we think we be successful in this role

  • Proven track record closing complex, high-value deals (six figures and above), ideally in a solution-sale or enterprise environment.

  • Strong self-starter with genuine experience generating your own pipeline and not just working inbound leads.

  • Comfortable and effective with SDR-style outreach: cold email, LinkedIn, calling and event-based prospecting.

  • Experience selling into large enterprise or matrixed organisations, ideally med-tech, med-device, pharma, healthcare, or another regulated/technical market.

  • A creative, hypothesis-driven approach to sales - someone who tests new angles rather than defaulting to "how it's always been done."

  • Confidence operating without a fully mature playbook, and the drive to help build one.

  • Comfortable working with data and CRM reporting to justify targeting decisions, track what's working, and adjust cadence and channel mix based on results rather than instinct alone.

  • Excellent stakeholder management across clinical, procurement, and commercial buyers.

  • Experience driving smart adoption of available tools using agentic AI for persona and target company research, for example, delivering results faster and at greater scale.

What We Offer

  • Private healthcare with AXA for you and your family

  • A penthouse office in Farringdon with unlimited snacks and soft drinks

  • £250/year work-from-home budget to build a setup that works for you

  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays, increasing 1 day per year up to 30 days.

  • A perks package with discounts on gym memberships and popular retailers

title: Senior Sales Development Representative (German-speaking, UK)
descriptionHtml:
Coder is looking for a Senior Sales Development Representative (SDR) to fuel our growth by generating qualified pipeline for our Enterprise Account Managers. You’ll help bring Coder’s Environment-as-a-Service platform to some of the world’s largest companies that are adopting AI-driven development at scale.

This role is all about creating opportunities: finding and engaging the right prospects, uncovering the pain points Coder can help with, and setting up qualification calls that set our EAMs up for success. You’ll play a critical role in driving Coder’s outbound motion and helping large organizations build software faster, more securely, and at scale through the collaboration of AI coding agents and human developers.

 

What you’ll do here

  • Generate qualified opportunities for EAMs through targeted outbound prospecting

  • Conduct multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn using tools like SalesLoft, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, and Nooks

  • Research target accounts and key personas to craft personalized and value-driven messaging

  • Set up qualification calls for EAMs to run and advance through the sales cycle

  • Work closely with EAMs to strategize account outreach and hand off qualified opportunities seamlessly

  • Maintain accurate activity and lead data in CRM and engagement platforms

  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and campaigns to drive higher response rates

  • Stay sharp on developer tooling, platform engineering, and AI-driven development trends to speak credibly with prospects

 

What we’re looking for

  • 1-3 years in outbound SDR or BDR roles within SaaS or developer-focused technology companies

  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound cold calling, emailing, and social selling

  • Experience with SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, and similar prospecting tools

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly articulate technical value propositions

  • Grit, curiosity, and the ability to handle rejection while maintaining a positive, proactive mindset

  • Highly organized and self-motivated with a focus on measurable goals and continuous improvement

  • Eagerness to learn about developer tools, DevOps, platform engineering, and AI workflows

 

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Prior experience selling into engineering or DevOps personas

  • Familiarity with AI and GenAI developer tools

  • Knowledge of open source ecosystems or cloud-native technologies

  • Experience collaborating closely with Account Executives in an enterprise sales motion

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby and Brainerr help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact
