title: Staff Applied Scientist, Optimisation
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Millions of parcels, thousands of couriers, and routing, pricing and scheduling decisions needed in real time and under uncertainty. Relay's last mile is a growing optimisation problem that never sits still.

Relay's in-house solver has carried the business through more than 100x growth, built by a team of Operational Research Scientists who designed the decision architecture the network runs on. You'll join them and take it further.

Optimisation Highlights

  • An in-house solver, built and owned by our own Operational Research team, running live at scale.

  • Routing, pricing and scheduling decisions made in real time and under uncertainty.

  • ML and recommender intelligence integrated into the decision models.

  • A flexible network: pitstops can change, warehouse automation can be reconfigured, and new processes roll out overnight.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Lead optimisation for Relay's last mile, making the best routing, pricing and scheduling decisions for couriers and the wider network.

  • Model and optimise the decisions that define our last-mile delivery network and marketplace.

  • Develop our solvers and algorithms so they perform live, and at scale.

  • Partner with other Scientists to unite ML and recommender systems with Operational Research.

  • Raise the standard for Operational Research at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in operational research, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from operational research or industrial engineering, or from an advanced quantitative discipline, including trading, that has branched into optimisation.

  • Have built optimisation systems or ML models that run in production, and owned the outcome.

  • Are energised by large, messy problems, and know how to bring structure to them.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.

About the role:

Grafana Cloud runs Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope as multi-tenant SaaS databases across AWS, GCP and Azure in regions worldwide. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.

The role combines building and operating. You’ll write the software, automation and product changes that make our databases more reliable, including changes to the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases where reliability calls for it. You’ll also be on call for our highest-SLA customers and handle the operational work that comes with it. You’ll bring a production mindset to product engineering and engineering rigor to reliability, and you’ll set technical direction across squads.

What You’ll Do

  • Build reliability into the product. Write production code in our services, tooling and the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases that makes our databases more resilient, self-healing and scalable as demand grows quickly.
  • Build automation and platform tooling that removes toil and scales our reliability practices across regions and cloud providers.
  • Lead technical design. Author design docs, review others’ designs and PRs, and shape feature design so it’s scalable and operable from day one.
  • Own the SLO framework. Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models. Use SLO burn and incident learnings to find and fix the causes of failure in the systems themselves.
  • Improve observability and alerting so we find problems before customers do, and so escalations are actionable rather than noisy.
  • Be on call for our highest-SLA customers. Act as a technical escalation point for complex customer environments. Lead customer-impacting incident response, including customer bridge calls when needed, and write blameless post-incident reviews that lead to engineering fixes.
  • Handle the operational work that comes from on-call. This includes investigating customer escalations, following up on incident actions, tuning capacity and configuration, and turning recurring issues into permanent fixes or automation.
  • Multiply the team. Mentor engineers, teach reliability practices that teams adopt early in development, and work with engineering leadership on roadmaps and product strategy.
  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)

On-Call

Weekday on-call is 12-hour shifts, Monday to Friday, split between North America and Europe so you cover your local working hours. Weekends are covered by a separate 24-hour rotation. You’ll take a weekend roughly once every six to eight weeks.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and owning distributed systems in production.
  • Strong production software skills, ideally in at least one object-oriented language. You write clean, tested code and can make targeted changes in large open-source codebases you didn’t write.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems: performance, scaling and failure modes. You can reason about how a system will break before it does.
  • Experience running multi-tenant systems at scale on Kubernetes in AWS, GCP or Azure, with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Helm or Jsonnet.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing SLOs.
  • Experience being on call for production systems. You troubleshoot calmly and methodically under pressure, and you’ve taken part in blameless incident response and written high-quality post-incident reviews.
  • Staff-level technical leadership: driving cross-team projects, setting technical direction and making the engineers around you better.
  • Working knowledge of Linux internals, networking and cloud storage.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Prometheus or other observability and time-series databases.
  • Open-source contributions.
  • Customer reliability engineering (CRE) or customer-facing escalation experience.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

Your Day-to-Day

Own the Execution Plan:

  • Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

  • Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making

  • Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks — timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

  • Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

  • Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

  • Coach and mentor other TPMs.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs — ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI — with high delivery accountability.

  • Technical Depth: Solid understanding of how complex deep-tech products are engineered across Hardware, Software and Science/AI. You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

    • Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

  • Execution & Planning: Expert in building and managing master program plans, sprint structures, milestone tracking, and risk registers across multiple concurrent workstreams.

    Stakeholder Management: Able to translate technical complexity into executive-level clarity and to influence and align without formal authority across matrixed organizations.

  • Change Management: Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools, frameworks, and processes (e.g. PDLC/PLM rollouts, agile tooling) across cross-functional teams — balancing structured change with the pace of a fast-moving scale-up.

  • Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

  • Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up environments, models candid communication, and creates psychological safety in high-stakes settings

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. Familiarity with industrializing sensor-based inspection systems for high-throughput agricultural or food processing environments is highly valued.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

descriptionHtml:
LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. VOS MISSIONS · Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. · Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. · Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. · Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. · Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. · Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. · Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. · Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. · Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. PROFIL · Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe. · Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée. · Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client. · Enthousiaste, curieux(se) et doté(e) d’un esprit d’initiative. · Adaptable et proactif(ve), avec un fort esprit d’équipe. · Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, une troisième langue serait un plus. title: Stage: Bedrijfsprocessen & Veiligheid
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdracht

Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

  • une équipe dynamique et soudée avec fort esprit d’équipe

  • Une réelle école de vente avec la Doctolib Sales Academy, qui vous forme au cycle de vente complet et vous apprend à répondre à des objections. 

 

Vos missions 

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Mettre à jour et organiser les informations des prospects dans notre outil CRM.

  • Travailler en partenariat avec les équipes support et produit pour assurer la satisfaction des utilisateurs tout au long de leur parcours.

  • Générer des opportunités pour nos équipes commerciales en contactant de futurs utilisateurs.

  • Assister aux réunions d’équipe et participer à des sessions de formation continue avec votre manager pour améliorer vos compétences dans le domaine commercial.

 

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le/ la prochain(e) membre de notre équipe si : 

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études

  • Vous avez une très bonne communication à l'oral comme à l'écrit, en français, et un bon niveau en anglais 

  • Vous êtes doté(e) d’un très bon relationnel et possédez un fort esprit d’équipe

  • Vous avez envie d’apprendre, et vous recherchez à intégrer une entreprise à vrai impact social avec laquelle vous pourrez apprendre et vous développer.

  • Faire preuve d’empathie et avoir une capacité d’écoute attentive.

  • Avoir un fort sens de l’organisation et de l’efficacité.

Ce serait fantastique si :

  • Vous avez une première expérience dans l'univers de la vente

  • Vous avez une appétence pour le domaine de la santé 

 

Notre offre

  • Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

title: Stage - Social Media Redactie (feb 2027)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een social media fanaat en heb je er altijd van gedroomd om deel uit te maken van het 433-team en zijn 120+ miljoen volgers? Dit is jouw kans! Wij zijn op zoek naar twee Social Media & Content Stagiairs.
WIJ ZIJN 433

Met meer dan 120 miljoen volgers en ruim 9 miljard impressies per maand is 433 the home of football op social media. Wij richten ons op het creëren en delen van de beste voetbalcontent op alle platformen wereldwijd. Onze enorme fanbase bevat meer dan 15.000 professionele voetballers, waaronder Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé en Erling Haaland. En we zijn meer dan alleen social media: met de 433-app brengen we alles samen op één plek. Van live uitslagen, statistieken en opstellingen tot het laatste transfernieuws, virale video's, quizzen en Predictions waarmee fans het tegen elkaar opnemen op de leaderboards. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam brengen we de kleedkamerhumor en voetbalpassie naar fans over de hele wereld.

JOUW POSITIE OP HET VELD

Als Social Media & Content Stagiair bij 433 maak je deel uit van het gepassioneerde content- en socialmediateam. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor alle content op platformen zoals Instagram, YouTube, TikTok en Snapchat én in de 433-app. Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn het beheren van communities op verschillende kanalen en het ontdekken en activeren van nieuwe social media functionaliteiten en tools. Daarnaast help je mee om de app elke dag te vullen met de beste content: van nieuwsupdates en transfers tot quizzen en Predictions rondom de grootste wedstrijden. Je bent altijd op zoek naar nieuws, doelpunten, transfers, skills, e-sports en nog veel meer. Jij leeft voor voetbal, net zoals wij. Met jouw creativiteit en out-of-the-box mindset bedenk je nieuwe concepten om miljoenen volgers en app-gebruikers te betrekken.


JOUW SPELERSPROFIEL

Wij zoeken creatieve en ambitieuze stagiaires die in ons verhaal geloven, houden van het mooiste spel ter wereld en dezelfde passie delen. Jouw profiel:

  • Bij voorkeur studeer je in de richting van marketing, communicatie, creative business, (graphic) design, multimedia design of een andere vergelijkbare studie;

  • Je hebt kennis en ervaring met verschillende sociale media platformen;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe fans content gebruiken, op social én in apps;

  • Basiskennis van Adobe Photoshop is mooi meegenomen;

  • Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027

  • Je hebt uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, in woord en geschrift;

  • Je hebt een grote passie voor voetbal en sociale media;

  • Je bent flexibel, creatief en enthousiast;

  • Je woon in (de omgeving van) Amsterdam.

ONS AANBOD

  • Een toffe stage bij de grooste online voetbal community ter wereld;

  • Ervaring met zowel social media als een eigen app, een unieke combinatie in de voetbalwereld;

  • Een stagevergoeding, een dagelijkse verzorgde lunch en paddelen met je collega’s bij ons op kantoor in Amsterdam;

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving waar creativiteit, ambitie en plezier centraal staan;

  • De kans om je socialmedia-skills te ontwikkelen en je carrière een boost te geven.

Wil je deel uitmaken van de wereldwijde groei van 433? Solliciteer dan direct en wie weet zien we je snel!

title: Stagiair Office & Event Management (mbo/hbo)
descriptionHtml:
Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt?

Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee!

Over Zibber

Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren.

Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen.

De rol

Je werkt nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt.

Denk aan:

  • Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten.

  • Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering.

  • Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt.

  • Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken.

  • Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën.

En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen!

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een afwisselende stage waarin je écht iets kunt bijdragen.

  • Ruimte om zelfstandig dingen op te pakken en eigen ideeën uit te voeren.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant.

  • De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken.

  • Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven.

  • Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid.

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage.

  • Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school.

  • Starten in januari of februari 2027!


Je volgt een mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage.

Verder vinden we vooral belangrijk dat je:

  • Positieve energie meebrengt en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt.

  • Zelf initiatief neemt en niet afwacht.

  • Makkelijk communiceert en vragen durft te stellen.

  • Houdt van organiseren en overzicht bewaren.

  • Goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.

Ervaring? Mooi meegenomen. De juiste instelling? Veel belangrijker!

Klinkt dit als jouw stage?

Ben jij iemand die liever zegt 'Ik regel het!' dan 'Wie gaat dat doen?'?

Dan pas je waarschijnlijk perfect bij Zibber. Solliciteer en laat ons weten waarom jij graag dingen voor elkaar krijgt. We maken graag kennis met je!

title: Strategic Account Executive Enterprise - DACH
descriptionHtml:
🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
  • A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
  • A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
  • Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
  • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.
The Mission 🪐
  • The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

    • Key Responsibilities ✨

    Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
  • Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
  • Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

    • Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command

  • Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
  • Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
  • Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

    • Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

  • Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
  • Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

  • A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
  • Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
  • Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
  • Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
  • C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
  • Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.

    • The Self-Selection Filter ❓

    This role is perfect for you if:

  • You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
  • You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
  • You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

    • This role is NOT for you if:

  • You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
  • You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
  • You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

    • 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
  • Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
  • Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
  • Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance. Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
  • Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo, to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
  • Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.
  • Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.
    • Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫 🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris. 💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office. 🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year. 📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years. 📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options. 🍽️ Lunch vouchers:6,50€ per day / 15 days a month. 🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin! ❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App. 📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow. Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive. Your profile may be subject to background screening. title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Strategic Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by helping the world’s leading hotel, restaurant and leisure groups own their guest relationships. We partner with multi-venue operators across EMEA as trusted advisors: we take a consultative approach, uncover gaps in how groups manage guest data, operations and distribution, and design solutions that reduce reliance on third-party networks and drive measurable revenue. Since SevenRooms joined DoorDash, we work alongside DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to bring merchants a connected offer across discovery, reservations, delivery and on-premise dining.

About the Role

We’re hiring an experienced Strategic Account Executive to uncover, drive and close new business with enterprise hospitality groups across EMEA. You will focus on hotel groups, multi-brand restaurant groups, and other large multi-venue operators (typically 50+ locations), selling the full SevenRooms platform: CRM and guest data, marketing automation, reservations and waitlist, table and revenue management, events and experiences, online ordering, Voice AI, and group reporting. These are complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, so you will navigate matrixed organisations, build executive-level relationships and structure commercial agreements that scale across venues and regions. You will work closely with Product, Solutions, Customer Success and Onboarding to make sure every enterprise partner launches successfully and grows with us.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Win new enterprise logos. Own a named-account strategy across hotel and restaurant groups with 50+ venues, building and running a pipeline through targeted outbound, partnerships, industry events and executive networks.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Map decision-makers across operations, marketing, IT, finance, procurement and group leadership, and build consensus around a clear business case.
  • Sell a platform, not a point solution. Articulate how SevenRooms unifies guest data across venues to drive direct bookings, repeat visits, higher spend per cover and lower commission costs, and tailor the story to each group’s priorities.
  • Run the full sales lifecycle. Take deals from first conversation through discovery, executive presentations and live demos, commercial and financial deal structuring, RFP responses, security and legal review, contract negotiation and close.
  • Negotiate multi-year, multi-venue agreements. Structure pricing, rollout phasing and contract terms across brands, regions and entities.
  • Partner cross-functionally. Work with Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Onboarding, Customer Success and DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to shape rollout plans, integrations and long-term account growth.
  • Be a trusted advisor. Bring market insight, benchmarks and hospitality expertise to senior operators, and champion their success well beyond signature.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 8+ years of B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding quota
  • You have experience selling complex, multi-faceted platforms to mid-market and enterprise customers, ideally in hospitality, hotels, restaurants, leisure or adjacent verticals
  • You have deep knowledge of, or strong relationships within, the hotel and hospitality industry
  • You have experience building relationships with C-level and executive stakeholders and navigating large, matrixed organisations
  • You have experience structuring and negotiating complex, multi-year deals, and managing RFPs, procurement and security reviews
  • You are an outstanding presenter in person and virtually, with strong business acumen and natural curiosity
  • You are self-driven, organised and comfortable managing a long, multi-threaded pipeline with forecast discipline
  • You are tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools; you have worked with Salesforce, RFP management tools or similar systems
  • You are open to regular travel across EMEA to meet clients face-to-face
  • Nice to have: fluency in a second European language, and experience selling CRM, marketing, reservations, PMS or POS technology

About SevenRooms

In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.

With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.

In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.

As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Strategic Finance Business Partner - Senior Vice President
descriptionHtml:
About AlixPartners

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action — when it really matters.

We create value that has a lasting impact on companies, their employees and their communities.

By understanding, respecting and acknowledging the needs of our employees, clients and communities, AlixPartners actively fosters an inclusive environment. We firmly believe in the value that diversity of experience brings, and we are committed to continuously improving our initiatives, policies and practices. We commit to creating space for authenticity, growth and equality for everyone.

AlixPartners has adopted a hybrid working model to offer flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration.

What you'll do

In this role as Strategic Finance Business Partner (France), you can expect a fast-paced, hands-on position in finance, working with the local French Leadership on driving the country’s performance as well as with the wider strategic finance team for the EMEA region.

You will be a trusted strategic finance partner to the French Country Leader and Managing Director & Partner group, translating financial data into actionable insights and proactively challenging business decisions to support sustainable and profitable growth.

In supporting the finance function, you will work closely with colleagues in accounting and other Corporate Services functions (HR, Legal, IT, Business Development, etc.) in our fast-moving, rapidly growing company.

Ideally, you are an experienced business partner with a strong customer focus and the ability to build and maintain interpersonal relationships. You will work closely with the French leadership team and the wider Managing Director & Partner group and successfully handle demanding financial topics.

You are joining at an exciting time and will help modernize the finance function and support the company's long-term success. This role plays an important part in our strong growth, and you will have the opportunity to help shape it and build your own finance career at AlixPartners.

The Strategic Finance Business Partner – France is a full-time position with hybrid working arrangements, based in our Paris office. The role reports to the EMEA Head of Strategic Finance. Your responsibilities also include:

Proactive coordination with the French Country Leader and Managing Director & Partners to provide financial expertise and support, focusing on company growth, improving profitability and strengthening working capital management to reduce DSOs

Acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, offering proactive financial insights, recommendations and constructive challenge on key business and operational decisions

Preparation and ownership of annual budgets and monthly forecasting processes

Supporting business planning and capacity planning, including financial analysis to improve resource allocation and profitable revenue growth

Providing the financial resources needed to ensure strategic business development, client retention and increased client profitability within country, service and industry groups

Close collaboration with the engagement analyst team to ensure a continuous flow of information on project-related challenges, or specific issues, and to support their resolution and discussion

Identifying revenue risks arising from significant working capital or engagement challenges and responding appropriately

Supporting the Managing Director & Partner group on the running of their projects, including pricing, project set-up, WIP and AR management

Proactively challenging stakeholders on engagement economics, fee structures, profitability and financial risks, and driving appropriate corrective actions

Preparing the monthly financial management information (MI), including insightful commentary and analysis

Developing and implementing dashboards, KPIs and regular performance-review routines across clients, engagements and Managing Director & Partners, translating analysis into clear business recommendations

Monitoring performance against long-term strategic and short-term operational plans and supporting the Country Leader in defining the measures needed to achieve agreed financial targets

Carrying out ad hoc analyses as needed to maximize profitability in terms of revenue and working capital

What you'll need

Experience in strategic finance, FP&A or finance business partnering with senior stakeholders, ideally in the professional services or consulting sector

A strong foundation in accounting and financial controlling, combined with relevant professional experience; seniority and scope of experience will be assessed against the role requirements

Advanced proficiency in MS Office, with a particular focus on Excel and PowerPoint

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

The ability to stay calm and focused under pressure

Strong analytical and organizational skills with great attention to detail

Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge experienced stakeholders, including senior business leaders

Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to turn complex financial analyses into practical, actionable recommendations

A proactive, hands-on, solutions-oriented mindset and the confidence to take ownership of financial performance topics

A mindset that prioritizes continuous improvement, supporting personal development, colleague development and the optimization of business processes and interactions

A collaborative team player who values transparency and takes a straightforward approach

title: Strategy & Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:
If you do not speak German at a minimum C1 level, please do not apply!

Applying anyway is disrespectful and a waste of both your time and mine.

This requirement is clearly stated for a reason.

No fluent German, no chance. No exceptions!

Unser Kunde

Das Unternehmen ist ein Climate‑Tech‑Start‑up im Bereich Nachhaltigkeits‑Software und Consulting. Mit 11‑50 Mitarbeitenden, Hauptsitz in Berlin und einem remote‑first Team, bietet es eine KI‑gestützte Plattform für CO₂‑Footprinting, PCF‑ und LCA‑Berechnungen sowie CSRD‑Compliance. Es positioniert sich als schneller, produkt‑orientierter Anbieter, der Unternehmen bei der Reduktion ihrer Emissionen unterstützt.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Hohe Gestaltungsmacht – du baust den gesamten Beratungsprozess auf und bestimmst die Skalierung.

  • Sinnstiftende Aufgabe – du trägst direkt zum Klimaschutz bei, indem du Unternehmen beim CO₂‑Footprinting unterstützt.

  • Remote Flexibilität – 100 % Homeoffice aus Deutschland, keine Mikromanagement‑Kultur.

  • Karriere‑Boost – schnelle Aufstiegschancen in einer wachsenden Unit.

  • Attraktives Gehalt – €50‑70 k Jahresgehalt plus Benefits.

  • Innovatives Tech‑Stack – Arbeit mit einer KI‑basierten Sustainability‑Plattform.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des PCF/LCA‑Kundenprozesses.

  • End‑to‑End‑Betreuung von Kundenprojekten: Datenaufnahme, Modellierung, Validierung und Ergebnispräsentation.

  • Entwicklung von Regelwerken und Methodologien für PCF/LCA‑Kunden.

  • Mitgestaltung der Software: Input für Produktfeatures und Automatisierungsideen.

  • Skalierung und Dokumentation wiederholbarer Consulting‑Prozesse.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam zur Optimierung von Workflows.

  • Schulung von Kolleg:innen und Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

  • Hauptansprechpartner:in für Kund:innen, inkl. Unterstützung bei weiteren Nachhaltigkeits‑Tools.

Dein Profil

  • Fließendes Deutsch (C2) und sehr gutes Englisch (C1).

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Nachhaltigkeitsberatung oder in‑house mit Fokus PCF/LCA.

  • Hands‑on‑Ownership von PCF/LCA‑Projekten von Daten bis Ergebnis – keine Weiterleitung.

title: Sustainability solutions consultant (french & german speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We're looking for more early members to join our Sustainability solutions team! You may be a fit for this role if you’re excited to help Europe's largest companies deliver real decarbonisation, navigate an increasingly complex landscape of investor pressure, customer expectations and regulatory requirements. You’re willing to roll your sleeves up and go deep with prospective customers on their functional and technical needs, partnering with our sales, product and climate science teams along the way. You may be a carbon accounting aficionado or you may have never worked in climate before but have a passion for the subject; either way, you have a knack for quickly learning new, complex topics and distilling them for others.


You will:

  • Partner closely with 3-4 Account Executives, to analyse and understand customers’ businesses, climate ambitions and software needs

  • Become a trusted advisor to our prospective customers—educating them about corporate climate commitments, carbon accounting, regulation/policy and the Watershed offering

  • Build and share subject matter expertise on how the world’s largest companies can run successful climate programs

  • Demonstrate Watershed’s unique value to prospective customers, through product demonstrations, ROI analysis and customer stories

  • Creatively apply the Agentic AI capabilities of the Watershed platform to address innovative use cases

  • Scope complex customer engagements as Watershed expands to new industries

  • Interface with Customer Success and Sustainability Advisory teams to ensure smooth handovers from pre- to post-contract

  • Collaborate with Watershed’s Engineering, Product and Marketing teams to continuously improve Watershed’s products and positioning

  • It is a mandatory requirement to have business level French and German for this role

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have worked in a Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering role for an Enterprise SaaS company

  • Have partnered with Account Executives to scope successful engagements with mid-sized to large companies

  • Master new concepts and technologies quickly

  • Have exceptional communication and presentation skills; can engage deeply with both technical and business executive audiences

  • Get energy from working across multiple projects concurrently and wearing many hats

  • Are passionate about decarbonising diverse industries, from aviation to manufacturing to cloud computing

  • Are excited to join a startup and are ready to take responsibility defining a new standard for climate and Sustainability AI programs around the world!

Considered a “very nice to have” if you:

  • Have a background in corporate climate programs or carbon accounting

  • Have policy experience, especially in climate/sustainability/corporate reporting

This role might include up to 25% travel.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: System Software/Embedded Engineer (Munich)
descriptionHtml:
System Software / Embedded Engineer (Munich)

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours.

Responsibilities

The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers.
  • Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred.
  • Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions.
  • BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each others’ differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. title: Talent Lead
descriptionHtml:
You make sure the best people apply to Pivotal's programs, and that we select the right ones.

  • Salary: £86,750–£155,500 per year, depending on seniority. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You’ll own how people find Pivotal’s programs and how we select them. This runs from the first time someone hears about us to the final decision, which you make with mentors. In 2027 we plan up to 4 more application rounds, and for our Q1 2027 round we received 5,000+ applications.

The primary focus will be to grow the number of strong applicants, including people from outside the usual AI safety pipeline, such as mid-career professionals. You’ll also run selection at scale, which is getting harder because AI-written applications make written answers a weaker signal. You’ll design each round, check afterwards whether it picked the right people, and change it when it did not.

  • Outreach and marketing. Grow the number of strong applicants for each program through channels, campaigns, partner organisations, and presence at universities and conferences.

  • Communications for applicants. Program pages, application guidance and messages to applicants.

  • The selection process. Design and run each round: forms, AI-assisted screening, contract reviewers, work tasks, interviews, and final decisions with mentors and Research Managers. Keep it fair, fast and compliant with data protection law.

  • Learning from results. Track which selection signals predict good fellowships and careers. This includes fellows who did worse than expected and strong applicants we turned down. Change the process based on what you find.

Who does well in this role

  • You have run recruiting, admissions, marketing or talent search for a selective program or organisation, and you can show results.

  • You have good judgement about people, and you can make it explicit so that others can apply it consistently.

  • You want to find out if your process works, and you change it when it does not.

  • You are good at outreach & communications, including outside the AI safety community.

  • You use AI tools well, for example to screen at scale, and you know where they fail.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks from AI. You do not need a research background.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £155,500

title: Technical & Industry Enablement Manager
descriptionHtml:
Technical & Industry Enablement Manager

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Technical Enablement Manager to join our Revenue Enablement team in Amsterdam. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to empower our global revenue teams through impactful technical training, scalable enablement programs, and industry expertise, helping drive customer success while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance.

Why DataSnipper?

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers
.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

What you will do

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the Revenue org, Product, Product Marketing, and the Revenue Enablement team to ensure technical readiness and alignment across all field enablement initiatives

  • Design and deliver technical and industry enablement programs that deepen the field's product, architecture, and industry knowledge so they can confidently explain how DataSnipper works and why it matters in audit and finance

  • Build and maintain scalable enablement assets (training workbooks, playbooks, and technical guides) ensuring consistent depth across the global team

  • Build and run discovery and value realization training that teaches the field how to ask the right questions, uncover pain points, and drive customers from adoption to measurable outcomes

  • Develop objection handling frameworks and coaching that prepare the field for tough, skeptical conversations with technical and finance audiences

  • Continuously analyze and improve field performance through data-driven insights, tracking the connection between enablement and adoption, delivery quality, and customer outcomes

What you bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in technical enablement, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or a similar technical-plus-customer-facing role within B2B SaaS

  • Direct experience translating complex or technical product concepts into clear, practical guidance that non-technical audiences can use immediately

  • Hands-on experience building technical training programs, workshops, or enablement content from scratch (not just delivering pre-made content)

  • Strong understanding of how enterprise software products work at an architectural level. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand how the pieces fit together

  • Ability to work across teams (Product, PMM, SE, CS) and synthesize input from multiple sources into coherent enablement materials

  • Comfortable working with data to identify performance gaps and measure the impact of enablement programs

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills. You can hold a room (virtual or in-person) and make technical concepts accessible

  • A collaborative, self-starter mindset suited for a fast-paced scale-up environment

  • Experience in audit, finance, or accounting technology is a strong plus but not required

What We Offer:

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

  • Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing


Recruitment Process

  • Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  • Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site)

  • Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

Du nutzt deinen Freiraum, packst Themen selbstständig an und bringst Projekte auch dann strukturiert und verlässlich ins Ziel, wenn es technisch knifflig wird.

Worum es bei dieser Aufgabe geht

Als Technischer Leiter Engineering / Lead Engineer bist du einer der technischen Köpfe von ISTinox. Du übernimmst die fachtechnische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Projekte und unterstützt unsere Projektleiter überall dort, wo vertieftes Engineering, Berechnungen oder verfahrenstechnisches Wissen gefragt sind. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Geschäftsleitung, Projektleitung, Konstruktion, Einkauf und Produktion zusammen.

  • Kundenanliegen aufnehmen: Technische Kundenanliegen im Erstkontakt aufnehmen, erste Ideen und Bedürfnisse erkennen und als kompetente Ansprechperson in die weitere Projektklärung begleiten.
  • Konzepte entwickeln: Technisch saubere und wirtschaftliche Lösungs- und Anlagenkonzepte entwickeln.
  • Anlagen und Komponenten: Anlagen und Komponenten planen, berechnen und dimensionieren.
  • Engineering: Das verfahrenstechnische und mechanische Engineering in anspruchsvollen Projekten verantworten.
  • Technische Grundlagen: Klare technische Grundlagen für Projektleitung und Konstruktion erarbeiten und sicherstellen, dass die Lösungen auch in Fertigung und Montage funktionieren.
  • Komplexe Kundenprojekte: Komplexe Kundenprojekte von der Konzeptphase bis zur technischen Umsetzung begleiten.
  • Unterstützung und Sparring: Unsere Projektleiter bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragestellungen als fachliche Sparringsperson unterstützen.
  • Fachliche Prüfung: Konzepte, Konstruktionen und kritische Komponenten mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch prüfen.
  • Zusammenarbeit: Eng mit Geschäftsleitung, Projektleitung, Konstruktion, Einkauf und Produktion zusammenarbeiten.
  • Standards und Abläufe: Technische Standards, Methoden und Abläufe pragmatisch weiterentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

  • Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise technische Grundausbildung als Konstrukteur, Anlagen- und Apparatebauer, Polymechaniker oder Ausbildung als Maschinenbauingenieur FH/ETH, idealerweise mit Fachrichtung Verfahrenstechnik, sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung im verfahrenstechnischen Anlagenbau.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Sehr gutes Verständnis für Konstruktion, Berechnung und technische Auslegung
  • Kundenspezifische Lösungen: Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen, kundenspezifischen Anlagen und Lösungen
  • Problemlösung: Freude daran, technische Probleme strukturiert zu analysieren und pragmatisch zu lösen
  • Fachliche Unterstützung: Fähigkeit, Konstrukteure und Projektleiter fachlich zu unterstützen
  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was dich bei ISTinox erwartet

  • Bei uns zählen nicht nur die Hard Facts: auch menschlich muss es passen. Wir packen an, haben Freude an richtig guter Arbeit und wollen gemeinsam etwas bewegen.
  • Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Menschen, mit denen Zusammenarbeit Freude macht: direkt, unkompliziert, hilfsbereit und mit echtem Teamgeist.
  • Leistungsprinzip: Initiative, Qualität und Verantwortung bringen dich bei uns weiter – Titel machen sich zwar gut auf Visitenkarten – entscheidend ist aber, was du daraus machst.
  • Schnelle Wege: Kurze Wege, klare Entscheide und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung – bei uns landen gute Ideen nicht in der Warteschleife.
  • Rundum gut abgesichert: mit 100 % Lohnfortzahlung bei Krankheit und attraktiven Vorsorgeleistungen, die mit deinen Dienstjahren wachsen!
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: fünf Wochen Ferien, ab 50 sechs, plus kostenlose Getränke von Kaffee bis Feierabendbier.
  • Echter Teamspirit: Ob After-Work-Drink, Grillabend, Weihnachtsessen oder Jubiläumsreise: Wir feiern Erfolge gern gemeinsam – und guter Teamgeist gehört für uns einfach dazu.

Klingt nach dir?
Wenn du einen Job suchst, der möglichst unspannend bleibt, sind wir vermutlich nicht dein Ziel. Wenn du Technik liebst, Verantwortung willst und mit uns Gas geben möchtest, wollen wir dich kennenlernen. Ein steifes Standardanschreiben ist nicht nötig. Schreib uns lieber, was dich antreibt, worauf du beruflich stolz bist und warum du zu ISTinox passt.

Thun-Gwatt

Sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
